izzyondroid:com.seeker.seekprivacy.name: SeekPrivacy
izzyondroid:com.seeker.seekprivacy.summary: Activist-Grade Defense Against System-Level Data Surveillance
izzyondroid:com.seeker.seekprivacy.description:
Standard vaults create a clunky "island." SeekPrivacy creates a shield. Apps like social media and basic tools demand "Storage Access"if you refuse, they break. If you accept, they spy . This creates a painful trade-off between functionality and privacy .
 SeekPrivacy is built on the principle that your phone's operating system and other apps should be considered "hostile territory." It assumes the Android OS is compromised and every other app is a potential spy . Its architecture ensures that even if a malicious app gains full control of the device, your data remains a cryptographic black box.
 SeekPrivacy eliminates this blackmail. It provides multi-layered defense by isolating data within an encrypted sandbox, inaccessible to other apps , the OS , or unauthorized physical extraction —providing activist-grade security . Built on the belief "Privacy Without the Tradeoff of Ease" , even if a malicious app has full device control, it sees nothing .

izzyondroid:me.sankethbk.dairyapp.description:
DiaryVault: Your Private Journal 
 DiaryVault is a private diary and journaling app designed to make writing, organizing, and protecting your personal memories simple.
 Write about your day, keep personal thoughts, save memories with photos and videos, and build a journaling habit — while keeping control of your data.
 ✍️ Rich Text Journal 
 Write naturally with a powerful rich text editor. Format your entries, add images and videos, create checklists, and use emojis to make every journal entry your own. DiaryVault also supports autosave and works offline, so you can write whenever inspiration strikes.
 🔐 Private & Secure 
 Your personal thoughts deserve privacy. Protect your diary with password, PIN, and fingerprint authentication. Individual notes can also be encrypted so that your private entries remain protected even when they are backed up to the cloud.
 ☁️ Cloud Backup & Sync 
 Keep your diary safe with automatic cloud backup and sync across your devices. DiaryVault lets you use your own cloud storage, including Google Drive, Dropbox and Nextcloud. Your journal stays in your chosen cloud storage, giving you greater control over your data. DiaryVault does not use your cloud storage as a way to access or read your personal journal entries.
 🎨 Make Your Diary Yours 
 Choose from multiple themes and customize your journaling experience to match your style.
 🏷️ Organize Your Journal 
 Use tags to organize your diary entries and quickly find the notes you’re looking for. Whether you’re keeping a daily journal, writing personal reflections, recording memories, or simply taking private notes, tags make it easier to keep everything organized.
 📊 Build a Journaling Habit 
 Stay consistent with daily reminders and journaling statistics. Track your writing activity, maintain your streak, and see your journaling history over time.
 📄 Export Your Entries 
 Take your writing with you. Export journal entries as plain text or PDF files for saving, printing, sharing, or keeping an additional copy of your memories.
 🌍 Multiple Languages 
 DiaryVault supports multiple languages, making the app accessible to journalers around the world.
 🚫 Ad-Free Journaling 
 Enjoy your journal without advertisements interrupting your writing experience.
 🔑 Forgot Your Password? 
 If you forget your password, you can reset it using the password reset email associated with your account.
 💻 Open Source 
 DiaryVault is open-source and built with privacy and user ownership in mind. View the DiaryVault source code on GitHub: https://github.com/SankethBK/diaryvault
 Start writing, reflecting, and keeping your memories with DiaryVault — a private journal you can take with you.

fdroid:com.drbea.nawoliy.summary: Offline personal finance manager, built for Guinea
fdroid:com.drbea.nawoliy.description:
Nawoliy is a personal finance manager that works entirely offline. No internet connection, no account, no data leaving your phone: everything is stored in a local database on the device.
 It is built for the realities of Guinea, where the connection is scarce and expensive, and where money moves through very concrete operations: transfers between accounts with operator fees, savings goals, debts between relatives, income that arrives every month.
 What you can do
 Budget and expenses : track your day-to-day spending, category by category, with an overall monthly budget, category budgets and a warning at 80% and when you go over.
 Transfers between accounts : follow several accounts (mobile money, bank, cash...) and record the fee charged by the operator, so you know the real cost of a transfer.
 Savings goals : set money aside for a project and follow your progress.
 Debts and loans : note who you owe and who owes you, repay in several instalments, and follow each person's history and the upcoming due dates.
 Recurring operations : salary, rent, subscriptions… a reminder at each due date opens the form already filled in.
 Quick entry : templates for frequent operations (taxi, phone credit…) and an optional daily reminder on days with nothing recorded.
 Statistics : by month or by year, compared with the previous period, with the change for each category.
 Backup : automatic daily or weekly copy, export and import of your data, CSV export and import for a spreadsheet.
 Widget : your balance and this month's spending on the home screen, with a button to add an operation.
 App lock : protect the app with your phone's fingerprint or screen lock.
 Privacy
 The app asks for no network permission and contains no advertising, no tracker and no usage analytics. Your financial data stays on your phone. Nothing is transmitted, and nothing can be.
 Languages
 Available in French (default), English, Spanish, Chinese, Hindi and Arabic. Amounts are displayed in the currency of your choice: Guinean franc, CFA francs, euro, dollar, pound sterling, naira, dirham, Egyptian pound, riyal, rupee, yuan, Hong Kong dollar, Macanese pataca, Mexican peso.
 Nawoliy is free software, released under the GNU GPL v3 license. Your data belongs to you.

fdroid:com.jarsilio.android.waveup.name: WaveUp
fdroid:com.jarsilio.android.waveup.summary: Turn on the display by waving
fdroid:com.jarsilio.android.waveup.description:
WaveUp wakes up your phone—switches the screen on—when you wave over the proximity sensor.
I built this app because I got tired of pressing the power button just to check the time (a surprisingly frequent habit). Inspired by the great Gravity Screen On/Off. I looked for an open-source alternative and just couldn’t find one. So I made it myself!
Checkout the code: https://gitlab.com/juanitobananas/wave-up
A possibly more more up-to-date README: https://gitlab.com/juanitobananas/wave-up/#waveup
 Features 
▸ Wave mode : Turns the screen on when you wave over the proximity sensor.
▸ Pocket mode : Turns the screen on when you pull your phone out of a pocket or bag.
Both are enabled by default but can be turned off in settings.
▸ Screen lock : cover the sensor for a second (or your chosen time) and the phone locks. Off by default , but easy to enable.
 Wait, what's a proximity sensor? 
It’s that invisible little thing near your phone’s earpiece that turns off the screen when you’re on a call.
 Known Issues 
Some phones keep the CPU running while listening to the proximity sensor and this drains battery (blame your phone, not me). Most phones don’t, so battery use is minimal.
 Accessibility Services 
▸ Purpose: Starting with Android 9, WaveUp utilizes the Accessibility Services API to allow users to switch off the screen.
▸ Privacy and Security: WaveUp uses the Accessibility Services API exclusively for this purpose and only if the 'lock' option is enabled. No personal data is collected, stored, or shared through this service.
▸ Permission Scope: The Accessibility Services permission is strictly used for enabling the screen lock feature. It does not monitor or interact with any other aspect of device usage.
 Permissions (yep, quite a few)
▸ WAKE_LOCK – turn on the screen
▸ RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED – auto-start on boot
▸ READ_PHONE_STATE – pause during calls
▸ BLUETOOTH / CONNECT – avoid pausing when on a Bluetooth call
▸ IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS etc. – stay alive in the background
▸ FORCE_LOCK – lock device (Android 8 and below)
▸ ACCESSIBILITY_SERVICE – lock device (Android 9+)
▸ DELETE_PACKAGES – let the app uninstall itself if needed
 Uninstalling (Android 8 and older) 
WaveUp uses Device Admin permissions, so it won’t uninstall the usual way. Use the 'Uninstall WaveUp' button in the app to remove it properly.
 Fun fact 
This is my first Android app and my first open-source contribution! I'd love your feedback or help—especially if you're into translations or just enjoy tinkering.
 Open source rocks! 
 Translations 
Help translate WaveUp! Even the English version could use improvements.
https://explore.transifex.com/juanitobananas/waveup/
https://explore.transifex.com/juanitobananas/libcommon/
 Acknowledgments 
Thanks to all who contributed: https://gitlab.com/juanitobananas/wave-up/#acknowledgments

fdroid:humer.uvc_camera.name: UVC Camera / Usb Camera custom
fdroid:humer.uvc_camera.summary: App for using a video camera over usb from userspace.
fdroid:humer.uvc_camera.description:
Android-UVC-Camera
The app connects to a usb camera from your Android Device. (OTG cabel or OTG Hub needed)
This Project was built to perform an Isochronous Video Stream for all Android Devices (Above 4.1 Ice Cream Sandwich)(Mediathek Devices too) with UVC Cameras.
The program uses your userspacr usb device driver to perform an isochronous transfer with your camera device.
Follow this way to set up your own userspace device driver:
First you have to set up all camera settings for your device. The program then saves the values and you can restore them later or overwrite them with other values. Use the "Edit/Save/Restore" Button to adjust the values.
Use the automatic camera serarch to find and set up the camera.
Explaination:
When the automatic search succeeds, you first set up the MAXIMAL PACKET SIZE. If your device is a mediathek device, you may have to lower the value for the max packet size.
The Value PACKETS PER REQUEST defines the Number of the Packets sended to the device: One packet has a size of 3000 bytes and you use 16 packets at one time for sending. Here you define the amount of Bytes which were sent.
Next thing are the USB REQUEST BLOCKS (activeUrb): These are in relation to the max packet size. You have to find here the right values for your device and control the output on the screen under the menupoint "Isoread".
Some typically values for Qualcom Devices are: 8 for the activeUrbs and 16 Packets per Request....
The first thing of the method Isoread is a Controltransfer to the camera device:
If the controlltransfer is successful, than you are ready to go.
Next take a look at the frames.
When you receive identically and long frames, you can proceed to the method Isostream, where the frames were displayed on your screen.
To know how big be a Frame should be, you can look at the output of the controll transfer of the camera in the log: maxVideoFrameSize, This value is returned from the camera and should be the valid frame size (The value is calculated by Imagewidth x Imagehight x 2).
The IsochronousRead1 class shows you how the frames are structered by the camera. Different camerasetting == Different Frame structers. Try it out with different setting and look at the output. The eof hint shows the framesize in the log. For valid camera settings the size should be the same as maxFrameSize value of the controlltransfer.
Output method Isoread: (Controltransfer) Thirst the program will send a controlltransfer to your camera device. The output of it looks as following: Initial streaming parms: hint=0x0 format=1 frame=1 frameInterval=2000000 keyFrameRate=0 pFrameRate=0 compQuality=0 compWindowSize=0 delay=0 maxVideoFrameSize=0 maxPayloadTransferSize=0 Probed streaming parms: hint=0x0 format=1 frame=1 frameInterval=2000000 keyFrameRate=0 pFrameRate=0 compQuality=0 compWindowSize=0 delay=0 maxVideoFrameSize=614400 maxPayloadTransferSize=3000 Final streaming parms: hint=0x0 format=1 frame=1 frameInterval=2000000 keyFrameRate=0 pFrameRate=0 compQuality=0 compWindowSize=0 delay=0 maxVideoFrameSize=614400 maxPayloadTransferSize=3000 The first line are the values you set in the program, to connect the camera. fdroid:org.p1graph.pitchvis.name: PitchVis

fdroid:org.p1graph.pitchvis.description:
PitchVis listens to your microphone and turns the musical pitches it hears into a colorful, real-time visualization.
Under the hood it runs a Variable-Q Transform (VQT) over the live audio signal, which gives high frequency resolution in the low registers where music lives, then detects the prominent pitches and maps each one to a color. The result is an animated picture of the harmony, melody and tuning of whatever you play or sing. It is displayed in a spiral, 12 pitches per octave, one octave per spiral rotation.
Features:
* Real-time pitch analysis of live microphone input
* Variable-Q Transform tuned for musical signals (especially choir singing)
* Pitch-to-color mapping in a perceptual color space
* Several visual modes (Full, Zen, Performance, Galaxy)
* Tuning drift display in cents
* Runs fully offline
PitchVis is useful for musicians, singers, music students and anyone curious about the structure of the sounds around them. It works with any instrument or voice.
PitchVis works fully offline and never connects to the internet. It uses the microphone permission for normal operation; the notification and foreground-service permissions are used only by an optional advanced mode that analyzes audio played by the device itself — audio only, never screen content.

apple-macos:6791324759.name: Blank Browser
apple-macos:6791324759.description:
The web should work for you.
Blank Browser is a modern web browser built for people who value speed, privacy, and control without sacrificing the browsing experience they expect. Whether you’re reading the news, shopping online, researching a topic, or managing your daily workflow, Blank Browser gives you the tools to browse the way you want.
Choose between Standard Browsing and Private Browsing at any time. Standard Browsing saves your history, cookies, passwords, and website preferences for a familiar experience. Private Browsing uses an isolated browsing session that leaves no lasting website data behind when you’re finished. Switching between modes is quick and seamless.
Take control of online distractions with a powerful built-in content blocker. Block ads, trackers, unwanted domains, and other web content to create a cleaner browsing experience. Import public filter lists, create your own blocklists and whitelists, build wildcard or regular expression rules, and customize exactly how websites behave. Your browsing experience is yours to control.
Blank Browser also helps you better understand the websites you visit. View detailed page information including SSL certificate details, cookies, downloads, permissions, connection information, observed technologies, and other useful insights. Everything is presented in a clear and accessible way, making advanced information available without requiring technical expertise.
Your passwords remain protected with the built-in Password Manager. Credentials are securely stored using Apple’s Keychain, with an optional PIN available for an additional layer of protection before viewing or editing saved logins.
Additional features include:
• Built-in ad and tracker blocking
• Custom blocklists and whitelists
• Import public filter lists
• Regular expression and wildcard filtering
• Per-site permissions
• Popup blocking
• Mobile and desktop website switching
• Download manager
• Favorites manager
• Detailed page information
• Browsing statistics
• Modern tab management
• Password Manager with optional PIN protection
• Support for iPhone, iPad, and Mac
Unlike many browsers, Blank Browser does not require you to create an account before you can browse the web. There are no mandatory sign-ins or unnecessary barriers between you and the internet.
Blank Browser is actively developed with regular updates focused on website compatibility, browsing performance, stability, privacy improvements, and new features. Every update is designed to make browsing faster, more reliable, and more enjoyable while keeping you in control of your experience.

apple-macos:1616146386.name: Effekt | Wallpaper Art Creator
apple-macos:1616146386.description:
Effekt is a powerful mix between an image editor and a visual toy that generates artwork in ultra high resolution.
The artwork is generated on the GPU, using compact and blazingly fast programs known as fragment shaders.
Packed with features
Despite being a one-screen app, it packs a load of visual effects, each with their own custom set of tools. 
All effects start off relatively simple, allowing the user to tweak the appearance to their liking, all while running smoothly at 120fps using Apple’s Metal framework. All changes are immediately reflected on the screen, creating an instant feedback loop and fast iteration.
The app comes with 30+ color schemes and a variety of image editing tools known from photography apps such as exposure, saturation, brightness and contrast, but also less common tools such as stair width, color buckets and kaleidoscope.
High resolution export
The app comes with a number of export formats for both video and still images, ranging from the generic 1080p, 4K and 8K as well as specific formats tailored to some of Apple's devices such as the Studio Display, the XDR Display and the Apple Watch.
All effects can be exported both as a still image and hi-res animated video up to 30s in 120fps. The hi-res still images are perfectly suitable for high quality poster prints with a resolution of up to 8000x8000 pixels.
Technology
Effekt has been under development for a long time and is built from scratch using Apple's latest rendering technologies in the Metal Framework, all using native Swift and no third-party graphics frameworks. The app itself contains only a few graphics assets, as all the art is generated in code on the GPU. 
This allows for a super lightweight app with a download size of just over 4mb.
Effekt is a visual toy and an image editor and helps you create stunning art in high quality.

flathub:io.github.coccinelle.coccinelle.name: Coccinelle
flathub:io.github.coccinelle.coccinelle.summary: Match and transform C code using semantic patches
flathub:io.github.coccinelle.coccinelle.description: Coccinelle is a program matching and transformation engine which provides the language SmPL (Semantic Patch Language) for specifying desired matches and transformations in C code. Coccinelle was initially targeted towards performing collateral evolutions in Linux. Such evolutions comprise the changes that are needed in client code in response to evolutions in library APIs, and may include modifications such as renaming a function, adding a function argument whose value is somehow context-dependent, and reorganizing a data structure. Beyond collateral evolutions, Coccinelle is successfully used (by us and others) for finding and fixing bugs in systems code.

flathub:io.github.saeugetier.photobooth.name: Photobooth
flathub:io.github.saeugetier.photobooth.description:
Photobooth is a touch-friendly, kiosk-style app for capturing photos. You will expect this features:
 Intuitive, touch-friendly user interface designed for kiosk use.
 Capture photos via a camera. USB camera (V4L2) and GPhoto2 cameras are supported.
 Create collage from captured photos. Collage templates are customizable (see documentation)
 Print single photos or collages
 View and reprint captures in a gallery
 Background removal via neural network or green screen.
 Selectable image filter effects

flathub:io.github.sigmasd.share.name: Share
flathub:io.github.sigmasd.share.description:
Share is a bidirectional file sharing application that works both ways — send files to others or receive files from them. It offers both a graphical interface (GTK) and a terminal-based CLI mode.
 Features:
 Bidirectional file transfer - both send and receive files
 No additional software required - just a QR code scanner and web browser
 Receive Mode - let others upload files directly to your device
 Directory uploads - upload/download entire folder structures
 Multiple file uploads - batch upload many files at once
 Share data from the clipboard, automatically detect if the clipboard contains an image, or a text, note that pasting files will only send paths as text (if the app doesn't have read permission), so its better to drop them instead
 CLI mode — run entirely from the terminal without a graphical interface, useful over SSH or on headless systems
 How it works:
 Creates a temporary HTTP server on your local network
 Generates QR codes for both sharing and receiving
 Sharing Mode: Others scan to download your files
 Receive Mode: Others scan to upload files to you via web interface
 All transfers happen locally over your network - no internet required
 Perfect for quick file transfers between devices, mobile-to-desktop uploads, collaborative work, or any situation where you need wireless file transfer without cloud services.

flathub:io.github.tomluchowski.OpenDunge.name: OpenDungeonsPlus
flathub:io.github.tomluchowski.OpenDunge.summary: manage Creatures and Dungeons in the style of Dungeon Keeper
flathub:io.github.tomluchowski.OpenDunge.description:
a better fork of Opendungeons : with enhanced editor and tile - geometry distortions
 Feel free to say what do you think about new Fog of War system --- please contact me via Discord.
 The up to now console commands are in the package cheats. For example to call command fps with argument 30 type cheats.fps(30)
 APRIL 2023: Now with build-in PYTHON support in game console
 FEBRUARY 2023: Improved Combat Pit a.k.a Arena
 JANUARY 2023: Now with improved prison chamber.
 NOTE: On some linux distros ( like OpenSuse) it might require the command " xhost +local: " as regular user to run, before the command "flatpak run io.github.tomluchowski.OpenDungeonsPlus" . The game REQUIRES the graphic option 'Separate Shading Objects' to be enabled.
 NOTE 2 : DO NOT mark dynamic shadows options as this is a future feature and won't work anywhere, it would only crash the game.
 OpenDungeons is an open source, real time strategy game sharing game elements with the Dungeon Keeper series and Evil Genius. Players build an underground dungeon which is inhabited by creatures. Players fight each other for control of the underground by indirectly commanding their creatures, directly casting spells in combat, and luring enemies into sinister traps.

flathub:io.itch.keyikedalube_ndang.Type-.name: Type Off
flathub:io.itch.keyikedalube_ndang.Type-.summary: A short 6 min typing speed game
flathub:io.itch.keyikedalube_ndang.Type-.description:
A short 6 min typing speed game.
 Random characters pop up from the left side and move toward the right side of the screen. You lose a life if any character disappears after hitting the right edge. Moreover, you only have three lives. No respawn.
 Can you make it to the end?

flathub:net.mediaarea.BWFMetaEdit.name: BWF MetaEdit
flathub:net.mediaarea.BWFMetaEdit.summary: Embed, validate, and export BWF files metadata
flathub:net.mediaarea.BWFMetaEdit.description:
BWF MetaEdit is a tool that supports embedding, validating, and exporting of metadata in Broadcast WAVE Format (BWF) files. It supports the FADGI Broadcast WAVE Metadata Embedding Guidelines.
 Initially funded by the Library of Congress and FADGI (Federal Agencies Digital Guidelines Initiative); previously developed by MediaArea and led by AVPreserve; currently developed and led by MediaArea. MediaArea provides support and binaries for all platforms.

flathub:one.naiara.Kuychi.name: K’uychi
flathub:one.naiara.Kuychi.summary: Generate color palettes with all their shades and copy their hex codes
flathub:one.naiara.Kuychi.description:
K’uychi is a simple utility for generating color palettes. By selecting a base color, it
 automatically creates a consistent scale of lighter and darker shades using the OKLab color
 space, ensuring perceptual uniformity.
 Designed for developers and designers, K’uychi simplifies the task of finding the right tone
 for your interface. You can copy the hexadecimal value of any generated shade with a single
 click, ready to use in CSS or your preferred design tool.
 Built with Libadwaita, the application integrates seamlessly with the GNOME desktop. The name
 "K’uychi" comes from the Quechua word for "rainbow".

flathub:org.megamek.MegaMek.name: MegaMek
flathub:org.megamek.MegaMek.description:
MegaMek is a Java version of BattleTech that you can play with your friends over the internet.
 All rules from Total Warfare are implemented. Rules from Tactical Operations and Strategic
 Operations are constantly in the works, and many of those rules and weapons are already implemented.
 Players can create their own units, maps, and scenarios for use with MegaMek. MegaMek supports all unit types,
 from infantry, BattleMek, and vehicles, to Aerospace fighters, DropShips, and warships. Ground battles as well
 as space battles can be played.

Among its crowning characteristics, it conveys a dynamic and varied rhythm which facilitates the reading of long texts. Also, it provides freshness to the page while referring to the calligraphic letter, not as a literal interpretation, but rather in a contemporary typographic language. The italic has just as much care and attention to detail in the design as the roman. The bold weights are strong, and the Black weights are really experimental for the genre. Not only does Alegreya provide great performance, but also achieves a strong and harmonious text by means of elements designed in an atmosphere of diversity. Alegreya was chosen as one of 53 “Fonts of the Decade” at the ATypI Letter2 competition in September 2011, and one of the top 14 text type systems. firefox-addons:3040161.name: AWS Security Agent Recorder
firefox-addons:3040161.summary: Record the target domain and accessible URLs your web app contacts for AWS Security Agent setup.
firefox-addons:3040161.description:
AWS Security Agent (now part of AWS Continuum) is a frontier agent that proactively secures your applications throughout the development lifecycle across all your environments. It performs on-demand penetration testing customized to your application, discovering and reporting verified security risks. 
 What it does 
When you start a recording session in the active tab:
- The extension captures the tab's origin as the target URL.
- It reloads the tab and watches every HTTP request it makes.
- Every other unique origin the page contacts is added to a list of accessible URLs.
- A pastel purple/blue border around the page reminds you a session is active.
- On AWS Security Agent's "create" pages, focusing a Target URL, Accessible URLs, or Out-of-scope URLs field shows a panel with the recorded values. Select one to fill the field. Filled entries get a green check, excluded entries get a red x.
The popup shows the target URL, the running list of accessible URLs, and buttons to Start, Stop, Copy all, and Clear. All data lives in storage.local and never leaves your browser.
 Use 
To use the extension, follow the steps below.
 Open the page you want to record.
 Choose the extension icon to open the popup.
 Choose Start recording . The page reloads and a pastel border appears around it.
 Use the app normally: navigate, log in, exercise the features you want covered. Each new origin shows up in the popup list.
 Choose Stop recording when you're done. The border disappears.
 Follow the steps on Create a penetration test . Focus the Target URL field and pick the recorded value from the panel; do the same for Accessible URLs and Out-of-scope URLs.

firefox-addons:2632912.name: SoundCloud Downloader
firefox-addons:2632912.summary: Directly download tracks on soundcloud.com. Creates metadata tags for Title, Artists, Album & Artwork. Allows to block reposts in your Stream feed and more.
firefox-addons:2632912.description:
This Add-on allows you to easily download tracks off of SoundCloud, by the press of a button. Unlike other Add-ons, this does not use any 3rd party services to perform the download - only SoundCloud's own APIs. No links or redirects to sketchy sites needed!
When you hit 'Download', we will set the appropriate metadata information: Title, Artists, Album and Artwork. If the track is downloaded as part of an album, we will also set the track number.
If you are a Go+ user, we will download the higher quality version (.m4a file) for you. 
As an added bonus, this Add-On also allows you to block reposts/playlists in your 'Stream' feed, so you don't miss out on actual new songs from artists you follow!

bluejetty:00018979:ios.description:
The Fairytale Kingdom created by Mother Goose experiences great trouble. King Cole cancelled Christmas and raised the taxes, leaving the residents without any chance of celebrating, playing hide & seek games and buying presents. On top of that, Mother Goose went missing! Humpty-Dumpty invites you into a breathtaking quest to solve many hidden object games and travel through the Fairytale Kingdom, where you’ll meet a lot of characters from Mother Goose’s rhymes – the Crooked Man, Diddle Cat, Jack and Jill. Make the merry King Cole kind again and save Christmas in this festive game with search & find games! Moreover, stop the hungry Baker Tommy from eating up all the Christmas supplies in the Bonus Chapter!
· TRAVEL THROUGH THE FAIRYTALE KINGDOM FULL OF MAGIC!
Humpty-Dumpty is taking you to a breathtaking adventure around the Fairytale World created of Mother Goose’s rhymes! Explore the unique world of fantasy and help the local residents return Christmas by playing hidden objects games!
· SOLVE FESTIVE PUZZLES!
As you’re travelling through the Fairytale Land full of magic, play finding games and solve festive and merry Christmas games! 
· RETURN CHRISTMAS BEFORE IT’S TOO LATE!
Will you be able to find hidden objects in picture to make King Cole kind and merry again just before the clock strikes 12 at Christmas Eve?
· MEET YOUR FAVORITE CHARACTERS FROM MOTHER GOOSE’S RHYMES!
Your friends will always help you cope with challenging task and intriguing hidden pictures! 
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.
-----

Visit our website to search and find hidden object games: http://dominigames.com
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00121380:ios.description:
The gnome princess has finally come home. She managed to make peace with the trolls and befriend their queen, but at home evil was afoot: a warlock collector stole the gnome monarch’s castle along with the royal family! The princess must gather a team and set off on a new adventure to save her loved ones!
Set off with her through uncharted lands full of mystery and unbelievable creatures in the exciting casual fantasy/strategy game Gnomes Garden 3.
Lots of different objectives, more than 40 levels, a fun plot, simple and engrossing gameplay, and new game elements: all this and more awaits in a special magical world. Manage resources and building construction, plant magic giant trees, and fight against the dastardly warlock and his mass of followers. Simple gameplay and concise insructions will help you dive right in. Just don’t forget about the princess’ immense magical power if you get stuck!
Gnomes Garden 3 — track the evil warlock to the Grey Wastelands!
- An extraordinary magical world whose source of magic is ancient gardens. 
- An upbeat plot, colorful comics and charming characters!
- A multitude of varied quests and new gameplay elements.
- Colorful trophies.
- Over 40 unique levels.
- Unusual enemies: sentient plants, gremlins, stone dormice and... krakens.
- Make any purchase - turn off ads! 
- Useful bonuses: speed up work, stop time, run fast. 
- Simple controls and a well-designed tutorial..
- Over 20 hours of exciting gameplay for all ages.
- Pleasant themed music.

bluejetty:00179199:ios.name: Migros – Einkaufen & Sparen
bluejetty:00179199:ios.summary: The digital shopping assistant gives you all the advantages of Migros in the palm of your hand at all times, wherever you are. Find out about the latest special offers and new products at your local Migros store from the comfort of your hom
bluejetty:00179199:ios.description:
The digital shopping assistant gives you all the advantages of Migros in the palm of your hand at all times, wherever you are. Find out about the latest special offers and new products at your local Migros store from the comfort of your home and let yourself be inspired by thousands of recipes. Simply order online and have your purchase delivered to your door. Or shop with subitoGo in-store – no waiting at the checkout. The shopping list allows you to plan your shopping on the go. Instore or online: redeem your Cumulus coupons and vouchers, earn points with your Cumulus Card and collect digital stamps. It’s all on the Migros app. Download it today and benefit immediately! 
• Special offers, new products and the regular product range 
Now you’ll never miss unbeatable special offers or attractive new products. That’s because push notifications always keep you up to date with the latest offers. The Migros app also informs you about which products are currently available at which Migros store. 
Shop online 
You can complete your entire shopping online via the “Order” tab. Simply place the desired products in the shopping cart, choose your delivery date - done. We deliver your purchase on time to your home or to the address of your choice. 
• Shopping lists 
Is there something missing in your fridge or cupboard? Your shopping list knows the answer. It simplifies your shopping planning and is intuitive to use. Especially practical: Lists can be shared with family, friends and colleagues and worked on together. 
• Recipes 
Be inspired by thousands of Migusto recipes for your shopping planning, save your favourite recipes in the app and add ingredients directly to your shopping list. 
• The Cumulus card 
Earn points, save money and enjoy experiences. The Migros app allows you to present your Cumulus card in digital form – either on the app or via the widget. Cumulus points are automatically credited to your account. The current balance can be viewed in the Migros app at any time. 
• Coupons and digital Cumulus vouchers 
Put an end to all those bits of paper in your wallet! That’s because all of the coupons and Cumulus vouchers are available digitally in the Migros app and are thus ready to use whenever you go shopping. Simply activate in advance and benefit automatically at the checkout or when you order online. 
• Collect stamps and get premiums 
New stamp cards are constantly being added to the Wallet section in the Migros app. This way, you can automatically collect stamps when you buy the respective products and exchange them later for exciting rewards. 
• subitoGo 
Scan, pay, done. With subitoGo, you can do your shopping directly from your mobile phone. Simply scan your products, pay using the app and leave the store - without having to wait in line. 
• Digital receipts 
What did you buy when? Get an overview! The Migros app saves all of your till receipts from recent months. This means that time-consuming filing is no longer necessary. 
• Competitions and campaigns 
You simply can’t lose with the Migros app, because you’ll never miss a competition or promotion ever again! Secure yourself great prizes, like gift cards, new products to test, trips and much more. Simply take part via the app and with a bit of luck, you could be one of the winners!

bluejetty:00032304:ios.description:
When you download the Queen Warriors TV App, get ready for a life changing transformation! Queen Warriors is a tight knit community of fierce, beautiful and strong women! We have 3 main priorities we focus on to help everyday women look and feel their best: Fitness. Mindset. Lifestyle.
Queen Warrior Live Workouts Every Week:
Celebrity Fitness Trainer Fabiana Ferrarini created the full body Queen Warrior HIIT Workouts especially for women with an emphasis on the glutes, quads, hamstrings, and core + positive mindset building. Fabiana and her team of Queen Warriors Instructors will lead you in LIVE workouts every week from the comfort of your home. LIVE workouts are incredible because you have the ability to chat live with the instructors and leave messages for the other Queen Warriors in between sets!
If you can’t make the LIVE workout, a replay of the same workout will be available exclusively to Queen Warriors members. Replays are available 24/7, so you can tune in at any time that works for you.
EXTRA BENEFITS:
Along with our core HIIT + POWER strength training live workouts, you will also receive access to a variety of our special classes such as:
Barre, Dance, Kettlebell, Glute Camps, Stretch + more! If you’re looking for workout classes that are FUN but always make you sweat and sculpt, make sure to tune into one of these so you can be on your way to getting fit and feeling fabulous!
Mindset Coaching with Jennifer:
Queen Warrior Mindset coaching with Jennifer Zoga will give Queen Warriors vital tools to develop a healthy self identity, more confidence, increased self-esteem, self love, motivation, and ultimately everything needed to help create life changing habits! Jennifer has been a life coach for 7 years with a strong focus on helping women feel happy and confident to face their journeys, past, and present, with an optimistic outlook.
Daily Affirmations with Jennifer Zoga:
Let’s start your day off to a powerfully positive start! Join Jennifer Zoga for a short yet super sweet daily affirmation session to get your self-love juices flowing and those feel-good vibes going!
As a Queen Warrior, you get access to both live classes and replays.
+Already a member? Sign-in to access your subscription.
+New? Subscribe in the app to get instant access.
Queen Warriors offers an auto-renewing Monthly/Annual Subscription. You’ll receive unlimited access to content on all your devices. Payment is charged to your ID account at confirmation of purchase. Pricing varies by location and it is confirmed prior to purchase. The subscription automatically renews each month unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can cancel anytime in Account Settings.
For more information, please visit:
Terms and Conditions: https://www.queenwarriors.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.queenwarriors.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00184579:ios.description:
UNIVERSO Now es el mejor sitio para ponerse al corriente con las últimas temporadas de sus programas favoritos de UNIVERSO, vea televisión en vivo y reprodúzcala donde sea. Descargue la aplicación de UNIVERSO ahora para ver episodios completos de The Riveras, Larrymania, WWE, I Love Jenni, Quien da Más, ¡Y MUCHO MÁS!
Empiece entrando a la cuenta de su subscripción de servicio televisivo (de cable, satélite o digital). La aplicación de Telemundo cuenta con la mayoría de los proveedores de servicio televisivo, entre ellos DirecTV, Dish, Spectrum, Xfinity y AT&T. Si no cuenta con una subscripción de televisión de pago todavía podrá ver hasta 3 episodios completos de su elección durante un mes.
CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA APLICACIÓN:
• Acceda a la aplicación mediante su subscripción de servicio televisivo para ver episodios completos de sus programas favoritos de UNIVERSO.
• ¿No cuenta con una subscripción a algún servicio televisivo? Vea hasta 3 episodios completos de su elección durante un mes sin necesidad de registrarse.
• ¡Reproduzca episodios nuevos transmitidos en vivo usando la aplicación!
• ¡Compatible con Chromecast y AirPlay! Empiece a reproducir episodios en la aplicación y transmítalos a su televisión.
• ¿No puede terminar de ver un episodio en una sola sesión? ¡La aplicación asigna un marcador para que reanude la reproducción después! 
• Guarde sus programas favoritos en su Lista con acceso rápido a los episodios más recientes.
¿COMENTARIOS O PREGUNTAS?
Por favor escriba a support@nbctve.zendesk.com para pedir mayor asistencia. 
¿Tiene problemas accediendo la cuenta de su subscripción de servicio televisivo? Visite http://ayuda.telemundo.com para más información.
¿Le gusta lo que ve? Explore las otras aplicaciones de NBCUniversal para reproducción de contenido, entre ellas Telemundo, Telemundo Deportes, NBC, NBC Sports, y Bravo.
Importante: La aplicación solo puede usarse en los Estados Unidos y sus territorios. Es posible acceder al contenido de video a través de 4G, LTE y redes Wi-Fi. Podrían aplicar cargos por datos.
Política de Privacidad: https://www.nbcuniversal.com/privacy?brandA=Universo&intake=Universo
Opciones de Privacidad: https://www.nbcuniversal.com/privacy/notrtoo?brandA=Universo&intake=Universo
CA Notice: https://www.nbcuniversal.com/privacy/california-consumer-privacy-act?intake=Universo
* Esta aplicación cuenta con software de medición de propiedad de Nielsen que les permitirá contribuir a la investigación de mercado, como en las valoraciones televisivas de Nielsen.
* Para saber más sobre nuestros productos de medición digital y sus elecciones con respecto a ellos, por favor visite http://www.nielsen.com/digitalprivacy para mayor información.

bluejetty:00036930:ios.description:
Ready to unleash your inner racer and conquer every track? 
Buckle up, rev your engines, and take over the streets in this adrenaline-pumping racing game! Only the bravest and most skilled racers will rise to the top of the leaderboard. Test your limits and showcase your racing prowess!
Choose your speedy monster
Whether you are into sleek sports cars, rugged off-roaders, or massive trucks, you will find what you need. Each vehicle type offers unique handling and features, making every race an epic experience. Expand your arsenal by purchasing new vehicles from the shop. Pick the car that best suits your racing style and dominate the tracks.
Enhance cars with tuning and upgrades
Use our extensive customization options to transform your car into a super-fast beast. Upgrade your engine, tweak your suspension, equip cutting-edge tech, and install a nitro system for explosive bursts of acceleration. Each modification will help your car meet the demands of various tracks and racing conditions, allowing you to stay ahead of the other racers.
Master the most challenging raceways
Race through a variety of winding tracks, each with its own unique set of obstacles and thrills. From city streets to desert trails, each track offers incredible challenges and stunning visuals. Perfect your drifting skills to handle sharp turns, unpredictable terrain, or high-speed nitro zones. Master these tracks and make your competitors swallow the dust from under your wheels!
Become the best racer
Create your dream machine, crush the competition, and boost your scores to unlock new racing tracks, modes, and cars. Climb the ranks and show the world what you are made of. Dive into intense races where only the strongest wins. 
Each trophy you earn marks a milestone on your journey to becoming a racing legend.
Are you ready to start the engine and feel the adrenaline? Then go ahead and burn some rubber!
SUBSCRIPTION
Subscribe and get right now without limits:
1. Free daily refuel
2. 20% upgrade discount
3. One extra reward per open
4. Access to trucks
5. One daily free crate
6. Only rewarded ads
Make your life easier with premium access:
- Check out its benefits by getting a free 3-day trial period. After 3 days, the trial period will automatically switch to a weekly paid subscription. 
- The paid subscription is divided into the 2 types: weekly and annual. 
- The cost of a weekly paid subscription is $ 9.99. Annual - $ 49.99.
- The amount will be debited from your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase. 
- You can cancel your subscription or trial period at any time, but no later than 24 hours before the end of the current period. OTHERWISE, it will be automatically renewed. 
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
- After payment, you can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your account settings. 
- Any unused portion of the free period will be canceled after purchasing the subscription. 
- Read our privacy policy https://pixelvoidgames.com/policy.html .
And the EULA https://pixelvoidgames.com/terms_of_use.html .

Join Snoopy, Charlie Brown and the Peanuts gang for a cheerful Christmas countdown. Enjoy 25 days full of holiday countdown games, puzzles, trivia and festive surprises when you download the 2026 Peanuts Digital Advent Calendar.
EVERYTHING YOU’LL FIND IN THE 2026 PEANUTS ADVENT CALENDAR:
• 25 Animated Comic Strips: Start each day with a new, animated comic strip reimagined just for the holidays.
• Christmas Family Games Everyone Can Enjoy: Built for players of all ages, enjoy Christmas card games like Solitaire, Mahjong, jigsaw puzzles, trivia and more for the whole family.
• Peanuts-Themed Activities: Enjoy festive activities like snowflake making, decorating trees, Christmas cookies and more with a Peanuts twist! 
• Personalized Experience: Make the virtual Peanuts Advent world your own by customizing your Peanuts-themed home and trimming the tree as you countdown to Christmas.
• Holiday Fun with the Peanuts Gang: Explore the virtual Peanuts world through heartwarming scenes and activities. 
• Meaningful Connections: Create and send digital Peanuts holiday greeting cards to friends and family.
Let our Peanuts Advent Calendar bring joy, laughter and festive cheer to your holiday season.
DOWNLOAD THE APP NOW
Get your daily dose of holiday joy with the Peanuts gang. Download the Peanuts Advent Calendar app for your device today and start your countdown to Christmas.
WHAT IS THE PEANUTS ADVENT CALENDAR?
The Peanuts Advent Calendar is a new way to experience the Christmas season. It's a digital experience unlike any other! It brings the magic of the Christmas countdown calendar into homes through stunning animations, holiday countdown games and interactive activities. Not to mention, you get to play alongside the Peanuts gang.
Each day of the Christmas countdown begins with a favorite holiday comic strip, delivered right to your digital door. Take a tour of the Peanuts world, unlock daily calendar games — from Christmas puzzles to trivia games — and activities, even decorate your own home. Every day brings something new.
Unlike traditional advent calendars, this digital version provides an interactive and customizable experience. It blends the beloved Peanuts comic strip with modern technology and interactive Christmas games for the whole family. Users can enjoy these activities on their computer, tablet or mobile device. Buy it for yourself and send it to others. It makes a perfect holiday gift for people of all ages.

bluejetty:00069491:ios.description:
Found a bug and wondering what it is? Point your camera at it or pick a photo from your library, and get its name, whether it's dangerous, and everything worth knowing about it.
 WHAT YOU GET WITH EVERY SCAN:
 • Common and scientific name, with a match score
 • Pest or friend? Its effect on your plants, and how to control it if it's a pest
 • How to tell it apart from lookalikes
 • Life cycle from egg to adult
 • What it eats and what eats it
 • Size, colors, habitat, lifespan and where in the world it lives
 • Where and when to find it, with observation tips
 • Answers to common questions, plus fun facts
 • Reference photos to compare with yours
 INSECTS, SPIDERS AND MORE:
Butterflies and moths, beetles and ladybugs, bees, wasps and ants, spiders, ticks and scorpions, flies and mosquitoes, cockroaches and termites, caterpillars, grasshoppers, dragonflies and more.
 HOW IT WORKS:
Take a photo with the camera or choose one from your library. The app identifies it and saves the result to your history, so you can come back to it anytime. Save favorites to My Collection and search past scans by name. Works on iPhone and iPad.
 PRO SUBSCRIPTION:
Identifying insects requires a Pro subscription. Prices and billing periods are shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://insect-scanner-web-production.up.railway.app/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://insect-scanner-web-production.up.railway.app/terms/

bluejetty:00166019:ios.description:
Blinkit is India’s last minute app. Trusted by millions, it is your everyday online grocery shopping app that home-delivers 30,000+ daily groceries. Buy milk products, fresh fruits & vegetables, daily grocery, kitchen, home & office items by shopping for them online on Blinkit. Enjoy an easy and smooth app experience with doorstep delivery.
- Best price and quality fresh fruits & vegetables
- Milk, curd, bread, butter, eggs, cheese, paneer & other daily grocery
- Snacks, biscuits, chips, ice cream, chocolates
- Cold drinks, ice, bottle opener
- Atta, rice, dal, oil, masalas, noodles
- Personal care, detergent, cleaning supplies
- Diapers & baby care
- Pet food
- Bulbs, batteries, mobile chargers
- Emergency medicines, thermometer
- Kitchen tools like chopper, blender, grinder
- Puja needs
- Stationery
- Smart watches, LED lights, Headphones
Beauty & skincare store
Makeup, luxury beauty brands & everyday skincare – now on Blinkit! Shop a huge range of authentic makeup, bath & body, hair care products, beauty accessories & much more!
Electronics store
Wireless or bluetooth earphones? Check. Smart watches? Yes. LED lights? Absolutely! Shop affordable and latest electronics online at best prices, only on Blinkit.
Safe and on time grocery delivery app
The average driving speed for Blinkit (formerly Grofers) delivery agents is 20kmph, since we have a grocery delivery store located every 2 km to serve you.
Many safe payment options
Do your grocery shopping online on Blinkit & pay safely and securely for your groceries with UPI, COD or cards / wallets / netbanking / buy now pay later. We accept Sodexo meal pass and Paytm food wallet too.
Authentic phone accessories
We don’t want you to wait for the most premium and authentic phone accessories out there – which is why you can get them delivered at your doorstep.
Printouts delivered at your doorstep
With Blinkit, you can get a printout of anything delivered at your doorstep. With convenient options of both black & white and coloured prints, get all your documents sorted.
Low prices, amazing offers
Blinkit (formerly Grofers) offers you big discounts and savings on daily grocery, bundles and bank offers. We give the best prices on online groceries with our monthly House Full Sale!
Live order tracking & helpful customer support
Track your grocery order online, right from your payment being confirmed to the delivery of your groceries. In case you need help, simply tap & chat with our customer support executives who are always ready to assist you.
Delivering groceries in 20+ cities
Do your grocery shopping online! Get delivery of milk, vegetables, bread, snacks & more on the Blinkit app in Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Chandigarh, Chennai, Delhi, Faridabad, Gurgaon, Hyderabad, Jaipur, Jalandhar, Kanpur, Kolkata, Lucknow, Ludhiana, Meerut, Mohali, Mumbai, Panchkula, Pune, Noida, Ghaziabad, Vadodara & Zirakpur.
Huge variety of local & international brands
Blinkit (formerly Grofers) grocery delivery app has a huge variety of shopping brands available online, including local specialities. In fact, Blinkit has brands you won’t find anywhere else. You can get delivery of daily grocery, festival special products, and even gourmet and international foods! Get the latest products from leading brands like boAt, The Wishing Chair, Ekam, MasterChow, The Body Shop, Farmley, Engage, The Whole Truth, The Moms Co, SuperBottoms, Tropicana, Nestle, Coca Cola, Lay’s, Harvest, Ferrero, Toblerone, Oreo, Nutella, Starbucks, Clinique, Kama Ayurveda, L’Occitane, Innisfree, Davidoff, Rage Coffee, Lindt, Blue Tokai, Sleepy Owl, Wingreens Farms, Bagrry’s, Gunsberg, Jade Forest, Jimmy’s Cocktails, Eveready, Nivea, Garnier, Lakmé, Haldiram’s, Bikano, Heinz, Vadham, Dettol, Cadbury, ITC, Colgate Palmolive, PepsiCo, Durex, Licious, Aashirvaad, Saffola, Patanjali, Fortune, 24 Mantra, TGL Co, Nestle, Amul, Dabur, & many more.

bluejetty:00018316:ios.description:
State Bank Spencer is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with State Bank Spencer:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the SBS Banking app, you must be enrolled as a State Bank Spencer Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00073385:ios.name: Zero: Fasting & Food Tracker
bluejetty:00073385:ios.summary: Zero is the all-in-one fasting tracker and nutrition app built for real results. Most fasting and weight loss apps stop at simply tracking fasts or calories. Zero connects the full picture — fasting, protein, meals, hydration, and habits —
bluejetty:00073385:ios.description:
Zero is the all-in-one fasting tracker and nutrition app built for real results. Most fasting and weight loss apps stop at simply tracking fasts or calories. Zero connects the full picture — fasting, protein, meals, hydration, and habits — so you actually change your body composition, not just your eating schedule.
Here’s how Zero helps you get there: 
• Track your intermittent fasting — Engage timers, streaks, and insights keep you stay motivated and consistent across your entire fasting journey.
• Log meals the smart way — Skip the tedious manual meal entry routine. With Zero Plus, snap a photo and get instant macros, protein composition, and clarity on how effectively your meals support your goals. Your first meal logs are on us, so you can try it before you subscribe.
• Hit your Protein Score — Zero Plus tracks a personalized daily protein target that adapts to your weight and goals. Better protein = better satiety, better muscle retention, better weight loss. Zero makes it automatic.
• Complete the equation: Fasting + Protein — Most people fast or track meals. Zero brings them together so you lose weight, protect muscle, and avoid the pressure and guilt of traditional calorie trackers.
• Stay hydrated to power your fasts — Water tracking with Zero Plus helps you maintain energy, reduce cravings, and support metabolic function throughout the day.
• Build healthy habits that actually matter — Track movement, sleep, mood, and other daily pillars that reinforce your fasting and fueling routine.
• Challenge yourself — Hit protein targets, maintain fasting streaks, and stay accountable with motivating challenges built around outcomes, not vanity metrics.
• Learn the real science — Understand how fasting, protein, and hydration work together for sustainable weight loss and metabolic health — with insights from leading experts.
• See measurable progress — Watch your streaks grow, your protein consistency rise, and your body composition improve with clean, insightful trend views.
Whether you’re starting out or optimizing an existing routine, Zero gives you the structure, guidance, and clarity most apps miss.
Zero is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult your doctor or qualified healthcare provider before making any changes to your diet, fasting routine, or health regimen.
Zero is free to download, with fasting timers, streaks, weekly trends, expert articles, and challenges included. Zero Plus is an optional subscription that unlocks photo meal logging and your Protein Score, water tracking, custom fasts and saved presets, Fat-Burning Mode, the mood journal and daily habit insights, premium articles and Plus-only challenges, and monthly, yearly, and correlated charts. A free trial is available.
Payment for Zero Plus will be charged to your Apple Account when you subscribe. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscription in your Account Settings.
Read more terms & conditions:
Terms of use: https://www.zerolongevity.com/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://www.zerolongevity.com/privacy-policy

Start putting you first — physically, mentally and emotionally. Improve your overall wellbeing and be happier through better self-esteem and less stress.

** TRACK YOUR MOOD ** 
Mood tracking is a technique in positive psychology that includes the tracking, recording, and analysis of a person’s mood. With that in mind, Tangerine not only helps you reflect on your days, but also realise what activities in your life make you happy or sad.

Journaling has become a hallmark of the self-care movement. It helps you prioritize and clarify thinking, but most importantly it gives you a boost in mindfulness, memory and communication skills. In addition to tracking your daily mood, on Tangerine you can write down your thoughts as they pop-up or leverage one of our guided journaling templates. 
** MEASURE YOUR PROGRESS WITH THE POWER OF DATA ** 
Get insights & stats on your routine and on how much you've evolved with elegant and comprehensive reports.
Tangerine integrates with the Health app in order to automatically complete health related habits.

bluejetty:00027075:ios.description:
Save links effortlessly. View them later, from anywhere, on all your devices. Sync, organize, and share your links—privately, without ever creating an account.
GoodLinks is a powerful bookmarking app with a sleek reading experience. Save the content of the link while eliminating the ads and other clutter.
Adding and viewing links is super simple and lightning fast. If you want to dig deeper, GoodLinks can be fully customized.
No account. No ads. No creepy spying. GoodLinks just works.
KEY FEATURES
• Universal App :: GoodLinks is a single app that works on all of your iOS and macOS devices, so you can access your articles anywhere.
• No Account :: Sync links, tags, and reading position without needing another web service account. iCloud Sync means all you have to do is install the app.
• Simple :: Save articles from anywhere with a powerful Share Sheet extension. GoodLinks is so easy it feels like part of the operating system.
• Readability :: Put the emphasis where it belongs—on the article you want to read. GoodLinks extracts the article text and removes web advertisements and other distractions to provide a wonderful reading experience. Pick the perfect font, spacing, and size.
• Highlight & Note :: Highlight important information within articles and add notes to them, making it easier for you to remember key passages.
• Organize :: Tame a large list with tags and starred articles, so you can always find what you need. You can also search based on title, author, and description.
• Actions :: Actions help you manage and share links. You can add article to Starred, share to other apps, export to PDF, plain text or Markdown... Build your own actions to export and share your saved links.
• Customize :: Adjust how your links and lists look, change swipe behavior, and more. Tailor GoodLinks to fit your style.
• Themes :: Switch between beautiful themes: Light and Sepia for light mode, Dark and Night for dark mode.
• Siri Shortcuts :: Deep support of iOS Shortcuts. Save a new link, query links, open a specific view, and more.
• Log in to Sites :: Log in to paywalled sites to get full access to their content.
• Widgets :: Get quick access to a list, or open a random unread link from your home screen.
• Summarization :: Get a summary of any article with Apple Intelligence or external LLM services using your own API keys.
• Archive :: The full rich text of each article gets saved in GoodLinks, and your reading history provides a natural archive if you need it. Save as many links as you want.
• Private :: Your reading history and favorite articles should only be private by default. GoodLinks doesn’t track you or your information, and nothing is shared online unless you choose to share it.
• VoiceOver :: GoodLinks is fully accessible via VoiceOver.
GOODLINKS PREMIUM
When you purchase GoodLinks today, you will get *permanent* access to all the current features, including any new ones released one year from your date of purchase. After your one year of feature upgrades is up, any new features introduced will require the GoodLinks Premium subscription to unlock. Once unlocked, those features are yours to keep *forever*, even if you choose to unsubscribe right after subscribing.

Privacy Policy: https://goodlinks.app/privacy/

bluejetty:00049164:android.description:
HB Wallet: Your Ultimate Ethereum Wallet for Multichain Asset Management
HB Wallet is a cutting-edge Ethereum wallet and multichain crypto wallet, designed for secure and efficient digital asset management across Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, Base, and all EVM-compatible blockchains. Whether you're a professional trader or a casual user, HB Wallet offers a streamlined, feature-rich experience for Ethereum wallet holders, ensuring seamless Web3 interaction.
Built-in Exchange: Swap Across Chains with Ease
The Built-in Exchange in HB Wallet allows users to swap tokens effortlessly between Ethereum wallets and other blockchain networks, including both EVM and non-EVM chains. For example, users can exchange SPX on Ethereum for MOODENG on Solana directly within the app at the best available rates. This cross-chain functionality removes trading barriers and simplifies Ethereum wallet transactions while minimizing fees.
Expand Your Ethereum Wallet with Custom RPC Networks
HB Wallet enhances Ethereum wallet flexibility by allowing users to add custom RPC networks instantly. Whether you're looking to explore Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, or Optimism, HB Wallet supports a true multichain ecosystem, offering both pre-configured options and manual custom RPC inputs for seamless blockchain integration.
Effortless NFT Management in Your Ethereum Wallet
HB Wallet isn't just an Ethereum wallet—it's also a powerful NFT hub. Users can store, view, and trade NFTs across multiple blockchains, including Ethereum, Solana, and Base. With HB Wallet's integrated NFT features, managing your digital collectibles is as simple as handling your Ethereum wallet tokens.
Send and Receive Crypto with Your Ethereum Wallet
Easily manage your Ethereum wallet assets alongside Bitcoin (BTC), Solana (SOL), Avalanche (AVAX), and more. HB Wallet simplifies transactions with Unstoppable Domains, enabling users to send and receive cryptocurrency using human-readable crypto domains instead of long, complex blockchain addresses. This feature ensures smooth, user-friendly transactions across Ethereum wallets and other supported chains.
Enhanced Security: Protect Your Ethereum Wallet with NFC Keycard
Security is a priority for Ethereum wallet users, and HB Wallet offers an additional layer of protection with its NFC Keycard feature. This Ethereum wallet security feature allows users to extract account authorization onto an NTAG215 NFC card, ensuring that every transaction requires physical authentication. Even if your phone is lost, your Ethereum wallet and digital assets remain safe.
Your Reliable Ethereum Wallet for Web3 and DeFi
As a next-generation Ethereum wallet, HB Wallet seamlessly connects to dApps and DeFi platforms via WalletConnect. bluejetty:00168515:ios.name: Return to Monkey Island+
bluejetty:00168515:ios.summary: Return to Monkey Island is an unexpected, thrilling return of series creator Ron Gilbert that continues the story of the legendary adventure games The Secret of Monkey Island and Monkey Island 2: LeChuck’s Revenge developed in collaboration
bluejetty:00168515:ios.description:
Return to Monkey Island is an unexpected, thrilling return of series creator Ron Gilbert that continues the story of the legendary adventure games The Secret of Monkey Island and Monkey Island 2: LeChuck’s Revenge developed in collaboration with Lucasfilm Games.
It’s been many years since Guybrush Threepwood was last locked in a battle of wits with his nemesis, the zombie pirate LeChuck. His true love, Elaine Marley, has turned her focus away from governing and Guybrush himself is adrift and unfulfilled, having never found the Secret of Monkey Island. Hip, young pirate leaders led by Captain Madison have shuffled the old guard from power, Melee Island has taken a turn for the worse, and famed businessman Stan has been imprisoned for ‘marketing-related crimes’.
Banter with old friends and new faces on familiar islands now under dangerous new leadership. Then, take to the high seas and explore the new and unknown as you work your way out of tough predicaments. Clever puzzles, bizarre situations, and devastating ripostes are all that stand between Guybrush and glory.
Return to Point & Click Swashbuckling
Bringing classic point and click gameplay to the modern-day, intrepid pirates will solve puzzles and explore the islands with a clever evolution of classic adventure game controls. Context-sensitive interactions, reactive dialog trees, and an easy-to-use inventory system make pirating a breeze.
Embark on Archipelago Adventures
Navigate the sometimes-friendly confines of Melee Island, a familiar place that finds itself under new management by leaders who have put the squeeze on old friends and new faces. Venture out into uncharted lands like the aptly named Terror Island and the chilling outposts of Brrr Muda to make allies and enemies alike.
Created by a Legendary Crew
The new chapter in the Monkey Island series marks the return of the iconic series’ creator Ron Gilbert, joined by game co-writer Dave Grossman, art director Rex Crowle (Knights & Bikes, Tearaway) and composers Peter McConnell, Michael Land, and Clint Bajakian (Monkey Island, Monkey Island 2: LeChuck’s Revenge).

AudioBooth is a streamlined iOS client designed exclusively for Audiobookshelf users who value simplicity and performance. Built with a focus on essential audiobook listening features, AudioBooth delivers a clean, distraction-free experience for your self-hosted audiobook library.
Key Features:
• Pure Audiobookshelf integration - Connect seamlessly to your personal Audiobookshelf server
• Focused audiobook experience - Purpose-built interface optimized for audiobook listening
• Essential playback controls - Variable speed, sleep timer with fade out, and chapter navigation
• Progress synchronization - Keep your listening progress in sync across devices
• Offline downloads - Download audiobooks for listening without an internet connection
• Library browsing - Explore your books, authors, series, and collections with filtering options
• CarPlay support - Enjoy your audiobooks safely on the road with full CarPlay integration
• In-app ebook reader - Read EPUBs and PDFs directly within the app

• Background playback - Continue listening while using other apps
• Lock screen controls - Standard media controls on your lock screen
• Apple Watch app - Control playback from your wrist
• Clean, native design - Intuitive interface that feels at home on iOS
AudioBooth focuses on what matters most: enjoying your audiobooks. No unnecessary features, no bloat, just a reliable, efficient way to access your Audiobookshelf library on your iPhone and iPad.

listings.name: AudioBooth: Audiobooks Player
listings.description:
Your personal audiobook companion for Audiobookshelf.

AudioBooth is a streamlined iOS client designed exclusively for Audiobookshelf users who value simplicity and performance. Built with a focus on essential audiobook listening features, AudioBooth delivers a clean, distraction-free experience for your self-hosted audiobook library.

Key Features:
• Pure Audiobookshelf integration - Connect seamlessly to your personal Audiobookshelf server
• Focused audiobook experience - Purpose-built interface optimized for audiobook listening
• Essential playback controls - Variable speed, sleep timer with fade out, and chapter navigation
• Progress synchronization - Keep your listening progress in sync across devices
• Offline downloads - Download audiobooks for listening without an internet connection
• Library browsing - Explore your books, authors, series, and collections with filtering options
• CarPlay support - Enjoy your audiobooks safely on the road with full CarPlay integration
• In-app ebook reader - Read EPUBs and PDFs directly within the app
• Multi-connection support - Connect to multiple servers or different accounts
• Playback history - Track your complete listening history
• Background playback - Continue listening while using other apps
• Lock screen controls - Standard media controls on your lock screen
• Apple Watch app - Control playback from your wrist
• Clean, native design - Intuitive interface that feels at home on iOS

AudioBooth focuses on what matters most: enjoying your audiobooks. No unnecessary features, no bloat, just a reliable, efficient way to access your Audiobookshelf library on your iPhone and iPad.

Note: AudioBooth requires an existing Audiobookshelf server to function. The app does not include any media content. Learn more about Audiobookshelf at https://audiobookshelf.org

---
AudioBooth is an independent client application and is not affiliated with the Audiobookshelf project.

By downloading AudioBooth, you agree to Apple's Standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00066101:ios.description:
This is a card-based dungeon crawler game with magic and simple rules. You will receive a set of cards, one of which represents your hero. You can move your hero one step left, right, up, or down to navigate through dungeons, unlock chests, collect coins, drink elixirs, cast fireballs, avoid traps, and defeat bosses. 
The game has basic mechanics with rogue-like elements, making it challenging to master.
There are 12 heroes to choose from, each with different tactics to help you collect as much loot as possible. These heroes include Knight, Mage, Paladin, Thief, Ruiner, Dark Druid, Sir Lancelot, Berserk, Assassin, Plague Doctor, Archer and Shaman. Defeating bosses adds difficulty to the game and upgrades your hero, while opening chests rewards you with loot. However, be careful as there are also dangerous cards, such as poison, that can hinder your progress. The game is said to be addictive and can provide hours of entertainment.

bluejetty:00119937:ios.description:
Welcome to Blueheart, the app helping couples forge the relationships they’ve always dreamed of. Our expert-led relationship and sexual health app connects you to your partner in new and meaningful ways through engaging courses, mindful exercises and science-backed advice. Couples therapy is for everyone, so let’s reboot your relationship happiness and your sex life with #1 Relationship Health App.
[As seen in BBC, Cosmopolitan, Independent, Marie Claire, The Guardian.]
Here’s how it works:
1. Sign up with a valid email address. You can do this separately or simultaneously with your partner
2. Take the free assessment to help us understand you and your relationship better
3. See your results straight away, so you know where we can help you
4. Choose between a monthly or annual subscription plan 
5. Get started with a 7-day or 14-day free trial, depending on which subscription plan you selected
6. Explore the app to dive into our couples questions, courses, smart journaling, articles and much more
7. Enjoy a happier, healthier relationship
So what’s in my plan?
Courses:
Destress Your Relationship
Becoming a Better Team
Navigating Your Differences
Sharing Appreciation
Managing anxiety
Dealing with Rejection
Low libido for Couples 
… and so much more
Sessions
Audio-guided touch sessions based on the proven practice of Sensate Focus 
Interactive guided conversations to have together 
Audio-learning and articles
Fun and meaningful activities to bring your learnings to life
Smart Journaling:
We’ll connect the dots between your feelings and their source to help identify key areas to work on.
Daily questions and chat space:
Each day, we’ll give you new couple questions for you and your partner to answer to help start engaging conversations.
Link profiles with your partner:
See both your insights all in one place with our relationship tracker.
Our courses cover all kinds of topics, including: 
Increasing sexual libido and desire (low libido)
Couples communication
Sexual wellness
Sex life after children
Emotional intelligence
Managing distractions in the bedroom
Exploring sexual fantasies
Different types of touch and intimacy
Love languages
Attachment Styles
Blueheart is backed by science. Created by experts. 
“Making your relationship the best it can be is easier than you think. Blueheart is here to guide you – teaching you things you may not have know about love, sex and connection. Think of it as not only a couples app, but a stepping stone toward a closer, more intimate relationship.”
— Dr. Kat Hertlein, Professor in Couple and Family Therapy
What Blueheart couples say:
“So good it should be given on prescription” - Alisha, 32
“Life-changing app. This has helped me and my partner to communicate. A huge block for a very long time. Thanks for helping me with a difficult situation!” - Daisy, 28 
“This is a really great app that’s helped me and my partner no end, without the embarrassing awkwardness!” - Mateo, 44
Join more than 150,000 couples all over the world building lasting love relationships with the #1 relationship health app. Our app is suitable for everyone, whether you are in a long distance relationship, marriage, dating or open relationship. Give Blueheart a try and reboot your relationship happiness: more love, more fun, and more of what makes you special together.

(1) 100% FREE international phone call for more than 230+ countries or regions.
(2) New user bonus +500 credits. Multiple ways to earn app credits to make phone calls. 
(watch videos, complete tasks, invite friends and more.)

(4) Server worldwide to ensure the best voice quality. 
(5) Unlike international calling cards, Duo Voice does not use your cell minutes.

- Free International Calling
Duo Voice is a 100% Completely international phone call app with no extra charge at all! Duo Voice can reach any mobile or landline number in more than 230+ countries or regions!

Duo Voice uses real telephone lines, which means we can guarantee a good crystal clear voice call quality, such as telephone calls from a landline! Duo Voice automatically detects and adjusts your connection speed to make sure more stable calls.
- Call Recording
Now it supports the call recording function, just tap the recording button during the call to record the call. one-tap recording, more convenient and faster to save important information during the call.
- Call Conference
You can hold up to 8-way calls conference with crystal-clear audio and minimal lag.
- High Quality Voice Call
Voice calls are sent to high quality Duo Voice's dedicated VOIP network so that you do not need to worry about bad reception, volatile calls or drops. Our system always finds the best telephone line (the best voice quality) in your neighboring region when you make the call.
- Earn credits
There are millions of ways to earn credits in our app, for example: daily check-in, friend invitations, watching ads, etc. To enjoy the best service calling, you simply just need a tap to earn FREE credits.

bluejetty:00145783:ios.description:
Embark on a thrilling merging, puzzling, and matching adventure with Merge Cruise: Mystery Puzzle! 
Set sail on a captivating journey across exotic islands, where every merge unlocks hidden treasures and reveals intriguing mysteries waiting to be solved.
Merge Cruise: Mystery Puzzle offers a unique blend of merging gameplay and adventurous quests, perfect for players of all ages. Dive into immersive landscapes, explore ancient ruins, and encounter fascinating characters along the way.
With stunning visuals, captivating soundtracks, and new gameplay mechanics, Merge Cruise delivers an unforgettable experience that will keep you engaged for hours on end. Whether you're a puzzle enthusiast or an adventure seeker, there's something for everyone in Merge Cruise!
== MERGE CRUISE: MYSTERY PUZZLE FEATURES ==
MERGE AND MATCH
Generate and merge items on the board to complete tasks and earn cash. Discover a variety of items to create and merge.
RENOVATE AND DECORATE
Use your hard-earned cash to renovate your cruise ship. Clean, fix, build, and decorate your way through each chapter, transforming your ship from run-down to luxurious.
ENGAGING STORYLINE
Immerse yourself in a rich narrative filled with humor, drama, and mystery. Interact with a cast of colorful characters, each with their own unique personalities and secrets.
UNIQUE GAMEPLAY MODES
Choose from three gameplay modes, each offering a different experience. Whether you're a casual player or a seasoned puzzler, there's a mode for you.
DIVERSE CAST OF CHARACTERS
Interact with a spectrum of characters, each bringing their unique story and secrets to the fold.
THEMES OF LEGACY AND COMMUNITY
Explore narratives of legacy, identity, and belonging, all woven into the fabric of a compelling mystery.
REGULAR UPDATES
With new chapters, items, and events added regularly, there's always something new to discover in Merge Cruise.
Follow Merge Cruise: Mystery Puzzle on Facebook and Instagram for exclusive offers and special updates!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MergeCruise/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mergecruise/
Do you need our help? Any questions about the game? Contact us by sending an email to: hq@peerplay.com

bluejetty:00184424:ios.summary:
