You can play with two players but if you have more fri
bluejetty:00184424:ios.description:
Duel your friends in a variety of 2,3 or 4 player minigames using simple one touch controls! Play simultaneously on the same device for multiplayer action on the road, wherever you are.
You can play with two players but if you have more friends or family around you can battle it out with three or four players.
You can also play the 4 Player Cup to determine who is the best!
================
40 Minigames to play
================
Snake Arena
Grow your snake by eating stars, but be careful, make sure your head doesn't touch an opponent's body.
Try to corner your opponent and be the last one standing in the arena!
Skateboard Racing
Tap as fast as you can to reach the finishline.
Tank Battle
Duel each other on the battlefield. Who’s the best shooter? 
Grab the Fish
Test your timing skills and be the first to grab 3 goldfish!
Soccer Challenge
Who has the soccer skills to score a goal in one touch soccer?
Sumo Wrestling
Fight your opponent in the sumo wrestling arena. Don’t get pushed over the line! 
Chicken Run
Avoid falling off the platforms by using gravity.
Rally Drifters
Be the quickest driver on the sandy tracks to complete 3 laps.
Micro Speed Racers
Avoid obstacles in this formula racing game and go around the corners as fast as you can!
Feed the Pigeon
Use your slingshot to shoot bread crumbs into the pigeon's mouth.
======
Features
======
• Simple one touch, one button controls
• 4-players can play using the same device
• 40 different games
• Challenge your friends and family 
• 4 player Cup
Thank you for playing!

bluejetty:00161831:ios.summary:
Aplicația MyAccount te ajută să-ți gestionezi serviciile mobile de la Telekom direct de pe smartphone. Ai acces rapid la informații despre costurile și serviciile tale mobile, 24/7, de oriunde ai fi.
Pot folosi aplicația toți clienții care
bluejetty:00161831:ios.description:
Aplicația MyAccount te ajută să-ți gestionezi serviciile mobile de la Telekom direct de pe smartphone. Ai acces rapid la informații despre costurile și serviciile tale mobile, 24/7, de oriunde ai fi.
Pot folosi aplicația toți clienții care au cartele preplătite și/sau contracte de abonamente mobile încheiate cu Telekom Romania Mobile Communications S.A.
Aplicația mobilă MyAccount te ajută să: 
plătești factura simplu și rapid;
vizualizezi și descarci factura pe telefon;
reîncarci cartela Telekom;
prelungești abonamentul mobil;
activezi factura electronică;
activezi roamingul la abonament;
fii la curent cu cele mai noi oferte.
Plătești factura mai ușor
Cea mai rapidă metodă de plată factură este cu cardul în aplicație. Poți salva datele cardului, pentru ca data viitoare să plătești factura și mai ușor. Plățile se fac în deplină siguranță, datorită sistemului 3D Secure.
În plus, ai acces la istoricul facturilor din ultimele 6 luni și poți descărca factura în telefon.
Reîncarci cartela Telekom
Cu MyAccount, poți reîncărca atât cartela ta, cât și pe cea a cuiva drag, simplu și rapid, la orice oră vrei. În plus, poți vedea și ultimele 3 reîncărcări făcute.
Prelungești abonamentul
Acum e mai simplu ca oricând să faci o prelungire abonament. Rezolvi rapid din MyAccount, fără drumuri în oraș. Totul e la vârful degetelor tale, cum s-ar spune. Tot din aplicație poți verifica și câte luni mai ai din perioada contractuală.
Activezi factura electronică
Factura electronică este mereu la îndemâna ta. Te anunțăm pe e-mail imediat cum se emite și o poți vizualiza și descărca din contul tău MyAccount, oricând vrei. Și mai ai un avantaj: scapi de costul asociat facturilor tipărite pe hârtie.
Activezi roamingul la abonament
Pleci în străinătate și nu ai roaming la abonament? Din MyAccount, poți schimba rapid abonamentul actual cu unul care are roaming inclus sau mai multe beneficii internaționale, fără să modifici perioada contractuală. La revenirea în țară, te poți întoarce la abonamentul inițial, fără niciun cost suplimentar. 
Participi la tombole
Organizăm frecvent tombole în aplicație. Fiecare acțiune realizată din contul tău MyAccount te aduce mai aproape de un super premiu. Verifică frecvent aplicația pentru a fi la curent cu toate detaliile.
Ce mai trebuie să știi
pentru a folosi aplicația, conectează-te la internet prin datele mobile sau Wi-Fi;
pentru a vedea informații despre abonamentele corporate, este nevoie să-ți creezi un cont business;
dacă vrei să primești o ofertă personalizată, te rugăm să accesezi această pagină: https://mobile.telekom.ro/lead/.
Spune-ne părerea ta
Lucrăm constant la aplicația MyAccount, pentru a-ți oferi o experiență de utilizare cât mai plăcută. Apreciem orice feedback din partea ta, întrucât ne ajută să îmbunătățim aplicația. Îți mulțumim!
Toate cele bune, 
Echipa Telekom

listings.description:
Stop ending practice with a question mark. Modacity is the Deliberate Practice System for serious musicians — helping you plan, record, reflect, and hear your progress session by session.


USED BY PROFESSIONALS

Serious musicians improve because their next session starts with a plan.

"Musically life changing app! Amazing app that every serious musician should have! Bravo."
-- Richard Stoelzel, President World Trumpet Society & Professor of Trumpet, McGill.

"I am amazed how well the Modacity system works."
-- Anne, amateur violinist

“As a trumpet player (ergo, loudmouthed and opinionated) I’ve often been wrong. However, in this case I’ve never been wronger. The app has become the central pillar of my practice schedule and I’d be lost without it. With that in mind, the price is cheap!!”

-- John Thirkell, trumpet & flugelhorn - Jamiroquai, Level 42, Buddy Rich Band

"Swiss army knife to organize and focus my music practice. I can’t imagine my life without it"
-- Armen, product manager & duduk player

“Just wanted to tell you how helpful this app has been over the years. I got my first regional job at 640 hours and then one more regional gig and a one year with a big orchestra at 930 hours on the app.”
-- Samuel Wamhoff, Principal Trombone - Modesto Symphony Orchestra; 2nd Trmb - Stockton Symphony; Acting 2nd - San Francisco Opera

METRONOME — Professional-grade metronome with subdivisions, accent patterns, and tap tempo. The timing foundation every serious musician needs.

CHROMATIC TUNER — Accurate, responsive, always available. Never practice out of tune again.

PRACTICE PLANNER — Plan and track every session. Write what needs work mid-session, rate how it went, and come back to it next time. Never lose the thing you meant to fix.

Start your first session. Know what to fix tomorrow. Enjoy an automatic 14-day free trial with your new account.

Modacity helps musicians of all genres practice effectively; Classical to Rock, Bluegrass to Pop, Modacity works for everyone.

Subscribe to Modacity Premium (monthly or annual) to unlock:

• Practice Statistics
• Unlimited Deliberate Practice Mode
• All Metronome Features
• Unlimited cloud-sync notes & recordings
• Practice Folders
• Full History Log
• Practice Break Reminders

Subscription payments will be charged to your Apple ID account and will automatically renew at $12.99 USD per month or $129 USD per year, unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Prices may vary by country.

bluejetty:00073419:ios.name: Planned Parenthood Direct℠
bluejetty:00073419:ios.summary:
Can’t go to the doctor? Get convenient home delivery or pharmacy pickup options—your prescriptions will always be stress-free, affordable, and completely private. 
Available in select states. Download the app to learn more!
HOW IT WORKS
bluejetty:00073419:ios.description:
Can’t go to the doctor? Get convenient home delivery or pharmacy pickup options—your prescriptions will always be stress-free, affordable, and completely private. 
Available in select states. Download the app to learn more!
HOW IT WORKS
1. After downloading the app, create an account or continue as a guest user.
2. Select a service: birth control, emergency contraception, UTI treatment, or schedule a health center appointment.
3. Answer a few health questions so clinicians can determine what's best for you.
4. Add payment and shipping information to submit your request for review by a clinician.
5. From here, you’ll be well on your way to quickly and easily getting the care you need!
PRESCRIPTIONS YOU NEED, WHEN YOU NEED THEM
• Delivered subscription birth control pills starting at $20/pack; includes auto-refills for up to one year + free shipping. 
• Pharmacy pickup options for birth control pills, patch, or ring prescriptions.  
• Delivered emergency contraception via overnight shipping—because accidents happen.  
• Fast treatment for UTIs—simply pick up your medication at a pharmacy.
*Offerings vary by state.
EASY TO USE, PRIVATE, AND SECURE
• Make your request anytime, anywhere.
• In most cases, no appointment or physical examination required.
• Get in and out in under 10 minutes.
• Secure billing and patient information.
• Discreet packaging to your doorstep. 
• Pay with credit, debit, or prepaid card.
• Planned Parenthood expertise—100 years and counting!
STRAIGHT ANSWERS FROM PLANNED PARENTHOOD
Planned Parenthood Direct also helps you decide which birth control method is right for you. Put your anxieties to rest and get answers to common questions from the experts at Planned Parenthood.
Planned Parenthood Direct services are currently not available in MA.

bluejetty:00158633:android.description:
Simple App offers financial convenience for customers, saving time, money, and energy through innovative technology and intelligent solutions. It provides seamless access to digital loans and "Buy Now, Pay Later" services, delivering a smarter way to manage financial needs. Founded in 2019, the company obtained its non-banking financial service license from the Financial Regulatory Commission of Mongolia in February 2020. With a user-friendly design and a commitment to transparency, Simple offers loans with straightforward terms, no disbursement fees, and zero hidden charges. 
Simple application offers the following services in accordance with Mongolian laws and regulations: 
 Digital loan 
 BNPL 
 Collateral loan 
Loan Details: 
 Loan Amount Range: 50,000mnt - 30,000,000mnt 
 Repayment Periods: Minimum of 3 months, maximum of 40 months 
 Annual Percentage Rate (APR): 27.6% to 39.6% 
Representative Example of Loan: 
 If you borrow 1,000,000₮ for 12 months at an APR of 27.6%: 
 Monthly Payment: 96,310.39mnt 
 Total Payment Amount: 1,155,724mnt 
 Total Cost of the Loan: 155,724mnt 
Key Features: 
 Instant loan approval 
 Flexible repayment schedules 
 Clear and upfront loan terms 
 Secure and easy application process 
We are committed to responsible lending. Review our loan terms carefully to ensure they meet your financial needs. For any questions, contact us directly through the app or at [info@simple.mn].

 (3) add the bookmark thumbnail image 
 (4) touch the bookmark edit button 
 (5) select the bookmark thumbnail image 
 (6) the bookmark memo view will be loaded

bluejetty:00065396:ios.description:
Tua Agenda é um aplicativo completo para quem quer praticidade, organização e velocidade na gestão de agendamentos.
Ideal para salões de beleza, barbearias, clínicas de estética, designers de sobrancelhas, lash designers, manicures, pedicures, profissionais da saúde, personal trainers, professores particulares e qualquer negócio que trabalhe com hora marcada.
Com o Tua Agenda, você centraliza sua agenda, automatiza processos e ganha mais tempo para focar no que realmente importa: atender melhor seus clientes.
AGENDAMENTO ONLINE
Ao criar sua conta, sua empresa recebe um link de agendamento online. Você pode compartilhar esse link no Instagram, WhatsApp, site ou outras redes sociais.
Seus clientes acessam sua página, escolhem o serviço, o profissional e o horário disponível, fazendo o agendamento de forma simples.
Você pode personalizar sua página com foto principal, contato, endereço, serviços, profissionais e outras informações importantes.
Caso sua empresa não queira receber agendamentos online, essa opção pode ser desabilitada.
MULTIAGENDAS E PROFISSIONAIS
Cadastre vários profissionais e organize a agenda de cada um separadamente.
Cada profissional pode ter horários próprios, serviços vinculados e permissões de acesso específicas.
Você controla o que cada funcionário pode visualizar ou alterar dentro do sistema.
SERVIÇOS, PRODUTOS E ESTOQUE
Cadastre seus serviços com valores, duração, profissionais responsáveis e configurações avançadas.
Também é possível cadastrar produtos, controlar estoque e registrar vendas junto aos atendimentos.
HORÁRIOS PERSONALIZADOS
Configure horários de atendimento de forma flexível.
Você pode definir horários por empresa, por profissional, por serviço e por dia da semana.
Também é possível utilizar preços avançados por dia e horário, adaptando o sistema à rotina da sua empresa.
MENSAGENS AUTOMÁTICAS
Envie mensagens automáticas para lembrar seus clientes sobre os agendamentos.
Use lembretes, confirmações e avisos para reduzir faltas e melhorar a comunicação com clientes e profissionais.
Alguns recursos de envio de mensagens podem ter custos adicionais conforme o canal utilizado.
FATURAMENTO E FORMAS DE PAGAMENTO
Controle suas entradas diretamente pelo aplicativo.
Registre formas de pagamento como dinheiro, PIX, cartão, à receber e outras opções utilizadas pela sua empresa.
Ao lançar os pagamentos nos agendamentos, os valores são contabilizados no faturamento.
Você também pode acompanhar custos, comissões e resultados por período.
COBRANÇA DE SINAL
Configure formas de pagamento integradas com algumas plataformas para cobrança de sinal de agendamento.
Esse recurso ajuda a reduzir faltas e trazer mais segurança para a reserva de horários.
LISTA DE ESPERA
Organize clientes interessados em encaixes quando não houver horário disponível.
Assim, você aproveita melhor os horários vagos da agenda.
RELATÓRIOS GERENCIAIS
Acompanhe relatórios de agendamentos, faturamento, produtos, serviços, profissionais, comissões e outros dados importantes para sua gestão.
ANAMNESES PERSONALIZADAS
Crie fichas de anamnese personalizadas para seus clientes.
Monte campos conforme a necessidade da sua empresa e mantenha tudo organizado em um só lugar.
CUPONS, PACOTES E PROMOÇÕES
Crie cupons de desconto, pacotes promocionais e condições especiais para seus clientes.
AGENDAMENTOS RECORRENTES
Cadastre agendamentos recorrentes para clientes com horários fixos, como atendimentos semanais, quinzenais ou mensais.
SUPORTE
Precisa de ajuda? Acesse o menu Suporte dentro do aplicativo e fale com nossa equipe.
TESTE GRÁTIS
Baixe o Tua Agenda e inicie seu período grátis de testes.
Não precisa informar nenhum tipo de pagamento para começar.
Se gostar, assine o app e continue usando todos os recursos para organizar sua empresa.
Siga nosso Instagram: @tuaagenda
Termos de uso: https://tuaagenda.com/termos-de-uso
Política de Privacidade: https://tuaagenda.com/politica-de-privacidade

bluejetty:00115324:ios.description:
No more Spotify Wrapped envy. Your Apple Music stats are finally here, and for the entire year.
With stats.fm for Apple Music, dive deep into your listening habits with beautiful charts and rich insights. Track your top songs, artists, albums, and more, all in a sleek, social experience just for Apple Music users.
Already a hit for Spotify, stats.fm now brings the same powerful experience to Apple Music- custom-built for fans who want to explore their music history in new and meaningful ways.
Features
 • Personal Stats: See your most-played tracks, artists, and albums
 • Trends & Visualizations: Discover patterns with listening clocks, charts, and custom recaps
 • Achievements: Unlock record badges for being a top listener of your favorite artist
 • Social Music: Compare your stats and share with friends
 • Historical Data Sync: Keep your stats up to date with your listening history
 • Privacy First: Your data stays yours; we never share without your permission
Built for Apple Music. Built for you.
This is a standalone app from the creators of stats.fm (originally for Spotify), redesigned for Apple Music users for a better performance.
Note:
• Requires an active Apple Music subscription.
• Some features (like lifetime stats) require a one-time import of your Apple Music listening history. We’ll guide you through the simple steps to upload it.
Free to start. Upgrade to unlock deeper insights.
• Enjoy core stats for free, or go Plus for access to full history, badges, and more powerful analytics.

Transform Your Photos into Masterpieces
Discover the joy of effortless photo enhancement with HD Photo Editor, designed to elevate your everyday moments into visually stunning creations. With just a few taps, you can turn ordinary photos into extraordinary works of art that truly reflect your unique style.
---
**Create Stunning Visuals for Every Moment** 
Whether you’re documenting a family gathering, a weekend getaway, or simply adding flair to your social media posts, HD Photo Editor makes every photo look its best. Enhance your memories, highlight your creativity, and share your beautiful moments with ease.
---
**Seamless Editing for Any Occasion** 
From casual selfies to professional-looking product shots, HD Photo Editor adapts to your needs. Capture the essence of your travels, perfect your fashion shots, or create polished images for your small business. With a full suite of creative tools, your photos will shine in any scenario.

**Personalize Every Moment** 
Add fun stickers, captions, or creative embellishments to make every image uniquely yours. Whether you’re sharing a playful moment with friends or designing a custom invitation, HD Photo Editor allows you to personalize every photo with ease.

Stand out on social media with visually stunning photos that grab attention. With just a few taps, you can create vibrant, eye-catching images that reflect your unique style and make your posts shine.
---

- **Effortless Editing**: Powerful tools, simplified for every user. 
- **Versatile Filters**: Enhance any type of photo, from travel snaps to fashion shots. 
- **Creative Effects**: Add unique, eye-catching effects that make your photos stand out.

---
**Comprehensive Editing Tools**

---
**Join Our Creative Community** 
Share your creations with the HD Photo Editor community and see how others are bringing their photos to life. Use the hashtag #HDPhotoEditor on social media to connect with fellow creators and showcase your work.
---
**Download HD Photo Editor Today** 
Elevate your photos with a few simple steps. HD Photo Editor is your go-to tool for creating stunning, professional-quality images. Available now on the App Store.

bluejetty:00150153:ios.summary: The Notary eJournal by Jurat INC is an electronic notary journal created to provide a digital replacement for the standard hard-bound notary journals that exist in the market. Designed by notaries in the State of California and trusted by n
bluejetty:00150153:ios.description:
The Notary eJournal by Jurat INC is an electronic notary journal created to provide a digital replacement for the standard hard-bound notary journals that exist in the market. Designed by notaries in the State of California and trusted by notaries in over 45 states, it adheres to the most strict and up-to-date notary journal guidelines in the United States.
Trusted by notaries in almost every industry, including; estate planning/trust documentation, automotive, loan signings, healthcare, general notary work, packing/shipping, resorts & timeshares, banking & financial institutions, and more
Before considering use of any electronic notary journal, a notary public should check their state requirements to ensure adherence to all guidelines. You can also visit our webpage for information regarding which states specifically prohibit the use of an electronic notary journal, as well as other notary journal considerations
The Notary eJournal was designed by signing agents in the State of California that work in the high-volume real estate & lending environment, often individually responsible for helping close hundreds of refinance, purchase and sale transactions per month. Given this workflow and industry insight, the Notary eJournal was created with the following priorities in mind:
Compliance - California has some of the strictest guidelines for notaries when it comes to the notary journal. As the only State to require capturing a thumbprint for certain notarizations, it is imperative for any useful electronic notary journal to provide such functionality. Our team has tested numerous bluetooth thumbprint capturing devices and has made the Notary eJournal compatible with the best bluetooth thumbprint scanner available to the public. The link this device can be found on our website.
*Note - this bluetooth thumbprint capturing device must be purchased separately
Ease of Use - The guided workflow provided by the Notary eJournal will ensure your signing appointments aren’t slowed down by the process of manually writing down all entry information and using an ink pad to capture thumbprints.
Technology - The Notary eJournal safely and securely implements features meant to truly make your job easier. Key features include using your device location to input location information, taking a picture of a signers ID and having all important information automatically input in the appropriate fields, and using bluetooth thumbprint technology to capture any necessary thumbprints.
For a list of all product features please visit our webpage. All new users get a 14 day trial to create up to 5 signing entries - so be sure to check out the app and see what we have to offer!

bluejetty:00121015:ios.description:
The most exciting hunting journey starts now! 
The only game which lets you see amazing predatory dinosaurs in action and challenge them for ultimate survival!
Carnivores: Dinosaur Hunter is a hunting simulation that is completely true to life and totally breathtaking. You land on a distant planet inhabited by dinosaurs and progress from a shy wildlife observer to a stealthy and ruthless T-Rex hunter. All dinosaurs are in full 3D complete with their terrifying roars!
• Chose time of day (night vision on!)
• Fill the area with dinosaurs to your liking and skills
• Equip with camouflage, cover scent or radar 
• Pick a weapon and hunt or take a camera and observe
• Store your prey in real-size trophy room
• Go green and use tranquilizer instead of bullets
• Read tips and tricks for every dinosaur in ‘Dinopedia’
• Upgrade to PRO with one-time purchase and get access to 7 huge 3D areas
To anyone who played Carnivores on PC, guaranteed hours of nostalgia!
PRO version has 22 dinosaurs now and more are coming! 
The game is compatible with Fling controller.

bluejetty:00152903:ios.description:
Hair Snap: Your Personal Hair-Care Companion
Hair Snap uses advanced AI image analysis to highlight 18 different hair and scalp characteristics from a single photo, then transforms the insights into an easy-to-follow self-care plan tailored to your goals.
--- How It Works
►Snap a Photo – Capture your hair with your camera anytime.
►AI Insights – Instantly see ratings on density, texture, shine, and more.
►Personalized Routine – Daily tips and care steps aligned with your goals (volume, smoothness, damage repair).
►Track Progress – Compare past scans to see changes over time.
---Key Features
► 18-Point Hair Snapshot – Clear, easy-to-understand feedback on multiple attributes.
► Unlimited Photos – Retake anytime, analyze as often as your plan allows.
► Goal-Oriented Plans – Whether you want more volume or reduced breakage, we’ll help you stay on track.
► Progress Dashboard – Visual charts to see trends and improvements.
► Reminders – Stay consistent with scheduled care tasks.
---Why Hair Snap?
► Holistic View – Considers both hair strands and scalp appearance for a complete picture.
► Smart AI – Built to recognize key cosmetic features from thousands of hair images.
► Flexible Access – Rescan anytime with affordable plans or one-time add-ons.
► Privacy First – Your photos are processed securely.
---MEDICAL DISCLAIMER
Hair Snap is designed for general wellness and beauty purposes only. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a qualified professional with questions about your health.
---Subscription & In-App Purchases
►Weekly Plan – Weekly analyses, full feature set.
►Yearly Plan – Best value: save over 40 % vs. weekly.
►One-Time Scan Pack – Purchase extra AI analyses as needed.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled ≥ 24 hrs before the end of the current period. Manage auto-renewal in your App Store settings.
Links
►Privacy Policy: https://www.belkalabs.com/privacy
►Terms of Service: https://www.belkalabs.com/terms
►Support: apple@belkalabs.com

bluejetty:00160548:ios.description:
The Datadog mobile app provides real-time visibility into critical alerts, incidents, monitors, dashboards, logs and application performance metrics across your entire environment directly from your iPhone or iPad.
Datadog seamlessly integrates with your on-call notification and messaging services so your on-call engineers can quickly evaluate the conditions that triggered an alert, determine its urgency, and decide the next course of action—anywhere, anytime.
With Datadog for iOS, you can:
- Trigger, respond, and resolve On-Call alerts anywhere:
Receive critical push notifications and investigate alerting monitors or active incidents with direct access to monitors and incidents. Additionally, Bits AI SRE accelerates root cause detection.
- Monitor key metrics on-the-go:
Track performance, SLO, and cloud integrations with full access to your Datadog dashboards and monitors.
-Create and manage Incidents from anywhere:
Kick off incidents, assemble teams, and manage response workflows without ever having to open your laptop
- Add Datadog on your Homescreen:
Add Datadog to your Home or Lock Screen for one-tap access to critical metrics and monitors.
- Search and explore Logs in real time: 
Pinpoint issues faster with log search and anomaly detection powered by Watchdog.
- View APM traces and service health anytime:
Analyze distributed traces and stay on top of application performance wherever you are.
A Datadog account is required to use this application. Setup a Datadog account for free at datadoghq.com
For more information, see Datadog Mobile App documentation: https://docs.datadoghq.com/mobile/

bluejetty:00096232:ios.summary:
Reimagine Your Home with AI-Powered Design

bluejetty:00096232:ios.description:
Reimagine Your Home with AI-Powered Design
Transform your house, garden, and outdoor spaces with just a photo. Our app uses advanced AI technology to help homeowners, real estate agents, and DIY enthusiasts visualize and plan their dream spaces with ease. From a single room refresh to a full home makeover, everything you need to design, preview, and transform is at your fingertips.
Key Features
► AI Interior Design & Space Redesign
Instantly redesign any room by uploading a photo. Explore layouts, furniture, and color schemes perfectly matched to your space.
► AI Garden & Landscape Planner
Generate beautiful outdoor layouts with plants, paths, and seating zones. Experiment with 40+ landscaping styles before you start building.
► New Wall Replacement & Color Preview
Test paint colors, wall textures, and feature walls virtually to find the perfect look.
► Flooring Preview & Style Selector
See hardwood, tile, or carpet options in real time and choose the one that fits your style.
► Exterior Facade Design & Makeover
Remodel your home’s exterior with new facades, windows, and roofs to boost curb appeal.
► Style Transfer from Inspiration Photo
Upload an inspiration image, and the AI will transform your space to match its style.
► Furniture & Object Replacement Tool
Replace old furniture with new pieces and instantly see them in place.
► Object Removal & Cleanup Editor
Remove clutter or unwanted items with one click for a clean, fresh look.
► Share Your Designs on Social Media
Save and share your designs with friends, family, or professionals for instant feedback.
Why Choose AI Decor?
AI Decor is powered by advanced multi-model AI technology, designed to make home design simple, inspiring, and interactive. Experiment with 100+ curated styles and visualize your ideas with precision, from cozy bedrooms to full exterior makeovers.
With just one photo, you can preview new layouts, colors, and furniture arrangements in seconds. Apply your favorite Pinterest or moodboard inspirations directly to your space, save multiple versions to compare, and find the look you love most.
Whether you’re redesigning a single room, refreshing your garden, or planning a full renovation, AI Decor gives you the tools to explore, experiment, and make confident decisions before you ever lift a brush or move a chair.
Payment & Subscription Terms
Payment is charged to your iTunes account at purchase confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Renewal charges appear within 24 hours before the next cycle.
Download AI Decor today and explore endless design possibilities at your fingertips. See your dream home come to life before you make a single change.
Privacy Policy: https://www.yspiradigital.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.yspiradigital.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00116484:ios.description:
Step into the free-to-play version of "Enchanted Stories: Mystic Woods", a captivating blend of adventure games and hidden object games, where magic, mystery, and danger intertwine. When Rose enters the forest to aid her grandmother, she unravels a chilling truth: dark forces and a ruthless logging pact threaten to wipe out the enchanted realm. Joined by a mysterious wolf companion, you must find hidden objects, solve ancient puzzles, and rally magical creatures to stand against the looming threat. In this immersive world of item search games and rich storytelling, every decision shapes the future. Are you ready to solve mystery games and become the forest’s final hope?
When Rose ventures into the Mystic Woods to help her grandmother, she discovers a devastating truth: the forest’s magic is fading, and a ruthless logging pact threatens to destroy its very soul. There’s no choice for Rose other than to embrace her grandmother’s legacy and become a guardian. bluejetty:00166756:ios.description:
The Juggernaut is a media tech company that tells powerful South Asian stories and convenes the community for high-quality events.
What you’ll get
We publish one story a day and have an archive of over 1,250 articles across multiple categories: profiles, culture, film & TV, politics, business & technology, and more. Access smart, quality journalism on South Asia(ns) with in-depth storytelling you can’t get anywhere else — with no ads or clickbait.
We are thoughtful in everything we do — from choosing fonts created by South Asians to paying our writers and illustrators responsibly — and have been featured in The Guardian, TechCrunch, Axios, Forbes, CNBC, Harvard Business School, Yale, and others.
Download our app to read new stories, search through content, and find and save your favorite reads.
• Stay up-to-date with timely, insightful stories on South Asia(ns)
• Save your favorite articles to easily come back to them 
• Share articles with your friends for free to discuss and debate the most insightful analyses you’ll find
• Search through more than 1,100+ articles to build your knowledge base on the world’s fastest growing demographic
Why we have a paywall
Media is difficult. People like free. But free, ad-supported content often leads to clickbait articles that are low quality. Ad revenue doesn’t responsibly support the costs associated with publishing an article (not even The New York Times survives on ad revenue alone). We launched a paywall because it allows us to pay our writers, editors, photographers, engineers, and artists responsibly. It also allows us to invest in better journalism. If you have additional questions about this, please don’t hesitate to email support@thejuggernaut.com. We’d love to hear from you.
Privacy Policy: https://www.thejuggernaut.com/privacy

bluejetty:00096006:ios.description:
Proactor is more than a typical AI note taker app or a passive transcription tool. It’s the world’s first proactive AI teammate in your conversations. Proactor acts as your personal AI note taker — capturing, organizing, and summarizing everything you say. Whether you’re in a business meeting, brainstorming session, class lecture, or just recording your thoughts, Proactor works silently in the background, perceiving your needs, recalling past details, and delivering real-time insights — all in real time, right as you speak.
Meet the future of productivity.
◆ Real-time Smart Suggestions
Proactor listens, understands, and anticipates your needs — just like a super-smart human assistant. It offers timely info, background facts, and next steps without you needing to ask — the very definition of a proactive AI assistant.
◆ Crystal-Clear AI Meeting Notes
Tired of typing during meetings? Let Proactor do the work. It captures high-quality AI-powered meeting notes and organizes them by speaker, topic, and key takeaways. Your meetings, made actionable.
◆ Instant Audio-to-Task Conversion
Forget follow-up chaos. Proactor automatically turns your conversation into tasks with assigned team members and due dates — a powerful AI note taker free that ensures nothing slips through the cracks.
◆ Voice Memos, Reinvented
Use Proactor as your primary voice note taker or AI voice recorder — it's perfect for journaling, ideas, or quick memos. You can also record with our AI recorder and enjoy real-time transcription that makes your voice memos smarter and more organized.
◆ Effortless Transcription
Need to transcribe audio to text or transcribe speech to text? Proactor does both instantly with high accuracy. It also works as a smart audio to text converter — just hit record.
◆ All-in-One Note Intelligence
From automatic summaries to clear action items, Proactor turns unstructured talk into structured outcomes. Experience next-level AI meeting note taker and AI recording power that makes every discussion more productive and easier to follow.
◆ Global Memory & Cross-Session Context
Unlike basic AI note tools, Proactor remembers your past conversations and connects ideas over time. Just ask your own memory assistant to get answers based on previous conversations, like having an always-on second brain.
◆ Flexible, Private & Free to Start
Proactor is an ai note taker free to use — no credit card needed to get started. Your recordings stay secure and only accessible by you.
Why choose Proactor?
Most tools wait for your command. Proactor acts before you even think to ask. While others take notes, Proactor understands — providing a dynamic blend of ai notes, real-time reminders, and task suggestions. It doesn’t just record — it helps you decide.
Applicable to various scenarios:
Business Meetings: Significantly improves meeting efficiency, provides real-time background information, and ensures every action item is tracked and implemented.
Learning Lectures: Functions as your lecture note taker, captures entire lectures, provides summaries, and explains complex topics on the fly. Helps you deep-research expanded knowledge and easily generate after-class review or exercises.
Sales Calls: Analyzes interactions from your calls, suggesting impactful questions and personalized talking points live. Easily generates follow-up tasks or drafts emails after each conversation.
Whether you're a founder, student, manager, or lifelong learner, Proactor is your edge in conversations. Use it as your AI notes taker, your note recorder, or your go-to voice notes ai solution. If you’ve searched for “voice to text free” tools or wished you could have smarter ai transcribe features, your answer is here.

Terms of Service: https://proactor.ai/proactor-terms-of-service.html

bluejetty:00177880:ios.description:
Music to sleep is the best sleep app with relaxing music and sleep sounds, which will help you to relax and sleep better.
In this calm app, you will find different sleeping songs we have selected particularly to relax and sleep better. Additionally we have developed a tool, which will allow you to create your own relax melodies or relaxing sounds by combining the sounds you like and customized to your liking. You can combine dozens of different relaxing sounds for sleeping from rain sounds for sleeping, forest, birds, thunderstorms, white noise, etc, all this combined as you like and 100 % customized.
What does Music to sleep offer?
We wanted to develop one of the best meditation apps with relaxing sleep music. Therefore, we have created a tool, which contains various functionalities and features you can use:
1.- Deep sleep music: The first tool you will find in this app is a music player with soothing music, with 2 types of songs: Chill out and relaxing music, so that you can choose the music you prefer depending on the situation. We also recommend to use these songs as baby sleep music, since they are relaxing they might help children to fall asleep.
2.- Calming music generator: With this tool you can create your own customized melody by using all the sound we have prepared for you as a base. You can add sound you like and create your own meditation music mix. You could say that it is a white noise app, with which you can add all kinds of sounds: rain, thunderstorm, birds, nature sounds, city sound and white noises.
3.- And last but not least, we have prepared some articles, which will be very useful for you, as a complement to these tools. In these articles we will talk about important topics such as the diet to sleep well, the stages or cycles of sleep, postures to sleep well, how many hours we should sleep, etc.
Main characteristics of the app Music to sleep:
In summary, this is what this app with asmr sleep music offers you:
- Sleep meditation music to listen to with lots of songs. You can use these songs as baby sleep sounds or sleep music for kids.
- A great variety of relaxing sounds you can combine and customize as you like. You should also know that these sounds can be good as a guided sleep meditation or relaxing music to study.
- Learn more about sleep and how to sleep better in our section with tips and articles.
Premium Features & Benefits
- Unlimited music playback: Enjoy your sleep music and relaxing sounds without time limits.
- Create richer sound mixes: In the free version you can combine up to 2 sounds. With Premium, you can add more sounds to create deeper and more immersive soundscapes.
- Sleep timer: Set a timer to automatically stop the music after a chosen time, perfect for falling asleep without worrying about your battery.
- Save your custom mixes: Create and save your favorite sound combinations to use them anytime you want.
- Access to premium sounds: Unlock exclusive relaxing sounds available only for Premium users.
- Ad-free experience: Enjoy the app without interruptions or ads, for a smoother and more relaxing experience.
We hope that this app or tool helps you to sleep well and relax. We are open to suggestions if you have any doubts or idea for the app.
Note: The entire content of this app has been designed and created by Reticode, consequently any use outside of this app without our consent is prohibited.

Privacy Policy: https://reticode.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00023805:ios.summary:
PosteID è l’App ufficiale di Poste Italiane per la nuova identità digitale che consente di accedere ai servizi della Pubblica Amministrazione e dei privati convenzionati con il Sistema Pubblico d’Identità Digitale (SPID).
REGISTRAZIONE CON
bluejetty:00023805:ios.description:
PosteID è l’App ufficiale di Poste Italiane per la nuova identità digitale che consente di accedere ai servizi della Pubblica Amministrazione e dei privati convenzionati con il Sistema Pubblico d’Identità Digitale (SPID).
REGISTRAZIONE CON DOCUMENTO ELETTRONICO
Se sei in possesso di un documento elettronico - Carta d’Identità (CIE) o Passaporto - puoi utilizzare l’App PosteID per effettuare la tua identificazione online, senza recarti in ufficio postale.
Per utilizzare questa funzionalità devi avere un dispositivo mobile abilitato alla lettura NFC. 
ACCESSO SENZA PASSWORD MEDIANTE QR CODE
Puoi autorizzare le richieste di accesso attraverso il QR Code riportato sulla pagina di login del servizio.
ACCESSO CON TOUCH ID o FACE ID
Puoi autorizzare velocemente gli accessi con l’impronta digitale o facciale in alternativa al codice PosteID.
ACCESSO CON LIVELLO SPID 3
Per autorizzare gli accessi ai servizi che richiedono SPID 3, devi essere in possesso del PIN SPID 3. Per ottenerlo, collegati alla tua area personale su posteid.poste.it
UTILIZZA L’APP COME UN GENERATORE DI PIN
Puoi accedere ai servizi anche con un PIN temporaneo generato in App, anche se questa è off-line. 
Una volta che avrai generato il PIN, questo andrà inserito sulla pagina di login del servizio, dopo aver inserito il tuo nome utente e la password. 
Consulta su https://www.poste.it/dichiarazione-accessibilita.html le dichiarazioni di accessibilità.
Nota: le funzionalità dell’App e l’assistenza sono disponibili esclusivamente in lingua italiana al numero +39 06.977.977.77
PosteID is the official Poste Italiane app for the new digital ID that lets you access online the services of the Public Administration and authorised Private Bodies with the Digital Identity Public System (SPID).
REGISTRATION WITH ELECTRONIC DOCUMENT
If you already have an electronic document - Identity Card (CIE) or Passport - you can use the PosteID App for online identification, without going to the post office.
A mobile device enabled for NFC reading is required to use this feature. 
PASSWORD-FREE ACCESS VIA QR CODE
You can authorise requests to access via QR Code on the service login page.
ACCESS VIA TOUCH ID or FACE ID
You can authorise access quickly via fingerprint or face recognition as an alternative to the PosteID code.
ACCESS VIA SPID 3 LEVEL
SPID 3 PIN is required to authorise requests to access the services that requires SPID 3 security level. To get it, connect to your personal area on posteid.poste.it
USE THE APP LIKE A PIN GENERATOR
You can also access to the services with a temporary PIN generated in the App, even if this is off-line.
Once you’ve generated the PIN, it will be entered on the login page of the service after having entered your username and password.
Consult the accessibility statements on https://www.poste.it/dichiarazione-accessibilita.html
Note: the app’s functions and support are available in Italian only. If you need to contact customer service, call us on +39 06.977.977.77

bluejetty:00035722:ios.description:
An exciting stylish sniper game about mafia clans wars.
Are you ready to go back to the beginning of the XX century to take part in the grand mafia war between clans as a gunfighter and to confront street gangs and corrupt authorities? If yes, then our first person shooting game Mafia Sniper is going to challenge your bravery and reaction!
Push back gangsters, corrupt cops, politicians, and get to criminal bosses to seize power in the city. Fulfill murder contracts to destroy whole clans and build your career from an ordinary bandit (associate) to a capo, a consigliere and finally a Don.
Exciting shootouts and chases, all kinds of rivals (from petty criminals to powerful bosses), and different locations as well as various suits and weapons are waiting for you in this dangerous game mission.
Your arsenal includes a sniper rifle and Thompson submachine gun – use these guns to fight for domination of your clan. You may also use enhanced shots to increase damage: buckshot, double shot, blast chuck, shoсk shot.
You will have to struggle not only in the city locations (on the streets, dark alleys, roofs, in residential districts), but also in more unusual and interesting places like warehouses, industrial areas, parking lots, casinos, suburbs, and even forests.
Always be careful with civilians - if you accidentally kill them, you will be punished. As punishment, you will lose some of your money and you will be highly wanted - so, more cops and federal agents are going to hunt you.
In-game shopping offers you a range of perks:
- small and big first-aid kit;
- light and heavy armor;
- talents/skills (fast recharge, an ability to earn more money for murders, additional set of bullets);
- small and big bribes for cops to decrease the wanted level.
Survive on the streets full of crime and hostility, target and kill your enemies to take control over the city.
Impressive animation and characters, atmospheric music and sound effects will let you dive in these old days of mafia rules.
Work up your courage and begin the great confrontation. It will be long and hard... So, win or die!

bluejetty:00181118:ios.description:
Ball Sort Puzzle – Egg Sort, a color sorting game, is a fun and relaxing game that entertains and stimulates your brain! Quickly sort the colored balls in the tubes until all the same colors are together in the same tube. A challenging yet relaxing game to exercise your brain!
HOW TO PLAY:
• Tap any tube to move the ball on top of any tube into another tube
• Only balls of the same color can be put on top of each others.
• You can’t put more ball(s) into a tube when it is full
• You can always restart the level at any time or retrace your steps one by one using the Undo button.
• Stack all the balls with the same color into a single tube.
• If you get really stuck you can add a tube to make it easier.
• Think ahead and derive your own strategy to solve the puzzle.
• Keep calm and sort it!
FEATURES:
• Free & easy to play.
• One finger control.
• No time limit!
• No level limit!
• Offline games, play offline without Wifi.
• Easy and addictive gameplay!
• Improve your logic and concentration
• Great game to pass time & it makes you think!

bluejetty:00069765:ios.description:
Do you enjoy writing a diary and keeping track of your memories? Do you need a safe place for all your private notes and thoughts? And what is more, you can get a customized diary and make it look just the way you want! This application does just that! My Super Secret Diary is an application that allows you to write a real diary. It offers you a calendar so that you can choose the exact day on which something you want to memorize happened to you. Beside that, you can attach photos to your memory, either from your gallery or take a photo right away from the app. There are also many cute emoticons to fulfill your diary page, which can be transformed by one of our beautiful designs created just for you!
FEATURES:
*** Lock option – with a pattern, touch ID or a pin code
*** Calendar view and a list of all your writings
*** Search option to easily find a certain writing
*** Different fonts and text colors
*** Colorful, wonderfully designed papers for your diary pages
*** Start and end date of a memory, tittles, emoticons and photos
*** Your memories are saved on iCloud so that they are available on both your iPhone or iPad
*** If you want, you can share your memory on all major social networks
If you need to protect your private writings from everyone else, this app is the right thing for you. Beside notes, it also keeps photos that you attach to your memory and all of that is permanently saved on iCloud. You can also choose the way you lock your app – with a pattern, touch ID or a pin code so that you make sure that nobody is going to read your private notes.
Download this app and start collecting your memories, thoughts and secrets now!

bluejetty:00131867:ios.summary:
Want to have a personal DJ? Try Offtrack for FREE. Mix the best part of your songs with smooth transitions on Spotify Premium, Apple Music, TIDAL, SoundCloud Free & local MP3s.
People skip half of the songs they play, like more than 500,00
bluejetty:00131867:ios.description:
Want to have a personal DJ? Try Offtrack for FREE. Mix the best part of your songs with smooth transitions on Spotify Premium, Apple Music, TIDAL, SoundCloud Free & local MP3s.
People skip half of the songs they play, like more than 500,000,000,000 songs every year. Why? Because songs are too long, shuffle ruins the vibe, and you listen to the same playlist over and over again.
Listen seamlessly with your AI DJ. Shorten your songs with smooth transitions so that your music will come to life.
The party doesn’t stop between tracks so why should the music? Offtrack picks the best fade-in and fade-out points, then seamlessly transitions automatically between tracks. Since most songs are too long, Offtrack plays the best 25-50% of a song as a highlight. Swipe to the queue page and you’ll see that the song order has already been optimized for you. There’s a surprise waiting for you every time you Smart Mix® with unique transitions and refreshing song mashups.
Making a mix with your own music has never been easier. Simply sync with your streaming service, press Smart Mix® and vibe out to your personal mix. Offtrack works with Spotify Premium, SoundCloud Free, TIDAL, Apple Music or your local library, and on Apple CarPlay.
So relax and enjoy your seamless mix while barely lifting a finger. Let your AI DJ take care of the music.
Offtrack Integrations
• Spotify Premium: Partial catalogue with ~80% of songs in popular playlists
• Apple Music: Partial catalogue with ~80% of songs in popular playlists
• TIDAL HiFi: Full catalogue of 100 Millions of HiFi tracks
• SoundCloud Free: Mix with 200 million tracks with your SoundCloud Free account (Go+ tracks currently unavailable)
• Local Music Library: Mix and beat-match local tracks
• iPhone/iPad/Macs with M chips
• Apple CarPlay
Offtrack is the only fully automatic DJ app today that works with both Spotify Premium and Apple Music with limited number of tracks. We recommend that you switch to TIDAL HiFi if having the full music catalogue is important for you.
The optional Offtrack Pro subscription allows you to subscribe once and use Offtrack Pro across your Mac and iOS devices to gain access to all Offtrack Pro features. You can cancel anytime – there is no cancellation fee.
Please check our FAQ page www.offtrack.com/faq for more information, or contact support@offtrack.com for support.
Offtrack Terms of Service:
https://www.offtrack.com/tos/
Offtrack Privacy Policy:
https://www.offtrack.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00076183:ios.name: Compass 55. Map & GPS kit.
bluejetty:00076183:ios.summary:
Compass 55 is an offline-capable GPS map and navigation toolkit for hiking, off-road travel, fieldwork, aviation, and marine use—with a compass, waypoints, routes, coordinate tools, and video recording.
+ Advanced target/waypoint editor. C
bluejetty:00076183:ios.description:
Compass 55 is an offline-capable GPS map and navigation toolkit for hiking, off-road travel, fieldwork, aviation, and marine use—with a compass, waypoints, routes, coordinate tools, and video recording.
+ Advanced target/waypoint editor. Can be also used as a coordinates converter. You can use map to check or set waypoint location and add photo or audio note.
+ Share your location via email, text message, Facebook or Twitter. This includes UTM, MGRS and Latitude/Longitude (MENU>Share my location).
+ You can use UTM, MGRS or Lat/Long, just pick your preference in settings (Coordinate Format).
+ Speedometer. Shows you the speed and pace. Speedometer also gives you options to control average and max speed and pace counters (MENU > RESET and PAUSE/RESUME counters).
+ Compass. Instant reaction compass, no delays. Automatically pickups the direction based on magnetic or GPS course. If you mostly walk or drive, you can change this automatic mode in app settings > Compass or GPS course. NATO mils? Same place in settings to set.
+ Magnetic declination δ for the current location and any location on the map (via World Magnetic Model, WMM, no need for data/internet).
+ Sunset and sunrise. So you can plan your travel better.
+ Arrow pointing to your target waypoint. Distance and bearing to it.
+ Create/measure routes and areas.
+ Barometric Vertical Speed Indicator (VSI, IVSI) in both scale and graph forms.
+ Integration of bluetooth sensors: Cycling cadence, Heart rate, Cycling speed.
+ Video recording for action and fieldwork. Add real-time G-Cross, map, QR code, and pitch & roll overlays as needed, then replay your recordings. The basic version stores one video and exports a branded 15-second clip.
All above belong to a basic version. PRO Pack upgrade will add following capabilities:
+ Recording and sharing GPS tracks.
+ Moving waypoints between folders.
+ Showing ETA to a target as this requires GPS tracking.
+ Native Google map with fantastic terrain map, amazing 3D and real night mode.
+ Adding own/custom tile map servers.
+ Downloading offline maps. Offline maps import in .sqlitedb, rmaps, mbtiles formats. Support for overzoom and underzoom - offline map is shown even for zoom levels that are not downloaded.
+ GPX import and export for waypoints, tracks and routes. 
+ Google Earth KML support for waypoints and tracks import/export. KMZ support for waypoints and tracks export, waypoints import.
+ Ground overlays. Import KMZ ground overlay or draw your own on the map in the app and share as kmz files!
+ CSV import/export for waypoints.
+ Voice coach to tell you active track distance and duration, current speed and altitude without need to open the app.
+ Support for Siri shortcuts in IOS 12 for starting and stopping GPS tracks.
+ From version 4.2 - support for OSGB (including grid shifts) and SK 42 in the coordinates converter.
+ Unlimited saved videos and full-length exports of stamped or original video.
+ BACKGROUND MODE. App will work in background automatically when tracking. You can use other apps while Compass 55 does its job in the background!
+ PRIVACY. Compass 55 never shares your location data with 3rd parties or ad agencies. Location data is used solely for telling you direction to a target and recording GPS tracks and never leave the app unless you decide to share by means of a track export. It always lets you know when background mode is on and never runs in background unless the track is being recorded.
! You can use this app on your iPhone as well as on any cellular iPad. **App will not work properly on iPods and wifi only iPads as they don't have GPS (external GPS module is required). As quite a lot of us are using external GPS modules, app is available for wifi only iPads and iPods.
! Please note that as with all GPS apps, continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

- Members-only rewards

bluejetty:00127355:ios.name: Kegel Exercises Pelvic Floor
bluejetty:00127355:ios.summary:
Kegel Exercise Trainer — Pelvic Floor Workout for Men & Women
Strengthen your pelvic floor muscles in just 3–9 minutes a day with guided Kegel exercises. Whether you want to improve bladder control, support postpartum recovery, or enhance
bluejetty:00127355:ios.description:
Kegel Exercise Trainer — Pelvic Floor Workout for Men & Women
Strengthen your pelvic floor muscles in just 3–9 minutes a day with guided Kegel exercises. Whether you want to improve bladder control, support postpartum recovery, or enhance intimate wellness, this personal Kegel trainer walks you through every step.
Why Kegel Exercises?
Pelvic floor muscles support the bladder, uterus, and bowels. Regular Kegel training may help:
- Improve bladder control and reduce urinary incontinence
- Support postpartum recovery and ease labor discomfort
- Enhance intimate wellness and sexual health for both men and women
- Lower the risk of pelvic organ prolapse
For Men
- Personal pelvic floor exercise trainer
- Support prostate health and sexual wellness
- Step-by-step guidance to locate and engage the right muscles
For Women
- Designed for pregnancy, postpartum, and everyday wellness
- Guided routines to strengthen pelvic floor muscles
- Track your progress over time
Smart & Discreet
- Silent mode with vibration cues — exercise anytime, anywhere
- Discreet app icon for complete privacy
- Customizable daily reminders so you never miss a session
Guided Training for All Levels
- 10 progressive levels from beginner to advanced
- Visual, vibration, and voice guides to help you perform correctly
- Workout intensity increases gradually as you improve
- Progress tracking with easy-to-read charts
- Sync with Apple Health
Personalize Your Experience
- Multiple themes to choose from
- Flexible reminder scheduling
What Are Kegel Exercises?
Kegel exercises strengthen the pelvic floor by repeatedly contracting and relaxing specific muscles. They are widely recommended by healthcare professionals for bladder control, pelvic support, and intimate health.
This app is for informational purposes only and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. The health information presented is based on published medical literature (see sources below). Please consult a qualified healthcare professional before starting any exercise program or making any medical decisions.
Sources
Mayo Clinic — "Kegel exercises: A how-to guide for women" (mayoclinic.org)
National Institutes of Health — "Pelvic Floor Disorders" (niddk.nih.gov)
NHS — "Pelvic floor exercises" (nhs.uk)

bluejetty:00187630:ios.description:
Turn meaningful goals into daily progress
Goals Wizard is a personal growth planner that helps bring structure, clarity, and consistency to the areas of life that matter most.
Set meaningful goals, break them into milestones, build supportive habits and routines, plan each day with intention, and stay connected to real progress over time.
Whether the focus is career, health, finances, relationships, or personal growth, Goals Wizard helps turn long-term vision into practical action.
Designed for more than simple task management, Goals Wizard combines goal planning, daily structure, habits, routines, journaling, and reflection in one guided system.
- Set meaningful goals with clarity
- Break big goals into manageable steps
- Build habits and routines that support progress
- Plan days and weeks with more intention
- Stay focused, organized, and consistent
- Reflect, reset, and keep moving forward
FEATURES
> Create long-term goals with milestones, tasks, habits, routines, notes, and reflections
> Choose from ready-made templates, AI-assisted setup, or manual planning
> Organize one-time and recurring tasks in a clear daily planner
> Build stronger consistency with habit tracking and routine planning
> Use weekly planning and calendar views to stay aligned with priorities
> Capture thoughts, lessons, and ideas with notes and journaling
> Stay intentional with reflection tools and guided check-ins
> Sync seamlessly across iPhone, iPad, and Web
*****
Progress does not come from good intentions alone. It comes from having a clear plan and following through, one day at a time.
Goals Wizard helps create that structure, making it easier to stay focused, build momentum, and make meaningful progress in everyday life.
Download Goals Wizard and start building better habits, clearer plans, and stronger follow-through.
*****
Goals Wizard is free to download and use. Goals Wizard Premium unlocks enhanced features and functionality, including unlimited goals, habits, and routines. Premium also includes full access to the complete Goals Wizard experience across all supported platforms.
Our Terms of Use: https://www.goalswizard.com/terms
Our Privacy Policy: https://www.goalswizard.com/privacy

bluejetty:00126402:ios.description:
Discover a New Level of Convenience with Hubtel!
Hubtel is your one-stop app for fast and reliable delivery, seamless payments, and essential services—all tailored for a soft life in Ghana.
What You Can Do with Hubtel:
Fast & Reliable Delivery
Order Food, groceries, and essentials from local favorites and get them delivered to your doorstep in no time!
Send Money, Hassle-Free
Transfer money instantly across all networks and banks using MoMo wallets like MTN Mobile Money, AirtelTigo, and Telecel Cash.
Pay Bills, Stress-Free
Take care of everyday bills like ECG, Ghana Water, DSTV, and more—directly from the app.
Insure Your Car Instantly
Skip the queues and buy your car insurance sticker in just a few taps.
Buy Now, Pay Small Small
Buy what you need now and pay later in easy weekly installments.
Find Some of Your Favorite Local Shops and Restaurants
Some of our shops and food delivery partners include: Melcom, KFC, Pizzaman Chickenman, Papaye, RocoMamas
More than Just Delivery
Hubtel lets you order food and groceries, send money, pay bills, and even buy your car insurance sticker—all in one app!
Why Hubtel?
Hubtel is more than just a delivery app; it’s your essential partner for daily life in Ghana. We combine fast and reliable delivery with secure payments and a host of convenient services, making your life easier and more efficient.
Download Hubtel today and experience a new level of convenience!

bluejetty:00079821:android.description:
UNLEASH THE MAGIC!
Embark on an epic journey through a mystical realm filled with wonders and dangers in AFK Magic, the ultimate character collector RPG game! Dive into a world where magic reigns supreme, and heroes are forged in the fires of destiny. Are you ready to assemble your team of legendary champions and unleash the power of magic against relentless foes?
COLLECT AND CONQUER

bluejetty:00033551:ios.description:
Entrena para sentirte más fuerte, mejorar tu salud y mantener la constancia sin importar tu nivel o tu objetivo.
Tanto si entrenas en gimnasio como en casa, quieres correr tu primera carrera, ganar fuerza, mejorar tu condición física o retomar el ejercicio, en Saiyan Workout encontrarás un plan adaptado a ti.
Más de 80 entrenamientos, guías y retos diseñados por profesionales con un enfoque centrado en la salud, el rendimiento y el bienestar femenino.
¿QUÉ ENCONTRARÁS EN SAIYAN WORKOUT?
• Entrenamientos de fuerza, running, HIIT, cardio, y movilidad.
• Programas de entrenamiento específicos: híbrido, hyrox, calistenia, pliometría…
• Planes de pérdida de grasa
• Preparación física para oposiciones
• Programas específicos para embarazo y postparto
• Retos de carrera para 5K, 10K, media maratón y maratón
• Ebooks sobre entrenamiento, nutrición y salud
UNA APP QUE SE ADAPTA A TI
Filtra los entrenamientos según tu objetivo, nivel, tiempo disponible o lugar de entrenamiento.
Entrenes donde entrenes, encontrarás opciones adaptadas a tus necesidades:
• Gimnasio, casa o exterior
• Principiante, intermedio o avanzado
• Sesiones rápidas o programas completos
• Objetivos de fuerza, pérdida de grasa, resistencia, salud, movilidad o masa muscular.
Además, podrás organizar tus semanas con un calendario totalmente personalizable para combinar entrenamientos, mover sesiones, modificar descansos y seguir tu propio ritmo.
ENFOQUE EN SALUD FEMENINA
Sabemos que la salud va mucho más allá del físico.
Por eso encontrarás contenido y programas pensados para acompañarte en diferentes etapas de la vida de la mujer, incluyendo embarazo y postparto, además de recursos educativos basados en evidencia científica sobre entrenamiento, nutrición y salud femenina.
ENTRENA CON SEGURIDAD Y PROGRESA
Cada sesión incluye:
• Vídeos con el movimiento de cada ejercicio
• Indicaciones técnicas detalladas
• Series, repeticiones y descansos
• Registro de progreso para seguir tu evolución
Todo diseñado para que sepas exactamente qué hacer en cada entrenamiento.
APRENDE Y FORMA PARTE DE LA COMUNIDAD
Saiyan Workout no es solo una app de entrenamiento.
Accede a ebooks y recursos educativos sobre entrenamiento, nutrición y hábitos saludables, y conecta con una comunidad exclusiva donde compartir experiencias, resolver dudas y recibir apoyo de nuestro equipo de entrenadores y nutricionistas.
* Comunidad sólo disponible con el plan semestral.
ENTRENAMIENTO BASADO EN EVIDENCIA
Cada entrenamiento que verás en la app ha sido diseñado por un equipo profesional especializado en cada ámbito o disciplina. Siempre basados en la última evidencia científica.
SUSCRIPCIONES
Saiyan Workout funciona mediante un modelo de suscripción, encontrarás:
• Plan mensual
• Plan semestral
Los nuevos usuarios pueden disfrutar de una prueba GRATIS de 7 días al elegir el plan semestral.
La suscripción se renueva automáticamente al finalizar el periodo contratado, salvo cancelación previa desde tu cuenta de App Store. Puedes gestionar o cancelar tu suscripción en cualquier momento.
Términos y condiciones: https://thesaiyankiwi.com/terminos-y-condiciones
Política de privacidad: https://thesaiyankiwi.com/politica-privacidad
Si tienes cualquier duda o necesitas soporte puedes contactarnos a través de ayuda@thesaiyankiwi.com
Eres más que un cuerpo, somos más que una app.

bluejetty:00186822:ios.name: Celestron SkyPortal
bluejetty:00186822:ios.summary: Celestron’s newest planetarium app is an astronomy suite that redefines how you experience the night sky. Explore the Solar System, 120,000 stars, over 200 star clusters, nebulae, galaxies, and dozens of asteroids, comets, and satellites—i
bluejetty:00186822:ios.description:
Celestron’s newest planetarium app is an astronomy suite that redefines how you experience the night sky. Explore the Solar System, 120,000 stars, over 200 star clusters, nebulae, galaxies, and dozens of asteroids, comets, and satellites—including the ISS. SkyPortal includes everything you need to experience the night sky in an exciting new way. When connected to a compatible Celestron WiFi telescope, you can automatically point the telescope to any object in the database and view it with great detail.
Planetarium Features
Simulate the night sky and plan your observing session with a custom list of tonight’s best objects based on your exact time and location. Look ahead to see when Jupiter’s Great Red Spot will be visible, animate transits, eclipses, and other celestial events. View hundreds of photos or listen to more than four hours of audio narration to enhance your stargazing experience.
•Simulate the night sky from anywhere on planet Earth, up to 100 years in the past or future.
•Compass Mode (with compatible devices): Hold your device up to the sky for a real-time synchronized display of celestial objects – from star names, constellations, planets, to nebulae and galaxies. 
•Control compatible Celestron WiFi telescopes with sophisticated mount modeling for quick and accurate go-to alignment.
•Animate transits, conjunctions, eclipses, and other events with SkyPortal's Time controls.
•Explore the sky with Night Vision turned on, and preserve your eyesight after dark.
•Learn the history, mythology, and science of the heavens with SkyPortal's hundreds of object descriptions.
•Browse hundreds of astronomical photographs and NASA spacecraft images
•Access over 4 hours of audio commentary to guide you through the best celestial objects.
Computerized Telescope Control
Pair your device to your compatible Celestron WiFi telescope, align with Celestron’s patented SkyAlign™ technology, and you’re ready to explore! Identify objects instantly. Tap any object and your telescope automatically centers it in the eyepiece.
SkyPortal’s telescope alignment incorporates advanced mount modeling, providing better pointing accuracy than other telescope systems which rely on a dedicated computer.

bluejetty:00160830:ios.summary: Clideo Video Editor is an all-in-one, cross-platform app for creating and editing videos. Work in an intuitive multi-track timeline, add subtitles, generate videos, images, and audio with AI, and enhance your projects with transitions and a
bluejetty:00160830:ios.description:
Clideo Video Editor is an all-in-one, cross-platform app for creating and editing videos. Work in an intuitive multi-track timeline, add subtitles, generate videos, images, and audio with AI, and enhance your projects with transitions and animations.
KEY FEATURES
• Synchronize and access your projects in the app and web version of Clideo
• Combine multiple clips, images, text, and music in one video
• Use a collection with free stock videos, images, and music
• Generate videos, images, and audio with AI and add them directly to your projects
• Add smooth transitions between photos, videos, and GIFs
• Animate how individual photos, videos, and GIFs appear and disappear
• Record your own voice or use text-to-speech to create AI voiceovers
• Auto-generate subtitles from your video, transcribe manually, or upload a subtitle file
• Add text to your video and customize it
• Overlay stickers, GIFs, emojis, and shapes
• Crop, trim, duplicate, and split clips and audio as you need
• Change volume, slow down or speed up video and audio
• Adjust brightness, contrast, and blur videos
• Add freeze frames and customize their appearance
• Clean up audio by reducing background noise
• Change the position and size of the elements as you like
• Make picture-in-picture and split-screen videos
• Create a video collage or video slideshow out of images and videos
• Make square, vertical, or landscape clips
• Undo changes and restore trimmed or deleted parts of your clips at any time
• Send files to the app using the standard iOS Share menu
• Save projects as videos or animated GIF images
• Edit videos offline and online
• Use one subscription for both the app and web version
SUBSCRIPTION
• You can use the app completely free of charge. Subscribe to Clideo Pro to remove watermarks, upload files larger than 500 MB, and save in FHD or 4K.
• Monthly and yearly subscriptions.
• Subscriptions include credits for AI video, image, and audio generation.
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes account once the purchase is confirmed.
• Your subscription will renew automatically unless you turn it off in your iTunes account.
• If you cancel your subscription, auto-renewal will be disabled, but the subscription will be active until the end of the already paid period.
Terms of Use: https://clideo.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://clideo.com/privacy

bluejetty:00095426:ios.description:
Discover the world of coins effortlessly with Coin & Value Identifier - Coinly. Identify, evaluate, and learn instantly. 
Coin Scanner is your all-in-one app for discovering and understanding coins from around the globe. Whether you're a seasoned collector or just getting started, our app provides accurate coin identification, detailed information, and expert insights, all in one place. With Coinly, you can explore the hidden stories of coins, understand their value, and grow your collection with confidence. Easy to use and packed with features, this app is the perfect partner for coin enthusiasts everywhere.
Key Features:
- Coin Identification
Use advanced scanning technology to instantly identify coins just by pointing your camera. Detects details like country of origin, denomination, and year of minting.
- Main Coin Information
Access essential details about each coin, including historical background and usage.
- Reference Price Range
Get an accurate range of estimated values for your coin, tailored to its condition.
- Expert Insights
Learn from professional appraisers and collectors through curated insights designed to deepen your understanding.
- Coin Descriptions
Read rich, engaging descriptions that bring the history of your coins to life.
- Interesting Facts
Unlock fascinating trivia and stories about the coins in your collection.
- Premium Subscription
Take your coin-collecting adventure to the next level with Coin Scanner Premium!
Premium Subscription
By subscribing, you’ll benefit from advanced tools and enhanced features that provide a deeper understanding of your collection. Whether you’re appraising high-value coins, seeking historical insights, or simply scanning for fun, the Premium plan offers unparalleled access to expert knowledge and a seamless, distraction-free experience.
Why Coinly?
Coin Scanner is more than an identifier; it’s a gateway to the fascinating history locked within coins. Each scan connects you to a treasure trove of stories, allowing you to appreciate every coin in a whole new way. From hobbyists to professional collectors, Coin Scanner combines intuitive technology with in-depth knowledge to deliver a seamless experience.
Start Collecting Smarter
Whether you’re exploring a family heirloom, checking market trends, or building your collection, Coin Scanner gives you the tools to succeed. Download Coin Scanner today and bring the fascinating history and value of coins into your hands.
Download Coin & Value Identifier - Coinly now and explore a world of coins with one easy app! Analyze, learn, and grow your coin collection like never before.
Subscription Details:
Your iTunes Account will be charged upon purchase confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in Account Settings. Any unused trial portion is forfeited upon purchasing a premium subscription.
Terms of Use: https://coins-scanner.app/tou
Privacy Policy: https://coins-scanner.app/pp
Support: support@coins-scanner.app

bluejetty:00120091:ios.summary: Join 65,000 of your colleagues and subscribe to the #1 online medical education platform in the world. Gone are the days when you had to buy multiple products from different vendors. With EM:RAP you gain access to everything you will ever n
bluejetty:00120091:ios.description:
Join 65,000 of your colleagues and subscribe to the #1 online medical education platform in the world. Gone are the days when you had to buy multiple products from different vendors. With EM:RAP you gain access to everything you will ever need throughout your career, all for one low price.
Because what you do matters!
AUDIO PODCASTS
Our emergency medicine, urgent care, and primary care audio programs have something for everyone. Just starting out? Our Comprehensive Core Curriculum (C3) has you covered for all of the most common presentations to the Emergency Department and Urgent Care. More of a seasoned vet? There is a reason our flagship EM:RAP podcast is the #1 EM audio program: it is full of cutting-edge updates from the specialty’s leading voices. Looking to expand your Urgent Care knowledge? UC Max has you covered!
HD VIDEOS
Can’t remember exactly how to execute that tricky procedure? Have no fear, our HD video section is filled with expertly-shot procedure videos and expert commentary. We also regularly host live shows to cover topics of interest. Additionally, we are building a robust library of video courses and lectures so you visual learners can deep dive into specific topics of interest.
BOARD REVIEW
Our Crunch Time audio product is a comprehensive board review course for MDs, RNs, PAs, NPs, and students of all types. We even have separate versions for both Emergency Medicine and Family Medicine!
LIFELONG LEARNING AND SELF-ASSESSMENT (LLSA)
Our reviews of LLSA papers cut straight to the chase. Listen to the audio and take the attached quiz, and you’ll be ready to ace the ABEM LLSA exam!
LITERATURE REVIEWS
Our Emergency Medical Abstracts team analyzes over 600 papers each month, so you don’t have to! And we dissect and summarize the best of these abstracts so you have the very best-available information for your practice.
PRIMARY CARE
Right on Prime is our comprehensive monthly audio series for the generalist. Primary care, urgent care, low-risk obstetrics, pediatrics, rural, remote and international medicine, paper reviews, and much more!
URGENT CARE
UC Maximus has revolutionized Urgent Care education. Your membership unlocks exclusive access to a comprehensive suite of UC educational products.
ABOUT EM:RAP
For twenty years, Emergency Medicine: Reviews and Perspectives (EM:RAP) has provided the EM community with the highest-quality medical education resources. Now the leaders in the field, the name EM:RAP has become synonymous with EM education. EM:RAP’s UC Maximus platform will do the same for Urgent Care. Our goal is to provide you with a one-stop for all your educational needs. With your EM:RAP subscription you gain access to everything you will ever need throughout your career, all for one low price.

2. Perfect jump gives a higher score and gold reward.
3. Use your gold to unlock more skins.

bluejetty:00185814:ios.summary:
The Burraco game you love. Since 2012, always with you: play without limits, wherever you are!
You may know it as Burraco, Buraco, or Canasta, but one thing is certain: it's one of the most beloved card games of all time. Choose from 6 gam
bluejetty:00185814:ios.description:
The Burraco game you love. Since 2012, always with you: play without limits, wherever you are!
You may know it as Burraco, Buraco, or Canasta, but one thing is certain: it's one of the most beloved card games of all time. Choose from 6 game modes with different rules, play for free on your phone, and have fun with real players and the smoothest gameplay there is.
The most traditional online Burraco app goes with you wherever you are.
Play BurracoON and find real players ready for a match. Team up with a partner, build your canastas, and experience all the strategy and fun of one of the world's favorite card games.
Getting started is easy: you can jump in and play without creating an account.
THE SMOOTHEST, MOST REALISTIC GAMEPLAY
At BurracoON, we're dedicated to creating the experience closest to the real thing: the texture of the table, the rule variations, and an efficient, refined simplicity that will remind you of playing with friends.
ZOOM AND MOVE CARDS SMOOTHLY
Hold your finger on the cards to zoom in and move them freely, bringing the experience as close to real life as possible.
ONLINE BURRACO WITH REAL PLAYERS
Nothing beats the thrill of playing against a real person. Find opponents online, build your strategy, and find out who rules the table.
JUMP IN AND PLAY
Just want to play a quick match? Then play. No account needed to get started. Our interface is smooth, lightweight, and straight to the point — the shortest path to the fun.
CHALLENGE YOUR COMPETITIVE SPIRIT ON THE LEADERBOARD
Every match is a new chance to show your skills. Climb the rankings and track your progress.
CHAT WHILE YOU PLAY
Burraco is also about conversation, friendly banter, and good stories. Use the in-game chat and meet other fans of the game.
JUST THE WAY BURRACO PLAYERS KNOW IT
An experience built to respect the classic, preserve the true dynamics of a Burraco match, and bring the joy of sitting down at the table for a good game to your screen.
Burraco, buraco, canasta... it doesn't matter what you call it.
If you've got cards in hand, a canasta on the table, and a good partner across from you, you're in the right place.
Download BurracoON, pick your table, and start playing.
