Explore More & Travel Better with Tripio
Tripio is your all-in-one travel companion that helps you effortlessly plan epic adventures, track where you’ve been, and discover where to go next — all in seconds. Whether you’re creating a custom trip from scratch or tweaking an itinerary from another traveler, Tripio makes trip planning fast, fun, and personal.
Because you deserve more than just pins on a map, endless spreadsheets and hours of research — you deserve a travel experience built around you.
 Key Features:
Search 200+ destinations worldwide
Explore the world with Tripio’s massive library of destinations — from iconic capitals to remote wonders.
Smart itinerary builder
Build your perfect trip in less than 60 seconds, or copy one of 1,000+ existing itineraries and customize it to fit your style.
Custom Rankings
Instantly discover top experiences based on your preferences and interests.
Been There, Done That
Check off places you’ve visited and view your travel history on an interactive world map.
Bucket List Builder
Save dream experiences and watch your future travel goals take shape.
Visualize your trips on a map
See your itineraries laid out beautifully on the world map.
Earn travel badges
Get rewarded for completing trips, adding bucket list items, exploring new experiences, connecting with other travelers & more.
Trip Notes
Add hotels, flights, car hire information & packing lists along with attaching tickets to each activity in your itinerary— everything you need, all in one place.
Turn-by-turn directions
Get from one activity to the next without leaving the app.
Collaborative trip planning
Invite friends or family to edit your itinerary or view it in real time.
One-tap itinerary copying
Copy someone’s trip with a tap, tweak the details, and make it your own.
Share everything with a tap
Easily share itineraries, activities, and destinations.
Explore 27,000+ activities worldwide
Use filters like Easy Adventure, Moderate Adventure, Intense Adventure, Art, History, Culture, Instagram-Worthy, Good Eats, and Nightlife.
Fun Fact:
The average person spends 30 hours planning a trip. With Tripio, you can do it in 30 seconds. We’ve done the research — all you have to do is explore.
Terms of Use (EULA):

bluejetty:00088280:ios.summary:
A world clock app for the people in your life. For iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac.
Whether your family is spread across countries or your team is split across time zones, World Time Widget keeps you thoughtfully in sync. Add
bluejetty:00088280:ios.description:
A world clock app for the people in your life. For iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac.
Whether your family is spread across countries or your team is split across time zones, World Time Widget keeps you thoughtfully in sync. Add clocks for the cities that matter, give each one a name that means something to you, and know at a glance whether it’s a good time to reach out.
Over one million downloads.
WORLD CLOCKS
See the time in any city, instantly. Add as many clocks as you need and label them the way you actually think of them: “Mum in Sydney”, “Berlin office”, “Charlie deployed.”
HOME SCREEN, LOCK SCREEN & STANDBY
Your most important world times are always one glance away — no need to open the app. Widgets for every Apple surface, with up to 8 time zones on a single large widget.
DAY & NIGHT STATE
Every clock shows whether it’s day or night for the person on the other end. So you know before you text.
MEETING PLANNER
Need to find a time that works across time zones? Drag through the day to find the right slot, without the mental arithmetic.
APPLE WATCH
Your world clocks on your wrist. A dedicated Apple Watch app and support for multiple complications keep your times visible wherever you are.
IPHONE, IPAD & APPLE WATCH
Works beautifully across all your Apple devices, with your clocks syncing seamlessly via iCloud. No ads, no sign up. Just your clocks.
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Does World Time Widget have a home screen widget?
Yes. There are widgets for every Apple surface: home screen, lock screen, StandBy mode, and Apple Watch. You can show up to 8 time zones on a single large widget, so everything you need is one glance away.
Can I use custom labels instead of city names?
Yes. You can name any clock whatever makes sense to you. “Mum in Sydney” tells you at a glance whether it’s safe to call. “Dev team in Berlin” tells you whether they’re in the office. Your clocks, your labels.
Does it work on Apple Watch?
Yes. There’s a dedicated Apple Watch app plus support for multiple complications, so your world clocks are always on your wrist.
Can I convert time zones and schedule meetings?
Yes. The built-in meeting planner lets you drag across the day to find a time that works for everyone, across as many time zones as you need. No mental arithmetic, no switching between apps.
How many cities can I add?
As many as you need. You can show up to 8 time zones at once on a large widget, and you can add more clocks to the app itself.
Does it handle daylight saving time automatically?
Yes. World Time Widget updates automatically for daylight saving changes worldwide, so your times are always accurate.
Does it work on iPad as well as iPhone?
Yes. World Time Widget works across iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Your clocks sync across all your devices via iCloud.
What makes it different from Apple’s Clock app?
Apple’s Clock app is useful, but limited. World Time Widget adds a day/night indicator for every clock so you can see at a glance who’s awake, lets you use personal labels instead of city names, and puts your world clocks on your home screen, lock screen, StandBy, and Apple Watch with far more flexibility. Apple Clock also caps out at 4 cities in a widget. World Time Widget shows up to 8.
Is there a free version?
World Time Widget is free to download with a premium upgrade available for additional features.
Terms of service: https://world-time.app/terms.pdf
Privacy policy: https://www.iubenda.com/privacy-policy/68114171

bluejetty:00033752:ios.summary:
You play the role of a game developer tasked by a secret organization to repair a lost platformer game from 1976 that seems way too advanced for its time. But is it really just a game?
A chilling homage to retro gaming – Rediscover the mag
bluejetty:00033752:ios.description:
You play the role of a game developer tasked by a secret organization to repair a lost platformer game from 1976 that seems way too advanced for its time. But is it really just a game?
A chilling homage to retro gaming – Rediscover the magic of classic games and retro platformers with a terrifying twist. SPOOKY PIXEL HORROR combines the beloved aesthetics of vintage 2D pixel games with a deeply immersive horror narrative that will keep you on edge. 
Intense gameplay – Navigate through 120 challenging levels filled with traps and mind-bending puzzles that will make some players rage. Every step brings you closer to uncovering the dark origins of the game, but beware – the deeper you go, the more dangerous this nightmare becomes.
Atmospheric and nostalgic visuals – Experience a beautifully crafted mix of 1-bit and 8-bit pixel art that captures the eerie aesthetic of the vintage 70s and 80s gaming era.
Uncover the hidden story – As you progress, piece together the sinister backstory of the game. Encounter pixelated spirits, ghostly glitches, and Lovecraftian horrors lurking within the code. Can you survive the nightmare and reveal the truth? 
Key Features:
• Retro Pixel Art: Immerse yourself in nostalgic graphics and pixel art that blend nostalgia with spine-tingling nightmares, bringing an eerie world to life.
• Challenging Platforming: Test your skills with platformer levels filled with rage-inducing traps and puzzles.
• Haunting Narrative: Unravel a compelling story that blends retro charm with modern horror elements.
Step into the shoes of a hero battling through a 2D nightmare, where every glitch and ghostly encounter brings you closer to the truth. SPOOKY PIXEL HORROR is a journey into the heart of retro horror.

bluejetty:00184740:ios.name: Star Traders: Frontiers
bluejetty:00184740:ios.summary: You are the captain of a starship venturing through a massive open universe. Customize your crew and take command at the helm of your very own ship as you explore a galaxy torn apart by internal strife, alien threats, and political intrigue
bluejetty:00184740:ios.description:
You are the captain of a starship venturing through a massive open universe. Customize your crew and take command at the helm of your very own ship as you explore a galaxy torn apart by internal strife, alien threats, and political intrigue.
Command your ship and crew as a space pirate, merchant, bounty hunter, and more in Star Traders: Frontiers – an epic space RPG from Trese Brothers Games. Venture forth into a massive open universe, rich with adventure and the lore of the Star Traders. Choose your path by assembling and commanding your custom crew and spaceship in a constantly evolving galaxy torn by internal strife, political intrigue, and alien threats. Will you fly as a pirate terrorizing shipping lanes, join the solar wars as a military captain, or track targets across the stars as a fearsome bounty hunter?
 - Explore a rich, open universe: Discover endless procedurally-generated galactic maps, meet unique characters, and take on enemies to conquer the galaxy! 
 - Become an intergalactic captain: Take on the role of a spy, smuggler, explorer, pirate, merchant, bounty hunter, and more (26 jobs total)!
 - Customize your own spaceship: Choose from more than 350 upgrades and 45 ship hulls to build your very own vessel to venture across the vast reaches of space. 
 - Assemble and tailor a loyal crew: Assign talents and equip specialized gear for every spaceship crew member.
 - Experience an ever-changing narrative: Decide to make friends or foes with other factions and influence political, economic, and personal vendettas.
 - Mold the crew by your choices: As you make decisions and set the tone for your ship, your crew will grow and change to match. Destroy enemy ships with all hands on deck and your crew will become more bloodthirsty and savage. Explore distant worlds and loot dangerous wastelands and your crew will become intrepid and clever ... or scarred and half-mad.
 - Varied Difficulty Options! play with save slots to try out different builds or storylines or turn on character permadeath and enjoy classic roguelike experience
 - Achievement Unlocks: accomplish story and challenge goals to unlock additional optional (but not better) content like new starting ships and new starting contacts
First there was the Exodus – when survivors of a great war left the ruins of the Galactic Core behind in search of a new home in the stars. Scattered worlds were claimed on the fringe of the galaxy. Each pocket of survivors held on to an isolated set of worlds while trying to rebuild under the great law of Shalun. Three centuries later, technology has brought them back together again. Discovery of the hyperwarp has bridged what was once an unimaginable distance between far-flung colonies, long-lost families, and political factions. 
With that reunification has come great economic prosperity. The hyperwarp reestablished the transportation of cargo, goods, and technologies between the quadrants – but it has also brought great strife. Political rivalries have been rekindled, blood has been shed in age-old feuds, and the fires of war have been stoked. Amidst the political infighting, a ruthless revolution is rising – and the fervent explorers of the hyperwarp have awoken something that was better left asleep.
Our very first game, Star Traders RPG, took hundreds of thousands of gamers on an interstellar adventure. Star Traders’ success and overwhelmingly positive reception helped to launch Trese Brothers Games. It was the adventures of our community’s star-crossed captains that put us on a trajectory to share more of our worlds, ideas, and dreams.
We set out to capture the loneliness, bravery, and camaraderie of people living together in a spaceship sailing across the stars. It is with great pride that after releasing four other games in the Star Traders universe, we’ve created a sequel to the original Star Traders RPG. 
Step onto the bridge of your starship, take to the stars, and create your own story in Star Traders: Frontiers.

-Convert gems to money
-Convert money to gems

X950
X2000
Analyze the evolution of your gem and coin conversions through graphs

On the main screen of BSBlue gems stars converter you can find several graphs with the summaries of your expenses for the last 7 days. Analyze this information to manage your investment in gems in the best possible way.

bluejetty:00013770:ios.summary:
ABBYY Business Card Reader Pro –The World’s Fastest Business Card Scanner & Contact Management App for iPhone and iPad! 
Recommended by The New York Times, CNN, The Telegraph, Computer Business Review, Macworld. 
Winner of the RISING STAR
bluejetty:00013770:ios.description:
ABBYY Business Card Reader Pro –The World’s Fastest Business Card Scanner & Contact Management App for iPhone and iPad! 
Recommended by The New York Times, CNN, The Telegraph, Computer Business Review, Macworld. 
Winner of the RISING STAR Award in the Mobile Star Awards 
ABBYY Business Card Reader Pro easily & simply captures & stores contact from business cards in 25 languages to your iPhone and iPad. The recognized data can be saved in either your device contacts or the app digital storage.
KEY FEATURES
• QUICK AND ACCURATE SCANNING
ABBYYs optical character recognition technology provides quick & accurate recognition of all contact information: names, organizations, phone numbers, e-mail addresses, etc. 
• AUTO-CLICK PHOTO FEATURE
Automatically focuses on the business card, detects its edges, crops any extraneous background & captures an image of the card all by itself. 
• EASY CHECK OF RECOGNIZED DATA
The app highlights “unusual” characters with blue color and displays the original image so that you can quickly confirm the output of the app.
• APPLE WATCH APP. You won’t need to reach for your iPhone or iPad to remember somebody’s name. View contacts and make phone calls right from BCR on your Apple Watch! 
• AUTOMATIC NORMALIZATION OF PHONE AND EXTENTION NUMBERS
BCR will automatically put in all the missing parts so that you can reach the contact even if the country code was omitted in print. 
• AUTOCOMPLETION OF ADDRESSES
BCR corrects any typos and fills in the missing address fields so you can easily find it on the map.
• MANUAL BACKUPS. Manual backups to archive and restore to another device.
• Export contacts to Salesforce Leads (premium account required). BCR can export business cards to Enterprise, Unlimited, and Performance Editions of SF license. Professional Edition does not allow BCR export. 
• Set up voice commands in Siri Shortcuts app to open business cards by voicing the name of the owner.
• Spotlight Search to find business cards from BCR 
• Export business cards to MS Excel in .CSV format.
• Smart Facebook and LinkedIn search: connect social media account to the business card and auto upload photo of contact from Facebook.
• Search in iPhone Maps for the address of your contacts.
• Exchange digitally and forward recognized contacts via e-mail as VCard or JPEG files or via SMS as a plain text.
• Share your contacts using QR code.
• Support 25 languages including recognition of multilingual cards.

- Polish

- Ukrainian

bluejetty:00161484:ios.description:
Wi-Fi Analyzer is a powerful and intuitive Wi-Fi network analysis and monitoring app designed for users who want to get the most out of their internet connection. With Wi-Fi Analyzer, you can easily manage your network, identify potential issues, and optimize your connection.
Key Features:
Wi-Fi Network Scan: Quickly and efficiently scan available Wi-Fi networks in your area, displaying their parameters such as signal strength, encryption type, and channels.
Scan Results Update: Easily access up-to-date network information with the real-time scan results update feature.
Connection Path View: Track the path your device takes to Wi-Fi to understand how data flows through the network.
Detailed Network Overview: Get a complete picture of your network with information about your router, connected devices, and their activity.
Website and IP Latency Test: Measure the response time of any website or IP address to evaluate the performance of your internet connection.
Connected Devices Overview: See which devices are connected to your network, with the ability to divide them into categories (e.g. smartphones, computers, IoT devices).
Detailed View of Connected Device: View information about each connected device, including its IP address, MAC address, and current activity.
Device Search Function: Easily find the devices you need on your network with the built-in search function.
Wi-Fi Analyzer is your reliable assistant in managing your Wi-Fi network. Optimize your Internet connection, monitor security, and get the most out of your connection!

bluejetty:00017123:ios.summary:

THE INTERACTIVE STORY OF SEVEN (7)
Being contact
bluejetty:00017123:ios.description:
“Seven (7): Deadly Revelation” is the Beginning of the Seven (7) interactive text thriller genre and the predecessor to “Seven(7): Endgame” where you decide your own scary interactive story.
THE INTERACTIVE STORY OF SEVEN (7)
Being contacted on your mobile phone by the personified evil leaves you breathless - spine-chilling suspense guaranteed in this interactive horror thriller Adventure! Your decisions determine which course the events in this thriller story will take - and how the story will end. Immerse yourself in the darkest depths of the human soul and experience an enthralling, spellbinding psycho thriller adventure trip that you will never forget! You will never forget the bone chilling story that’s about to unfold in seven (7).
In this free adventure game, a stranger's ominous prophecy sets off a series of dramatic events that you must solve with the astuteness of a detective. Prove yourself a hacker, solve mysterious puzzles, make the right story decisions, and so find out piece by piece who is so unscrupulous to threaten the very lives of your loved ones! The game features a bone thrilling story line of text dialogues with various characters and boasts of realistic documents, images, videos, and sound effects. The extensive and well thought-out text thriller will keep you engaged and guarantees long lasting fun of playing and puzzling. Seven (7) is a completely free to play horror game and includes optional in-app purchases that can speed up the process and completion of the story. And if you like Seven (7) deadly Revelation you will love Seven (7) Endgame too!!
YOU DECIDE THE MESSAGES, YOU INFLUENCE THE GAMES COURSE
How you decide has an impact on the course and the end of this scary episode of the interactive horror story. So you can actively determine the story and influence your relationship to the different characters. It’s even up to you to decide who will survive in the end. 
CHARACTERS AND RELATIONSHIPS IN THE GAME
In Seven (7) you can directly decide how to interact with the people in your life. Every text message and every time you decide influences the relationship you have with all the characters. The interactive thriller games will force you to choose between people and let some of them get lost in the scary depths of this horror story.
THE INTERACTIVE GAMEPLAY OF SEVEN (7)
Dive into the deepest abyss of the human soul and solve a variety of exciting tasks, puzzles and mini games. Seven (7): Endgame is a roller coaster ride of feelings and it’s up to you to fight an unpredictable psycho to save the lives of your friends and family! You will receive and send text messages that will directly influence the course of this interactive horror game. You can choose which way the story of the game will go by interacting with the individual characters and facing the psycho that threatens the ones closest to you.
ADDITIONAL GAME INFORMATION
This psych episode of the Horror Messenger Chat Thriller is completely free to play!
Optional In-app purchases can accelerate the course of the story and game.

bluejetty:00138543:ios.description:
A thousand years have passed since the legendary Reaper banished the all-consuming darkness in a cataclysmic battle. The once blighted lands have blossomed anew, bathed in the warm glow of a restored sun. Yet, whispers of unease stir beneath the surface. Shadows creep at the edges of bustling towns, and unsettling nightmares plague the slumber of once peaceful villagers.

Haunted by echoes of the ancient struggle, you train tirelessly, honing your skills in the spectral arts. Have a complete management system with online scheduling, automatic reminders, deposit collection, commissions, financial control and more – all in one place.
DottoVip is the all-in-one app for professionals who live by appointments and need organization, convenience, and results.
Tailored for beauty salons, barbershops, aesthetics studios, and any professional who works by appointment, such as hairdressers, waxing specialists, brow designers, massage therapists, estheticians, manicurists, lash designers, nail designers, tanning professionals, physiotherapists, photographers, and freelancers in general.
With a sleek and modern interface, you organize your calendar, send reminders, collect deposits automatically, track payments, and manage your business from anywhere, at any time. Your clients access your website and book directly with you – no downloads needed.
Main features:
• 24/7 online booking: your client can schedule, view, cancel or reschedule by themselves, directly on your website – quickly and easily

• Birthday messages: build loyalty by automatically sending birthday wishes through WhatsApp
• Block unwanted clients: avoid stress by blocking clients you no longer wish to serve

• Intake forms: request and store important client info to further improve your service

• Multiple locations: manage services in different locations from one single system, with clarity and practicality
• Full professional profile: showcase your services, pricing, hours, and highlights on a professional site
• Multi-user support: add multiple professionals with separate access and personalized permissions
• Automatic commission calculation: the system automatically calculates how much each professional earns, by service or custom percentage
• Complete financial control: track income and expenses, organize by category, and gain full clarity over your cash flow and profits
• Reports and analytics: track your performance with real data – income, expenses, profits, top services, and 6-month comparisons
Why choose DottoVip:
• All-in-one: appointments, reminders, payments, and management
• Built for appointment-based professionals
• Organize your routine: more professionalism, fewer no-shows
• Save time with automation: let the system handle the details
• Easy and secure access: use it anytime, anywhere, on any device with internet
• Full support: help via chat and WhatsApp whenever you need
• Trusted by thousands: professionals grow their business with DottoVip
Simplify your routine, increase productivity, and attract more clients.
Download DottoVip now, enjoy a 15-day free trial, and take your business to the next level.

Started as a DIY passion project in Hackney in 2011, with the aim of supporting emerging artists and creating an alternative to stagnant mainstream radio, the platform has over 600 resident hosts: musicians, DJs artists and record collectors.
Tune into two live channels 24/7, more than a sixteen Infinite Mixtape channels, or listen back to tens of thousands of archive shows spanning countless genres; from hip-hop to techno, jazz to afrobeats and disco to ambient.
100% ad free. Built by music lovers, for music lovers. NTS is free to use, but listeners may voluntarily subscribe to NTS through NTS Supporters. Half of your Supporter contribution will be paid directly to our resident hosts, supporting them in making exceptional, leftfield radio. The other half helps us build a better NTS, through new radio programming, web and app development, as well as keeping those ads off air…
MORE REASONS TO BECOME AN NTS SUPPORTER…
Live tracklisting on channels 1, 2, all Infinite Mixtapes 
Tracklist timestamps on archived episodes
20% discount across the NTS store
Early access to merch drops and Supporter-exclusive merchandise
Eligibility to submit a mix for broadcast for Supporter Radio 
Note To Subs Supporter-exclusive newsletter
Supporter-only channels on the NTS Discord
Terms and conditions
https://www.nts.live/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00015293:ios.description:
• 2024 Pick: Best Meditation App by Healthline, The New York Times Wirecutter, Vogue, and Sports Illustrated
Well-being is a skill that can be learned. We’re here to guide you along the way.
Backed by four decades of research from world-renowned neuroscientist Dr. Richard Davidson and the team at Humin (formerly Healthy Minds Innovations) & the Center for Healthy Minds at the University of Wisconsin—Madison, the Healthy Minds Program trains your mind through meditation and podcast-style lessons to develop skills for gaining focus, reducing stress, and maintaining positive social connections.
Research with the Healthy Minds App showed that just 5 minutes a day of practice leads to a 28% reduction in stress, an 18% reduction in anxiety, a 24% reduction in depression, and a 13% increase in social connection.
Featuring our scientific Awareness, Connection, Insight, and Purpose, Well-being Framework, the Healthy Minds Program is a holistic, all-encompassing meditation app that offers the best of both guided meditations and opportunities to learn. You’ll learn simple skills to enhance personal well-being, build healthy relationships, and improve communication, performance, and creativity.
––––––––––––––––––––––––––
What makes us unique?
Developed from Science: 
While many meditation apps can claim the scientific benefits of meditation, our practices are developed directly from neuroscientific research. You’ll also hear from the world’s foremost neuroscientists about neuroplasticity and how to train your mind.
Made for Busy Lives: 
Our app features active meditation practices that fit into your busy lifestyle. Don’t have time to sit for 20 minutes? Put on an active practice and train your mind while you fold the laundry.
Guided by Measurement:
Thanks to our pioneering scientific research, the Healthy Minds Program offers the first mobile mental and emotional well-being assessments. Learn about your current level of well-being and contribute to cutting-edge research on the science of well-being. Our app also integrates with Apple Health to track your mindful minutes.
Goes Beyond Mindfulness:
Our guided path offers step-by-step instructions for becoming more present in the moment and developing a sense of purpose, meaning, and connection in life.
Driven by Mission and Supported by Donation:
The Healthy Minds Program is made possible by our donors, who support our vision of a kinder, wiser, more compassionate world. Unlike other apps that require a subscription, the Healthy Minds Program is available by donation, driven by a mission to translate science into tools to cultivate and measure well-being.
––––––––––––––––––––––––––

https://hminnovations.org/terms-of-use
Read our Privacy Policy here:
https://hminnovations.org/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00144799:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00144799:ios.description:
Realistic BMX and MTB bicycle game in an open city. Pick your bike, hit the street, and land the trick.
Bicycle Extreme Rider 3D is a 3D bicycle game for people who love speed, stunts, and real city traffic. Every ride through the city feels different from the last.
NO WIFI? NO PROBLEM.
Career mode, stunts, and the whole city work completely offline, no connection required.
STUNTS IN REAL TRAFFIC
Dodge cars, avoid buses, time every gap. Traffic never stops, lights keep changing, the street is never empty. The same street plays differently every race, and mastering the city is half the skill.
BIG STUNTS AND JUMPS
Realistic bike physics and simple touch controls let you pull off backflips, wheelies, and huge jumps. Chain tricks together, land clean, rack up points. A bicycle game this realistic on mobile didn't exist before.
FULL BIKE GARAGE
Ride BMX, MTB, road bike, race bike, and time trial bike. Each bike handles differently: BMX for stunts and tight tracks, MTB for rough terrain, fixie for pure street speed. Unlock new bikes, upgrade speed, control, and power, and build the bike that fits your style.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR BIKE
Change colors, parts, and style until the bike is really yours. Your bike should look as good as it rides.
ONLINE BIKE RACING
Race real players from around the world. Climb the global leaderboard, challenge your friends, prove who's actually fastest in the city. Online races are fast, short, and easy to jump into anytime.
MISSIONS, CHALLENGES, AND CAREER
Race the clock, hit stunt targets, finish career missions, take on new challenges. There's always a new goal a few minutes away, whether you have five minutes or a full hour.
BUILT FOR MOBILE
Smooth 3D graphics, first- and third-person camera, and controls that stay responsive even on older phones. Pick the camera that fits your style and go.
Highlights
- Play fully offline, no wifi needed, or race online if you want
- BMX and MTB bicycle game in one app
- Realistic bike physics and a full stunt system
- Open city map with real traffic and obstacles
- Online racing and a global leaderboard
- Deep bike customization and upgrades
- Career missions and time-attack races
- 3D graphics with a first-person camera
- Regular updates with new bikes and content
Why players love this game
Some come for the BMX stunts, some come for the MTB tracks, and some just want a fast bicycle game for a few minutes on the bus. Call it a bike game, a cycling game, or one of your favorite mountain bike games, Bicycle Extreme Rider 3D covers all of it, plus a city that always has a new road to find.
We read what players write. Bug reports, requests for new bikes, and community ideas shape the next update.
Pick the bike that fits you
Want BMX tricks? Start in the skate zone. Looking for a realistic bike game with real hills? Take the MTB off the asphalt. Prefer fixie for pure street speed? The time trial bike rewards a clean line and a bit of nerve. This is a bike simulator, a racing game, and a stunt game all at once, and the feel depends only on the bike you're riding.
How to play
Tap to accelerate, tilt to turn, hold to charge a jump. Land clean and you keep your speed, land tilted and you lose it. The whole game fits in one sentence, learning it takes a minute, mastering it takes a lot longer.
Join the community
https://discord.gg/zywnkGddtn
tiktok.com/@eonevolve
instagram.com/eonevolve/
youtube.com/@EONEvolve
Download Bicycle Extreme Rider 3D, get on your bike, and start racing.

bluejetty:00186410:ios.name: My City : Office
bluejetty:00186410:ios.summary: Do you want to discover what it is like to be an adult and work at an office? My City : Office is where you get to create your own office adventure. with one house that belongs to the Boss and four awesome locations to work at, Monday morni
bluejetty:00186410:ios.description:
Do you want to discover what it is like to be an adult and work at an office? My City : Office is where you get to create your own office adventure. with one house that belongs to the Boss and four awesome locations to work at, Monday morning has never been so exciting! Hold important meetings, Who will get the employee of the month award? Would you like to work at the television station or perhaps at the Gym? Everything is possible in the new My City : Office !
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room.
No IAP or missing content. My City games are perfect for kids.
CREATE YOUR OWN STORY IN 5 GREAT LOCATIONS
1. Fun office space where you get to sit at the bosses office, hold important meetings and tell everyone else what needs to be done. Because it is a fun office you could even hold parties and grand the worker with a month awards.
2. Being a gym trainer is all about helping others live a healthier life. Your customers will have to do some Running, Jumping and weight lifting and your job is to supervise them.
3. Do you want to be a superstar? The TV station is searching for new talents to Host talk shows and read the news. Visit the television station today and apply to your next exciting Job
4. The American Diner is hiring new workers because it is the office lunchtime and everyone is hungry for some burger and fries. If you want to help out at the diner now is the time to apply for the job
5. After a hard day at work, even the boss needs to relax. Take a shower, prepare a nice dinner or simply put your feet up to watch a movie. The bosses house is where you get a chance to relax from a hard day at the office!
Play Together
We support multi-touch so kids can play together with friends and family on the same screen!
GAME FEATURES:
- Roleplay storytelling in 5 great locations: Office, Bosses House, Gym, TV Station and Burger diner.
- New Characters you can use in other My City games
- Surprises and gifts are hiding everywhere.
- The bosses office has some secrets to unlock, can you find those?
- Print, photocopy, meeting excels and so much more, Just like a real office!
- A variety of jobs to Roleplay and experience. Which one would you like to have?
- Night Day option.
- The game connects to other My City games, move characters, clothing and items between games as if they are one large game!
To Connect the game to other My City games you should:
1. Have your apps downloaded on the device
2. Update your My City games
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get privacy-related information at https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00064214:ios.description:
Create an exhibition stand to display your fossils.
Gradually restore and develop the run down museum.
-Set out to excavate fossils.
Discover fossils to display in the exhibition stand. You can choose your dig site from the map. Enjoy wondering about what kind of dinosaur fossil you will unearth!
Please the visitors to the museum by collecting and assembling every part of the fossils.
-Raise your level.
Raise the level of your museum. Eventually you will receive many visitors. 
Raise the level of your character. You can increase the number of excavations.

Collect many fossils, and aim to create your own wonderful museum with cute pixel art characters that move around!

bluejetty:00092231:ios.description:
Build a factory where every connection matters.
Idle Gears is a relaxing idle tycoon game focused on simple mechanics, steady progression, and satisfying motion. Place gears, connect them to the main drive, and watch your factory come to life—one click at a time.
How it works
- Each board has a main gear that powers the system
- Place gears on the board and earn income only when they physically connect
- Merge identical gears to create higher-level machines with greater output
- Every rotation produces a subtle mechanical click designed to feel calm and rewarding
Progress at your pace
- Earn money, level up, and unlock new factory sections
- Complete missions to earn Gems and Ingots
- Invest in permanent upgrades to improve efficiency
- Tier up individual sectors for focused income boosts
Long-term growth
- Overclock your empire to reset and gain powerful permanent bonuses
- Compete on the global leaderboard or play entirely offline
- Progress continues even when the game is closed
Idle Gears is designed to be played your way—actively or passively, online or offline. No rush, no pressure. Just steady growth, clean systems, and the quiet satisfaction of a well-running machine.

bluejetty:00096034:ios.summary: Join "Missing Hearts: Crimson Cruise"! When passengers vanish aboard a lavish ocean liner, dive into one of the thrilling hidden object games! Join Claire, a fearless vampire huntress, and Ethan, a secret immortal, as they seek and find hid
bluejetty:00096034:ios.description:
Join "Missing Hearts: Crimson Cruise"! When passengers vanish aboard a lavish ocean liner, dive into one of the thrilling hidden object games! Join Claire, a fearless vampire huntress, and Ethan, a secret immortal, as they seek and find hidden objects, uncover dark secrets, and solve mystical riddles that could tip the balance between humans and vampires. If you love mystery games and crave to solve mysteries in unsolved mysteries games, this is your next adventure!
Claire Malone, a fierce vampire huntress hiding under the guise of a journalist, boards the luxury cruise ship "Fortune's Dream", where fangs are sharper than the dress code. Her mission: solve a string of mysterious disappearances linked to bloodthirsty creatures of the night. But Claire isn't the only one keeping secrets. Ethan Cross, the enigmatic owner of the liner, hides his own dark truth: he is a vampire, determined to stop a rebellion within his kind before it spirals out of control. As a storm brews above and a cursed cargo sleeps below, Claire must face her fears, Ethan must confront his past, and together they must fight for the fate of every soul on board. With betrayal around every corner and time slipping away, trust becomes their only weapon against the Vampire Council - an ancient and powerful organization, hungry for much more than blood. They want to set a new world order where humans kneel and vampires rule the night. And on the ship, the first battle for the future has already begun.
· Explore a Sinister Cruise!
Experience hidden object games like never before as you find hidden objects across eerie decks and secret rooms, solving mysteries that connect to a powerful Vampire Council. Mystery games are waiting—solve mystical riddles now!
· Uncover Dark Secrets!
Search for clues, collect artifacts, and piece together secrets in the atmospheric hidden object games. Find hidden objects to solve mysteries, discover twists, and test your detective skills in these gripping mystery games!
· Team Up to Survive!
Dive into a deep story where you must find hidden objects and solve mysteries with Claire and Ethan. Unravel the truth in mystery games full of betrayal, puzzles, and eerie suspense—perfect for hidden object games fans!
· Defeat a Vampire Conspiracy!
Board Fortune’s Dream and find hidden objects to stop an ancient plot. Mystery games fans will love the puzzles and thrill as you solve mysteries and enjoy the hidden object games challenges!
Download the free trial of the "Missing Hearts: Crimson Cruise" now and let the hunt begin!
-----

Prog is the only magazine dedicated exclusively to progressive music in all its forms—from the genre’s pioneers to today’s innovators. Whether you’re into Pink Floyd, Genesis, Marillion, or modern visionaries like Porcupine Tree, Dream Theater, and The Mars Volta, Prog covers it all.
Each issue features:
- In-depth interviews with legends like Steve Hackett and Mike Oldfield
- Spotlight features on rising artists redefining the genre
- Comprehensive reviews of albums, concerts and reissues
- The latest news from across the progressive music world
Celebrating the past, present, and future of prog rock, this is your essential guide to the music that dares to be different.
-------------------

bluejetty:00148168:ios.description:
Deen App is an all-in-one Islamic app that covers everything a Muslim needs in one place. With features like accurate prayer times, a real-time widget, Ramadan Suhoor & Iftar schedules, and a Quran Memorizer (Hifz Tracker), the app ensures you stay connected to your faith effortlessly. Explore the full Quran with audio recitation, translations, and bookmarks, along with an extensive Hadith and Dua collection. Additional tools such as the Qibla Compass, Tasbih Counter, Zakat Calculator, Hijri Calendar, Mosque Locator, and an Islamic community forum make Deen a complete lifestyle guide for Muslims worldwide. Deen App is available in multiple languages with Dark Mode & Light Mode themes.
Features:
Instant Notifications – Receive real-time notifications for all five daily prayers and special Islamic events.
Accurate Prayer Times – Get precise Salah timings, forbidden prayer periods, and sunrise/sunset schedules based on your location.
Real-time Prayer Widget – View daily prayer start and end times directly on your home screen, along with the Hijri (Arabic) date.
Ramadan Times – Get daily Suhoor & Iftar schedules, automatically adjusted to your location.
Al-Quran – Read the full Quran, categorized by Surah, Juz, page, and topic, with audio recitations by renowned reciters, English & Bangla pronunciation, advanced search, bookmarking, and sharing options.
Quran Memorizer (Hifz Tracker) – A dedicated Hifz feature to help memorize the Quran by Surah, Ayah, or Juz, with Bangla & English pronunciation and progress tracking.
Authentic Hadith Collection –Includes hadiths from Sahih Al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan An-Nasa’i, Sunan Abi Dawud, and Jami At-Tirmidhi.
Comprehensive Dua Collection – A rich collection of Dua in Arabic and meanings, categorized for daily life, protection, forgiveness, and blessings.
Qibla Direction Compass – Find the Kaaba direction accurately and quickly based on your GPS location.
Tasbih Counter (Dhikr Tracker) – A digital Tasbih tool to count Dhikr anytime, anywhere with Dhikr note-keeping functionality.
Zakat Calculator – Assess your total wealth & assets and calculate Zakat based on the Nisab threshold.
Hijri Calendar & Islamic Events – View Islamic dates and all events like Ramadan, Eid, and Ashura, with adjustable Hijri settings.
Islamic Community Forum – Engage, discuss, and share knowledge with a global Islamic community.
Mosque Locator (Masjid Finder) – Find the nearest mosque in Map instantly based on your current location.
Islamic e-Library – Access a vast collection of Islamic books, including the life stories of Prophets, with progress tracking.
Deen Education:
Asma Ul Husna – Discover the 99 Names of Allah, their meanings, and virtues.
Kalima – Learn the six Kalimas in Arabic, Bangla, and English with pronunciation.
Ayatul Kursi – Recite and memorize Ayatul Kursi in Arabic, with Bangla & English pronunciation, translation, and audio recitation.
Al-Quran (Nurani Edition) – Read a digitized version of the traditional Nurani Quran.
Ablution (Wudu) – Learn to perform Wudu, with step-by-step guidance.
Prayer Rakats Guide – Understand all Salah rakats, including Fard, Sunnah, Nafl, and Witr, with detailed explanations.
5 Pillars of Islam – A complete guide to Shahadah (Faith), Salah (Prayer), Zakat (Charity), Sawm (Fasting), and Hajj (Pilgrimage), covering their significance and practice.
Daily Hadith, Dua, & Ayah – Get a new Hadith, Dua, and Ayah displayed on your home screen every day for continuous spiritual motivation.
NOTES: We continuously add new features to improve your Islamic experience. Keep your app updated to get the latest enhancements and smoothly incorporate Islamic practices into your daily life. If you have any feedback, please email us at support@deenia.com. Insha’Allah, we will fix the issue as soon as possible.
May Allah’s grace be with you every day and everywhere. May He bless you and guide you on the path of righteousness. Ameen.

bluejetty:00077486:ios.description:
Get unlimited access to an expanding library of thousands of professionally-filmed video lectures on the Bible and theology. 
This app lets you stream thousands of videos on demand—any time, anywhere—and comes with your membership to MasterLectures by Zondervan Academic.
All videos are presented by Christian scholars you trust. Explore videos on the Bible, theology, apologetics, Christian history, and so much more.
• LEARN ABOUT THE BIBLE. Explore the historical and cultural context of the ancient texts, learn the interpretive issues, and discover practical application for today. Start with an introductory survey, or dig deep into an individual book. 
• EXPLORE THEOLOGY. From introductory videos on the nature of God, to in-depth discussions of the most challenging and mysterious topics in theology, you’ll get expert guidance from today’s leading theologians. Choose from survey-level videos on systemic, historical, evangelical, and contemporary theology, or explore specific topics in theology, like the doctrine of the Trinity the doctrine of creation, and the creeds and councils. 
• GROW IN YOUR FAITH. Learn how to articulate and clarify your own beliefs, and get equipped to defend your faith to others. Choose from videos from today’s leading apologists, or explore topics on Islam, science, ethics, philosophy, and more. 
• DISCOVER CHRISTIAN HISTORY. Gain a richer understanding of your Christian heritage. Choose from videos on every period of church history, including the key people, events, ideas, and controversies that have shaped Christian thought. 
• DO BETTER MINISTRY. Whether you serve as a pastor or as a volunteer, you’ll get expert guidance from seasoned ministry leaders who have faced the same challenges. Choose from videos on leadership, evangelism, small groups, missions, preaching, counseling, and more. 
• READ THE BIBLE IN THE ORIGINAL LANGUAGES. From introductory videos on the Greek and Hebrew alphabets, all the way up to graduate-level lectures on syntax and discourse analysis, we’ve got you covered. Choose from beginner-level videos on Greek and Hebrew, or go further by learning Aramaic, Syriac, or Ugaritic.
To access all features and content you can subscribe to MasterLectures on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
* All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited upon payment. Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://masterlectures.zondervanacademic.com/tos
Privacy Policy: https://masterlectures.zondervanacademic.com/privacy

Real security for your privacy online and free Internet access.
Get RealVPN for your iPhone or iPad and protect sensitive personal data from identity thieves and hackers. Browse your favorite web resources and use social networks worldwide without restrictions. Use free Wi-Fi hotspots securely in airports, hotels, and restaurants.
Features
* Easy to use - one button to enable protection.
* Multiple VPN servers available worldwide for the best connection speed.
* Free access to beloved websites and social media.
* Secure Internet access for online shopping and banking.
* High-grade encryption AES-256 for your data sent through the Internet, such as credit cards, passwords, and pins.
* Total anonymity online – hide from anyone who might want to interfere in your conversations.
* Best pricing for the value and Lifetime plans – pay once and use forever.
* Up to 5 devices connected simultaneously for a single account.
* High-quality customer support 24/7.

RealVPN encrypts all your data and all Internet activities from any app on your iPhone or iPad which require Internet access. Any websites or advertisers will have many difficulties while trying to find your physical location.

bluejetty:00150479:ios.description:
Welcome to the official application of Milan Airports, the essential digital tool for travelers flying through Malpensa Airport (MXP) and Linate Airport (LIN). Whether you are departing, arriving, or in transit, our app is designed to provide a seamless, stress-free, and premium travel experience directly from your smartphone.
Real-time flight information & status
Stay updated with our comprehensive flight status dashboard. Monitor all departures and arrivals in real-time with detailed information on:
 - Malpensa terminal (T1 and T2) and Linate locations.
 - Exact gate numbers and boarding times.
 - Check-in island numbers and baggage reclaim carousels.
 - Real-time delays or flight cancellations.
Never miss an update again. Use the flight tracker to follow your specific journey and receive instant push notifications for any changes. 
Secure biometric login
Privacy and speed matter. Access your personal profile, saved tickets, and preferences instantly using biometric login. With Face ID or fingerprint recognition, you can skip the passwords and manage your travel documents in a secure, high-speed environment.
Book exclusive services
Skip the stress and save time by booking everything you need before you even arrive at the airport:
 - Book parking: Access the official Parking network to find the best rates and secure spots.
 - Fast tracking: Buy your fast tracking pass to bypass security queues and reach the gate faster.
 - Lounge finder/booking: Use our lounge finder/booking tool to locate exclusive VIP Lounges and purchase access for a relaxing pre-flight experience.
 - Baggage wrapping: Ensure your luggage is protected. Book your baggage wrapping service in advance.
Paperless digital ticket
Forget the hassle of printing. All your purchases, from parking reservations to lounge vouchers, are stored as digital tickets (paperless) within the app. Simply show your barcode at the airport and go.
Shopping & personalized promotions 
Get personalized alerts for exclusive deals at Malpensa and Linate’s shops and restaurants. Explore the latest trends and enjoy special rewards exclusive to our app users.
Logistics & support
 - Transfer Malpensa Express: Find the best way to reach the airport or city center via train.
 - Dedicated Assistance: Easy access to emergency contacts and customer support for both Milan airports.
 - Accessibility: A revamped interface designed for better navigation and compatibility with assistive technologies.
Download Milan Airports Official today, your journey to and from Milan has never been this smooth.
Accessibility statement: https://www.milanomalpensa-airport.com/en/legal/accessibility-app-milan-airports

- 매일 오
bluejetty:00079897:ios.description:
고객이 신뢰하는 브랜드 대상 (Trust Brand Awards)
6년 연속 1위 수상 (한경비즈니스 주최)
지금까지 진정한 소개팅을 제공하는 앱을 찾으신 적이 있나요?
진실된 인연을 연결해주는 것이야말로 '진짜 소개팅' 아닐까요?
코코는 다양한 소개팅 앱에서 느낀 갈증을 시원하게 해결해 드릴 거예요!
쉽게 연결되고 가볍게 만나는 인스턴트 같은 소개팅 앱과는 다르게, 코코는 '진짜 소개팅'을 주선해 드립니다.
- 매일 오전 11시, '진짜 소개팅'
코코는 매일 오전 11시마다 진정성 있는 '진짜 소개팅'을 선사합니다. 다른 앱들과 달리 "아무나"를 대상으로 한 모호한 소개가 아닌, 회원님의 연애 스타일, 취미, 취향 등을 고려한 최적화된 매칭 알고리즘으로 높은 연결 가능성을 자랑합니다. 우리와 함께 멋진 인연을 만들어보세요!
- 필터 한 번으로 이상형 소개
오늘의 추천 리스트에서 마음에 드는 이성을 찾지 못하셨다면 걱정하지 마세요. 간편한 필터 기능을 사용하여 원하는 조건과 성격, 외모 등을 기준으로 원하는 이상형의 프로필만 골라 추천받으실 수 있습니다. 나에게 딱 맞는 이성과 만남의 기회를 잡아보세요.
- 의미 없는 채팅보단 실제 연락처 교환
코코는 실체 없는 대화창이 아닌 진정한 만남과 교류를 추구합니다. 회원님들이 서로를 확실히 알게 되면 실제 연락처 교환도 가능하도록 지원합니다. 응답하지 않거나 일치하지 않는 대화창이 아닌, 진정성 있는 대화를 나누며 관계를 발전시킬 수 있는 기회를 제공합니다.
- 원치 않는 지인 차단 기능
지인을 만나 당황하지 않도록 코코의 '지인 차단' 기능을 통해 원하지 않거나 보고 싶지 않은 사람들을 효과적으로 차단할 수 있습니다. 자유롭게 원하는 만남에 집중하세요.
- 여성 중심의 맞춤형 소개팅
코코는 여성 여러분을 위해 맞춤형 소개팅을 제공합니다. 우리의 매칭 알고리즘은 여성의 선호도를 최우선으로 고려하여 최적의 파트너를 추천합니다.
- 13년 동안 축적된 전문성
코코는 6년 연속 "고객이 신뢰하는 브랜드" 대상 수상 및 주요 언론에서 높은 평가를 받은 경험이 있습니다.
코코 팀은 모든 회원님을 중시하며, 관리되지 않는 일반적인 앱과는 다릅니다. 10년 이상의 운영 경험으로 안전하고 신뢰할 수 있는 서비스와 안정적인 환경을 제공하기 위해 최선을 다하겠습니다.
당신만의 믿음직한 주선회사로서, 정직하고 전문성 있는 서비스로 여러분께 가까이 다가가겠습니다 :)
*19세 이상만 사용 가능합니다.

개인정보취급방침 : https://www.cocoapp.kr/terms/privacy/

- 사진: 프로필 사진을 등록하기 위해 필요한 권한입니다.
- 주소록: 지인과의 매칭을 피하기 위해 연락처를 등록할 때, 사용자의 연락처를 가져오는 데 필요한 권한입니다.

bluejetty:00070912:ios.name: Train Simulator & Driver Games
bluejetty:00070912:ios.summary:
And more, drive your own train to take a trip in the amazing world of ice-cream.
In the trip, we could be a train staff in the train uniform. Check if the luggage is properly stacked, take a trail in control room to control the equipment,
bluejetty:00070912:ios.description:
And more, drive your own train to take a trip in the amazing world of ice-cream.
In the trip, we could be a train staff in the train uniform. Check if the luggage is properly stacked, take a trail in control room to control the equipment, driving into high-speed railway station etc. 
Also, there are lots of assembling game for railways tracks, for you to design the pathway for trains to travel between city and countryside. 
This is so much fun, that you can’t miss. The train is departing! Come and play now!
FEATURE
- Assembling steam train - understand train parts, wheels and mechanic structures and how they work together.
 - Professions Role Playing Games - get to know the daily work of a train staff or high-speed train operator.
- Many fun carriages in different style available for you to create your own train, Regular carriage for passenger, pumpkin carriage, cake carriage, carriage of coal, flat carriage etc.
- Provides many fun track puzzles to design your path. The train would go to destination following the designed path. 
- Each train part has a name, while the user chooses any of them, a voice will tell them the name of the chosen train part. The fun activity is for the game user to learn more words and mechanic knowledge. 
- Supports Simplify Chinese and Traditional Chinese.
- Two models of pronunciation: Mandarin, Cantonese.
Contact us:
E-mail: support@iappsteam.com
Website: http://www.iappsteam.com

bluejetty:00142429:ios.name: 爱星盘
bluejetty:00142429:ios.summary:
爱星盘是一款集占星排盘、星座资讯、星座运势、占星教程于一身的应用，爱星盘的愿景是打造一款最专业又好用的占星排盘应用。
【产品主要特征】
专业占星排盘软件，集现代占星和古典占星于一体，全面星盘支持和数百万字的星盘解释数据，各种详尽的参数，超越你的想象，大幅提升排盘和分析的效率。
1、全面的星盘类型支持，包括个人盘（本命盘、重置盘、泛音盘、龙首盘、十二分盘、十三分盘）、合盘（比较盘、配对盘、组合中点盘、时空中点盘、马克思盘）、推运盘（行运盘、次限盘、推进盘、三限盘、太阳返照
bluejetty:00142429:ios.description:
爱星盘是一款集占星排盘、星座资讯、星座运势、占星教程于一身的应用，爱星盘的愿景是打造一款最专业又好用的占星排盘应用。
【产品主要特征】
专业占星排盘软件，集现代占星和古典占星于一体，全面星盘支持和数百万字的星盘解释数据，各种详尽的参数，超越你的想象，大幅提升排盘和分析的效率。
1、全面的星盘类型支持，包括个人盘（本命盘、重置盘、泛音盘、龙首盘、十二分盘、十三分盘）、合盘（比较盘、配对盘、组合中点盘、时空中点盘、马克思盘）、推运盘（行运盘、次限盘、推进盘、三限盘、太阳返照盘、月亮返照盘、太阳弧盘、法达星限、小限、黄道释放、希腊十年、中世纪小限）、合盘推运（比较次/三限盘 组合次/三限盘、时空次/三限盘、马盘次/三限盘），基本囊括你所了解到的全部星盘类型；
2、提供全面完备的星体配置，包括十大主行星（太阳至冥王）、小行星（凯龙、谷神、智神、 婚神、灶神，独有支持爱神星和灵神星）、特殊点（南北交点、莉莉丝、福点、宿命点 、东升点 、日月中点）和汉堡学派虚星（丘比特、哈迪斯、宙斯、阿波罗等等）；
3、提供134个恒星的位置和相位计算；
4、提供177个阿拉伯点和朔望点的计算；
5、提供星体的中点位置和相位计算；
6、全面的古典占星参数支持：先天尊贵、后天状态、宫神星、得时失时、速度、东出西入、灼伤、喜乐、互容接纳、赤纬平行、映点与反映点、特殊度数、光线围攻、光线传送等等；
7、提供行星时计算，计算日出时间、日落时间、日主星、时主星；
8、支持对星盘格局进行计算，支持大三角、T三角、大十字、风筝、信封、上帝手指、中三角、小三角等格局计算，支持守护星链条（定位星）的计算；
9、支持古典、现代、特定三种预置配置模版，多种星体选择、星体容许度和相位容许度、宫位系统等星盘参数设置，支持地心制、支持多种三分、界、十度主星选择，可以单独配置每个星盘要显示的相位和容许度；
10、拥有超过300万字的星盘解释数据库，针对星盘个性化解读；
11、独有开放性合盘缘分评分功能，对两人缘分进行数字化评估，评分细节公开展示，让你知其然知其所以然，也可以找出比较盘中相同部分，了解两人共性；
12、提供不同的星盘配色和星盘模式，包括默认、黑色、清新、粉红等多种颜色，包括符号版、文字版、专业版三种模式，组合成128中星盘外观；
13、同时还提供星历表、生命灵数、生日密码、公农历查询转换等工具；星历表支持按年、按天，可以找出每分钟的天象变化，支持查看各种小行星的星历位置计算；
14、支持从公元0年到3600年的星盘、星历计算，带你横跨3600年去看星星；
15、支持管理上千上万个星盘档案，提供多种分组和条件过滤，快速查询；提供看盘笔记功能，随时记录看盘点滴；
16、接入丰富的星座资讯、星座运势和占星教程内容，每天更新；
17、还有更多的惊喜功能和体验等你来发现...

bluejetty:00164587:ios.description:
Lisnr: Simplify Your Notes, Elevate Your Productivity!
Say goodbye to messy notebooks and time-consuming manual transcription! With Lisnr, you can transform your audio, text, or documents into organized, insightful notes in seconds. Whether you're a student capturing lectures or a professional recording meetings, Lisnr ensures you stay on top of your game with ease and efficiency.
Key Features to Supercharge Your Workflow:
1. Audio Transcription Made Effortless
Upload or record audio directly in the app, and watch as it's transcribed into clear, searchable text in moments. Lisnr supports multiple languages and ensures accuracy even in fast-paced discussions.
2. Smart Summaries with AI
No time to sift through lengthy recordings or documents? Let Lisnr condense the content into concise summaries, highlighting the key points so you can focus on what truly matters. Perfect for quick review before exams or important meetings.
3. Interactive AI Chat for Deeper Insights
Got questions about your material? Dive into the AI-powered chat and ask anything related to your notes, lectures, or uploaded content. Get answers, clarifications, or even summaries tailored to your queries.
4. Seamless Input Options
Not just audio! Upload text files, paste links to articles, or add PDFs—the app processes it all. Whether it's a research paper, lecture notes, or a project report, Lisnr uses the context to generate summaries, insights, and more.
Who is it for?
• Students: Take the stress out of lecture notes. Record, transcribe, and summarize effortlessly to create the ultimate study guides.
• Professionals: Never miss a detail from your meetings. Turn discussions into structured summaries and actionable items in minutes.
• Lifelong Learners: Enhance your understanding of books, articles, and more with AI-powered summaries and Q&A support.
Why Choose Lisnr?
With an intuitive interface, cutting-edge AI technology, and a focus on simplifying your workflow, Lisnr is your ultimate productivity partner. Forget hours spent deciphering recordings or poring over lengthy documents—Lisnr gets the job done faster, smarter, and better.
Transform the way you take notes today. Download Lisnr and let your ideas flow!

bluejetty:00077356:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00077356:ios.description:
OUR SECRET, THE BOARD GAME THAT BRINGS COUPLES CLOSER
Break the routine. Our Secret is a board game for couples that turns any night into a time of laughter, conversation, and surprises. Roll the dice, move across the board, and find out how well you really know each other.
- HOW IT WORKS
Every space on the board holds a surprise: a question, a challenge, or a card that can change everything. Special spaces move you forward or back and can turn the game around. The first to reach the finish wins.
- MADE FOR EVERY COUPLE
Customize each player with a name, color, gender identity, and orientation. The game works for straight, gay, and bisexual couples and picks challenges based on who's playing.
- CARDS THAT EVOLVE AS YOU PLAY
There are three card levels. The further you get on the board, the more challenging they become.
- MANY KINDS OF CARDS
• Secret Cards: questions that reveal dreams, stories, and things you haven't told each other yet.
• Challenge Cards: missions to complete together.
• Penalty Cards: lighthearted consequences for whoever lands on the wrong space.
Nearly 100 cards to play together.
- BOARDS FOR EVERY OCCASION
• Complete: every card type in one game.
• No Secrets: skip the questions and go straight to the challenges.
And much more...
- THE DETAILS THAT MAKE A DIFFERENCE
• A timer on every challenge, so no one can dodge the mission
• Your game is saved every round: stop whenever you want and pick up where you left off
• Available in English, Spanish, and Portuguese
- FULL EXPERIENCE: PAY ONCE, ENJOY FOREVER
Start playing for free with 2 boards. The Full Experience unlocks:
• All boards, including those still to come
• More than 2 players in the same game
• Skipping the card timer
• Creating, editing, and deleting your own cards
No subscription. One purchase, fun forever.
Download now and discover your secret.

bluejetty:00146279:ios.description:
FieldLevel is the athletic recruiting network that helps athletes find the right teams and coaches find the best athletes for their rosters. Whether you’re an athlete, parent, coach or organization, FieldLevel helps you achieve your goal.
FieldLevel is a community of hundreds of thousands of members, and we are growing every day.
HOW IT WORKS
ATHLETES
1. Sign Up
An easy-to-use app that keeps all your recruiting resources in one place. FieldLevel allows you to work with your coaches to simplify the recruiting process and get in front of the right teams
2. Get Exposure
FieldLevel’s network is extensive and provides unprecedented reach to coaches
3. Evaluate and Match
Find the right college fit based on your preferences and the recruiting needs of coaches with MatchUp
4. Communicate
Showcase your athletic, academic, and leadership skills to teams and communicate directly with coaches
5. Commit
HIGH SCHOOL + CLUB COACHES
1. Sign up
Saves you time by providing an easy-to-use tool that keeps all your recruiting info in one place 
2. Get Connected
Connect with coaches, grow your network, and build recruiting pipelines all over the country
3. Evaluate and Match
Helps you find the right fit for your athletes with national opportunities
4. Communicate
Provide insightful player evaluations to coaches and message them directly using the app
5. Commit
COLLEGE COACHES + PROS
1. Sign up
One central hub to review athletes’ videos, coach evaluations, academic information, and more
2. Find Talent
Provides a platform to market your program to coaches and athletes while discovering players interested in your program
3. Evaluate and Match
Post your recruiting needs and receive athlete recommendations directly from coaches
4. Communicate
Streamlines your recruiting efforts with direct communication with athletes and their coaches
5. Recruit

bluejetty:00022622:ios.description:
Everything you need to manage all your mobile services in one place! Find deals, track subscriptions, & so much more!
The Ooredoo app is the best way to complement your experience with Qatar's most reliable mobile network. Whether you’re in the country or travelling overseas, this will be your secure companion to manage your accounts, check your daily spending, monitor your data roaming plan usage, and subscribing to a variety of add-ons.
Check balances, recharge your prepaid plan, and pay your phone bills quickly and easily. Simply download the app, register or log in to your existing account, and you will be able to track usage, reserve your favourite number for a new eSIM, block unwanted SMS senders, and more with a single hit of a button.
Request home internet installation to your desired location or upgrade your current Home+ plan using the app to get more benefits and ensure a constant connection with your family and friends.
Visit our eShop to find incredible phone deals and receive Nojoom points with every purchase you make! Buy the latest devices from smartphones, tablets, or accessories and collect reward points that you can redeem at your convenience either from Ooredoo or any of our loyalty programme partners.
Our Help section provides several methods of contacting us, including chatting to our dedicated support agents via our live chat feature, via WhatsApp, email, or via a call; we’ll always be glad to hear from you to ensure your Ooredoo experience is up to standards!
On top of that, you can utilize our handy online directory and get quick access to a massive list of contact numbers for the services you might need.
Don't forget to visit the app on a regular basis to learn about any updates and check out our unmatched postpaid deals, as we're constantly adding new offers that will surely catch your eye.
Ooredoo Qatar may require access to your physical steps count using the Health App and/or HealthKit to allow some sports offers and features. We will notify you for permission when and if access to this information is required.

Meccle is your next one stop shop. Whatever the occasion, we've got you covered.
Moving out and need new furniture? Think Meccle. 
Dog chewed up their bed again? Think Meccle. 
Re-decorating your kitchen? Think Meccle. 
Whether it’s cozy home decor to cutting-edge tech gadgets to tools for all your home DIY projects, you’ll find it on Meccle! 
Our Best Price Promise
We believe in providing the best value & quality so you can shop confidently knowing we'd got your needs taken care of. 
We Do Fast Delivery
With our warehouses in Los Angeles, we promise fast 2-4 day delivery options on items big and small. Just place your order and we’ll have your items shipped directly from our warehouse to your doorstep faster than you can say “Meccle”. We're so confident that we can deliver fast that if we deliver later than the estimated date, we'll make sure to add a $5 coupon back into your account. 
Browsing product photos can be so boring. 
That's why we're changing up the game! Shop using our video scroll feed - just swipe up. Some videos even come with ASMR so you can see (and hear) what you’re shopping for.
Need assistance? 
Our own team of customer service reps are here to help you! Whatever your question is whether it’s about a product, an order or just giving us some valuable feedback, we won’t stop till we solve your problem! Simply email us at customer@meccle.com & you'll hear back from us in 24 hours or less.
Are you a small business? 
Meccle has a wholesale portal just for you. Join Meccle Business Club and get direct access to buy directly from our highly trusted supplier network. Chat with them, get to know them, then do business! Find your next supplier on Meccle.
Your Privacy is Our Priority
All personal information and card data is encrypted and securely processed. Any personal information is solely used for fulfilling customer orders. We never share or sell your information to third parties. We store all personal data securely and are proudly compliant and certified by PCI ASV standards. 
Trust our Standards
We are owned and operated by Haodex Ltd, an Australian National Stock Exchange listed company. Our operations are governed by stringent compliance and regulations within the Australian jurisdiction. Shop at Meccle with confidence, knowing our strong background and adherence to a strict code of standards ensure a secure shopping experience.

bluejetty:00152496:ios.description:
If you love trying different styles in outfit games, this adventure will keep you inspired every day!
Step into a magical world of fashion games and character creator fun for teens! In this doll dress up experience, your best friend dreams of becoming a true princess — and only you can make it happen! Choose from hundreds of outfits, accessories, and hairstyles to create a look fit for a royal ball. Decorate her cozy room with charming details to make it feel like a real palace. In our creative game, you can be her best friend forever, makeup stylist, and designer all in one! No third-party advertising.
Create a Perfect Look
Design her dream outfit with endless clothing choices — from gorgeous dresses and skirts to jeans, tops, and shoes. Add a hat, sunglasses, or magical wings to make her look truly divine. Every detail matters in this cute dress up game!
Change Hairstyles
Long or short, curly or sleek — it’s all up to you! Change her hair color, add sparkles and gradients, and create a style that brings joy every time she looks in the mirror in your character maker world.
Style a Dream Room
Transform her room with furniture and decorations. Design it like a royal castle in our teen game full of charm. Add fairy lights, plants, animations, and backgrounds to make it special — perfect for fans of casual games and princess dress up fun.
Adopt an Adorable Pet
Choose a playful puppy, fluffy kitten, or magical creature. Her new best friend will make every moment more delightful in your character customization world.
Create a Fashion Gallery
Snap photos, save favorites, and build your own gallery. Look back for inspiration and keep inventing new outfits. Turn your gallery into a royal portfolio in our teen game.
Compete in Style Challenges
Join beauty game challenges and fashion battles! Create dazzling outfits, beat rivals, and prove you’re the ultimate queen of style.
Your bff is waiting — make her dream come true in this magical world of cute makeover games and dressing up fun!
SUBSCRIPTION
Subscribe now to get:
1. Extra items for character customization.
2. Exclusive interior decoration items.
3. Special adorable pets.
4. Unique character animations.
5. Additional room animation effects.
6. "Random Outfit" feature.
7. “Save Snapshot” feature.
Premium subscription details:
- Start with a free three-day trial. When the trial ends, a paid weekly subscription will begin automatically.
- Subscriptions are available in weekly, monthly, and annual plans.
- A weekly subscription costs $9.99, a monthly subscription costs $19.99, and an annual subscription costs $99.99.
- Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase.
- You can cancel your subscription or free trial at any time. To prevent automatic renewal, cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
- You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
- Read our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:

bluejetty:00180599:ios.name: Phone Spam Pattern Blocker
bluejetty:00180599:ios.summary:
Block entire area codes, exchanges, and spoofed number ranges with one pattern, not one number at a time.
Phone Pattern Blocker uses wildcard patterns to block huge ranges of unwanted calls with a single rule. Enter a pattern like 555-123-
bluejetty:00180599:ios.description:
Block entire area codes, exchanges, and spoofed number ranges with one pattern, not one number at a time.
Phone Pattern Blocker uses wildcard patterns to block huge ranges of unwanted calls with a single rule. Enter a pattern like 555-123-XXXX and every number in that range is blocked: your phone won’t ring, and the caller can still leave a voicemail.
OPTIMIZED FOR IPHONE DUO
Open your iPhone Duo to see your patterns and the one you’re editing side by side. As you type, the What This Blocks panel shows how many numbers a pattern covers, its range, example numbers, and any overlap with your other patterns. Close it and pick up right where you left off.
HOW IT WORKS
Create a pattern using X as a wildcard digit. The app registers every matching number with the call blocking built into iOS. There’s no call monitoring: iOS quietly declines matching calls on its own, even when the app isn’t running.
FEATURES
• Block by area code, exchange, or any custom range
• Block neighbor spoofing: calls made to look like your own number
• Allow exceptions so the numbers you choose still ring
• 200+ countries and regions with local number formats
• iCloud keeps your patterns in sync across your devices
• Browse every number a pattern will block
• Import and export your patterns
YOUR CONTACTS ALWAYS RING
iOS never blocks a number saved in your Contacts, even if it matches a pattern.
PRIVACY
Your patterns are processed on your iPhone. The app can’t see your calls, contacts, messages, or call history. Crash and blocking diagnostics are shared with Apparent Logic by default to help fix problems, and you can turn this off any time in About › Privacy & Diagnostics.
PRO, NO SUBSCRIPTION
Block up to 5 million numbers free. Pro is a one-time purchase that raises your limit to 1 billion numbers, with no subscription.

Built for your drivers, the WorkWave™ Route Manager Mobile application is an extension of our WorkWave™ Route Manager product
WorkWave™ Route Manager builds optimal route plans that reduce planning time, drive time, mileage and costs while increasing capacity. Now you can easily improve response time by replanning routes in real-time and connect your operations to your drivers with the mobile app. 
With the easy-to-use route planning and scheduling tool, multi-vehicle routes can be created in seconds in full compliance with a variety of constraints. With your WorkWave Route Manager subscription you can:
- Automate optimized route plans
- Commit to narrow time windows
- Schedule last minute orders 
- Load vehicles to capacity
- Plan in real-time with WorkWave Route Manager 360
- Route simulations to plan for growth
- Dispatch route plans to drivers mobile devices
Here’s what you can expect with our Route Manager 360 solution:
Driver Mobile App
o Real-Time Routes
o Check-in and check-out of stops
o Sync with other navigation app and get turn-by-turn directions to the next stop
o Delivery Status (Completed or Rescheduled)
o Delivery Validation (NEW Barcode Scanning)
o Proof of Delivery (Signature, Photo, Notes and Voice Recording)
Driver Mobile GPS Tracking
o GPS Tracking
o Driver Breadcrumbs
o Live ETA 
Customer Notification Capability
o Live ETA Tracking Link
o Email Messaging 
o SMS Messaging (Coming Soon)
Typical productivity improvements for businesses include: 
- 20% reduction in drive time
- 30% reduction in mileage
- 25% reduction in overall costs
- 22% increase in capacity
Disclaimer: continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Visit workwave.com/route-manager today to schedule your demo or call 800-835-9817 to get started!

هل أنت من محبي كرة القدم أو الأفلام أو الأنمي أو الألعاب أو الرياضات الأخرى؟ هل تريد اختبار معرفتك في هذه المجالات؟ إذاً فأنت في المكان المناسب !
انطلق في مغامرة مثيرة للاستمتاع مع الأصدقاء بجولات رائعة للإجابة على العديد من الأسئلة الشيقة المتعلقة بكرة القدم والأنمي والأفلام والرياضات والمنوعات.
ستحتاج إلى السرعة في استحضار المعلومات واستخدام معرفتك في هذه المجالات للتفوق على خصومك.
ما يميز هذا التطبيق هو احتياجه ل ٣ لاعبين ، المتسابقَين و حكم اللعبة والذي يشارك في المسابقة ليطرح على المتسابقين الأسئلة ويتحقق من إجاباتهم.
يدير الحكم اللعبة باستخدام التطبيق:
 * يعرّف أسماء المتنافسين
 * يشرح كل نوع من التحديات
 * يقرأ الأسئلة ويتحقق من الإجابات
 * يعدّ الوقت ويخبر بانتهائه 
 * ويعلن النتائج!
تطبيق تحدي الثلاثين 
 * يعمل أوفلاين.. بدون إنترنت
 * حزم أسئلة مجانية ضخمة وفي كل المجالات
 * بنك أسئلة واسع ومتنوع، حدث التطبيق للحصول على المزيد دائماً
 * بسيط التصميم وسهل الاستخدام، إلعب مباشرة دون أي تعقيدات
 * احصل على الحزم المميزة من خلال النجوم
 * احصل نجوم مجانية من مشاهدة إعلانات قليلة وقصيرة
 * سجل الدخول باستخدام حساب آبل أو جوجل لحفظ معلوماتك من حزم ونجوم
|| ملاحظة || عند شراء نجوم لمرة واحدة بإمكانك إيقاف الإعلانات تماماً من شاشة حساب المستخدم

PICK A SCENE, ADD YOUR PHOTO
Browse 40+ ready-made scenes
bluejetty:00147530:ios.description:
Magivid turns your photos into short videos. Pick a ready-made scene, swap a face into any clip, or describe what you want to see — and save the result straight to your camera roll.
PICK A SCENE, ADD YOUR PHOTO
Browse 40+ ready-made scenes — video clips and photo looks, with new ones added over time. Every scene plays its preview right in the grid, so you know what you are getting before you start. Choose one, add a clear photo of yourself, and Magivid puts you inside it. Filter by Video, Photo, New or Hot, and pick the frame for your clip: 9:16 for Reels and Shorts, 1:1 for the feed, or 16:9 for widescreen.
DESCRIBE IT, GET A CLIP
Type the scene you have in mind — "a slow pan across a rain-lit street, neon signs reflecting in puddles, one person walking toward the camera" — and Magivid renders it as a video. Add a reference photo if you want the clip to grow out of your own picture, or leave it out and let the words do the work.
IT RENDERS IN THE BACKGROUND
Start a render and put your phone away. Magivid keeps working and sends you a notification the moment your result is ready.
EVERYTHING IN ONE LIBRARY
Every video and photo you make is kept in your Library, sorted into photos and videos, ready to save to Photos or share with friends.
BUILT TO STAY OUT OF YOUR WAY
• No ads, anywhere
• Prices shown before every render
• Video and photo results in one app
• Available in 13 languages
SPARKS AND MAGIVID PRO
Renders are paid for with sparks, and every render shows its cost before you spend anything. Magivid PRO comes as a weekly or a yearly plan: the yearly plan adds 1,000 sparks with every renewal, the weekly plan adds 200, and PRO unlocks every scene in the catalog. Need more sparks sooner? Top up any time with a one-time spark pack.
FREE SPARKS
Check in every day to collect free sparks — the reward grows over a seven-day streak — and get a one-time bonus for turning on notifications.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions. Spark packs are one-time purchases and are spent as you create.
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/privacypolicymagivid
Term of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/terms-of-use-magivid

bluejetty:00014119:ios.description:
Bible In Basic English.
The Bible In Basic English (BBE) is a translation of the Bible into Basic English. The BBE was translated by Professor S. H. Hooke. In an effort to simplify and make easy to understand the text he and his team limited the vocabulary to the standard 850 Basic English words. 100 words that were helpful to understand poetry were added along with 50 "Bible" words. 
The Bible in Basic English strives to simplify the Bible so that more people worldwide can read and understand the text. By using the Basic English vocabulary, this goal is accomplished. The BBE is certainly straightforward and simple.

Spark excitement for learning with Bitsboard – an interactive learning app trusted by over 5 million parents, teachers and students worldwide. Create your own learning experience with 35+ educational activities, join a private classroom or dive into thousands of hand-curated flashcard decks – whatever you want to learn, Bitsboard is here to make it fun and make it stick!
What you can do with the Bitsboard app: 
Teachers
• Create lessons in minutes with beautiful images and clear audio
• Adapt lessons to an individual user’s learning speed
• Encourage higher level thinking with fun single/multiplayer mini-games
• Keep track of individual progress 
• Automatically back up and sync data across devices
Students
• Turn boring assignments into addictive mini-games
• Master languages, vocab, reading, spelling and more
• Compete in multiplayer games with classmates
• Study at your own pace or with others
OVER 35+ POWERFUL MINI GAMES / STUDY MODES IN 1 APP INCLUDING
• Flashcards
• Photo Touch
• Memory Cards (1-4 players)
