• Match Up
• Word Builder
• Sentence Builder
• Spelling Bee
• BINGO (1-4 players)
• Letter Tracing
• Sequencing
• Related Items
• Word Search
• Crosswords
• Letter Match
• Odd One Out
• What Comes Next?
• Side by Side
• Word Chunks
• Reader
• Questions Game
• Photo Hunt (1-4 players)
• Racing Rivals (2 players)
• Battle Time (2 players)
TRACKS YOUR PROGRESS
• Bitsboard keeps track of every answer for every game, user, and board
SUPPORTS MULTIPLE USERS
• Detailed stats and progress reports for each user
• Automatically save games and boards settings at the user level
ACCESSIBILITY OPTIONS
• Bitsboard fully supports switch control to make all of the games accessible for users with disabilities
ORGANIZE YOUR BOARDS
• Easily group your boards into classes
ACCELERATE YOUR LEARNING
• Bitsboard's learning algorithm automatically personalizes each game based on the players skills.
SHARE AND SYNC CONTENT ACROSS DEVICES
• Automatically back up and sync data across devices
BITSBOARD CLASSES
• Share and automatically sync all of your content with other users / students on other devices
• Bitsboard classes are private - only you and the students you approve see your content
CLOUD SYNC
• With cloud sync all of your boards, students, classes, and settings are automatically backed up and sync across all of your devices
QR LOGIN CARDS
• To protect student’s privacy you can generate student accounts without any email or password.  Once created, you can share the login details of each student account via a simple QR login card.  Just email the QR code to your student and they will be able to download the free Bitsboard app and log into their Bitsboard account.

The basic version of Bitsboard is FREE for all users. Premium features can be unlocked with an in-app subscription.  
Bitsboard Premium Subscription:
• Unlimited access to all 500+ Premium Classes and Featured Boards + up to 10 new premium Classes per month
• Add unlimited number of students and classes
• Use "Cloud Sync" to sync and backup all boards, classes, and students
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You will not be able to cancel a subscription during the active period. Your subscription may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase.

bluejetty:00137952:ios.name: AMSConnect
bluejetty:00137952:ios.summary: AMS Connect is a HIPAA compliant mobile application for critical and secure text messaging. Enhancing critical messaging workflows AMS Connect also integrates with American Messaging’s suite of critical messaging devices, providing reliable
bluejetty:00137952:ios.description:
AMS Connect is a HIPAA compliant mobile application for critical and secure text messaging. Enhancing critical messaging workflows AMS Connect also integrates with American Messaging’s suite of critical messaging devices, providing reliable, secure, and redundant messaging. 
Key Features: 
- Send and receive secure text messages in compliance with HIPAA standards. 
- Pager Integration – Messages arrive on your pager, smartphone or both for redundancy and convenience. 
- Service Teams – Send a page to a service team or group. Adds backup and redundancy to the traditional “hand-off” or “pass around” pager with easy opt-in and opt-out of on-call pagers at any time. 
- Silent/Do Not Disturb Override – AMS Connect notifications can override “Silent” and “Do Not Disturb” phone settings when Critical Alerts are “Allowed” by the end-user. 
- Message Forwarding – Let your colleagues know who is covering you when off-duty and have your messages automatically forwarded to that person. 
- Availability Status – Set your status to let contacts know if you are available, bust or off duty and view the status of others. 
- Mobile & Web Accessibility – Access AMS Connect anytime, anywhere with device sync. 
- Read Receipts – See exactly if, and when your colleagues have read your messages with receipts. 
- Quick Messages - Quickly send commonly used messages by selecting from a list of pre-populated phrases or create your own. 
- Voice Notes – Record a voice message and send it securely within a conversation thread. 
- Photo & File Share – Safely send up to 5 photo and file attachments including PDF, Word, and Excel documents up to 28MB at a time. 
- Archived Messaging History – Ability to archive single, multiple or all messages (according to your organization’s retention policy). 
- Searchable Directory – Access a listing of professionals from your organization and message them directly. 
- Urgent Message – Alert your care team to critical information and events by sending an urgent message with a unique tone. 
- Critical Group Messaging – Privately and securely message individuals, teams, and other distribution groups. 
- Secure External Messaging – (enhanced feature) Send a HIPAA secure message or photo to anyone with a mobile phone. Secure external messages are encrypted conversations between an American Messaging user and an external user with a mobile device. No need to sign up and remember usernames and passwords. Just quick, easy secure communication.

bluejetty:00054094:android.name: Add Watermark
bluejetty:00054094:android.summary: Add watermarks to your pictures. Put your property text or a logo image into your picture, adjust its size, transparency, rotation, alignment, then save and share it. Lots of settings and features, automatic processing and batch mode - that
bluejetty:00054094:android.description:
Add watermarks to your pictures. Put your property text or a logo image into your picture, adjust its size, transparency, rotation, alignment, then save and share it. Lots of settings and features, automatic processing and batch mode - that's why many professional photographers and bloggers use Add Watermark in their daily routine.
FOR SUPPORT AND HELP please contact me via email or website (see below)!
Primary features of the Full version:
• Batch mode for processing multiple images at once
• Auto processing through sharing images from other apps
• Fonts, color and other effects in text mode
• 72 built-in fonts, upto 20 custom fonts can be imported
• Built-in sticker collection
• Support of transparent .png images as watermark
• Quick sharing to Instagram, Facebook, Flickr etc.
• Backup of settings on device or in the cloud
• Easy selecting of recently used watermarks
• Adding of timestamp, filename, GPS tags and other properties as text watermark
• Full support of EXIF and XMP metadata
• Support of 360° panoramas
• Saving format .jpg or .png
• Rename and resize by saving
Limitations of the Free version:
• User defined image-watermarks are disabled
• Saving only as .jpg, downsized to 1024 px on the long side
• No auto mode while sharing images from other apps, no batch mode
Useful tips:
• Don't delete original images after watermarking, because you can't remove watermarks from processed images.
• To add watermark automatically with predefined settings, select photos in Gallery, then "Share" them to "Add Watermark".
• Import up to 20 custom fonts in the settings for text-watermark.
• To place a date stamp on photo insert placeholder %date% in watermark text in "Settings".
Many thanks to: 
Ben (for Samia) for translation in Portuguese!

bluejetty:00071167:ios.description:
Foodabee® is where Creative Food Play meets Virtual Pet fun!
Meet Bee, a friendly monster who loves to be fed and nurtured. In Foodabee, children care for Bee by creating food, watching him grow, and discovering how play leads to progress.
WHY PARENTS LOVE FOODABEE
• 100% Ad-Free & Safe
A secure, trusted environment with no third-party advertising.
• Nurturing Play
The unique “Feed & Grow” mechanic teaches cause-and-effect as Bee evolves through play.
• Creative Confidence
Open-ended food play encourages imagination while helping Bee grow.
• Irish Heritage
Created by Bluebear, a small Irish company with a 10-year legacy in family apps.
EXPLORE A WORLD OF FOOD PLAY
The Bakery
Design dream cupcakes, rainbow cakes, and gingerbread cookies.
Fun Snacks
Make popcorn, hot dogs, and avocado toast.
The Sweet Shop
Craft ice cream, cotton candy, lollipops, and slushies.
Pizza Parlor
Bake delicious pizzas from scratch.
HOW IT WORKS
• Pick your favorite food maker
• Create by interactive mixing, baking, and decorating
• Feed Bee your creation and watch his reaction
• Grow Bee to unlock new levels and milestones
SUPPORT & PRIVACY
Support: help@foodabee.com
Privacy: https://www.bluebear.ie/foodabee_privacy.html
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Note: Foodabee is free to download with select makers. Unlock the full world and all content through a safe, parent-only subscription or one-time purchase.
ABOUT BLUEBEAR
We are a small Irish company focused on making high-quality apps for kids and families.
FOODABEE® is a registered trademark of Bluebear Technologies Ltd.

bluejetty:00115990:ios.description:
Bring the joy of diamond coloring into your daily unwind!
Antistress Diamond Painting brings you the most realistic and soothing digital experience while staying creative! Top-notch handcrafted content created in line with the DMC palette, will help you become a more relaxed and creative person!
WHY USE ANTISTRESS DIAMOND PAINTING
● Tilt your phone or tablet and watch the diamonds sparkle - just like real ones!
● Use your finger to paint, or enhance your experience with the Apple Pencil. It becomes your diamond applicator! Double-tap to switch between placing one diamond endlessly or tapping with a multi-diamond tip.
● No more guessing! Tap a color on the palette to highlight exactly where it goes. Or tap any spot on the canvas to see all matching areas instantly. You can also use Apple Pencil double tap for that!
● Almost everything is free! Unlock more by painting, earning stars, leveling up, or collecting coins.
● New daily artwork is added every day - claim it while it’s fresh! Missed a day? Only subscribers can access past daily content.
● Subscribe to get tons of bonuses: exclusive paintings, access to all daily content, and no more ads!
People all over the world are already enjoying our unique way of colouring – with over 1 000 000 paintings painted each month! Join them!
If you see anything we can improve, please, let us know! New reviews and support emails are really helpful to make our app better and smarter! Contact us via diamond@crimsonpine.com
___________________
SUBSCRIPTION INFO
By subscribing, you get unlimited access to all premium (marked with diamond) and locked (marked with padlock) paintings.
GOOD TO KNOW
● You can subscribe to a monthly plan (starting at $14.99, billed once a month). Availability and pricing of subscription plans may vary.
● The payment will be charged to your iTunes Account when you confirm the purchase.
● The subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original plan unless canceled at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
● Free trial automatically converts to a paid subscription unless canceled at least 24-hours before the end of the trial period. From that point onwards, subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
● You can cancel the subscription or the free trial anytime via the subscription setting through your iTunes account (go to your device settings and tap iTunes & App Store > Apple ID > View Apple ID > enter the password > Subscriptions > Assembly > Cancel Subscription button at the bottom). Do it at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. Learn more: http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098
● Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases subscription.
Terms of Service: https://www.crimsonpine.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.crimsonpine.com/privacy-policy

• Хаанаас ч, Хурдан, Хялбар: Утасны дугаараар мөнгө шилжүүлэх/нэхэмжлэх боломжтой. (шимтгэл 0 төгрөг)

• Лояалти хөтөлбөр: Голомт банкны лояалти системтийг SocialPay аппликейшны үндсэн үйлчилгээ болгон оруулж ирсэн.
• Бусад нэмэлт үйлчилгээ – Гуравдагч талын мини апп-ууд

bluejetty:00084043:ios.description:
Experience the ultimate thrill of city racing and driving in "Car Driving City Racer Games." Immerse yourself in a stunning 3D world where you can race through bustling city streets, complete exciting missions, and customize your dream cars. Whether you’re a speed demon, a car enthusiast, or someone who loves exploring virtual cities, this game has something for everyone.
Key Features:
1=Explore a Massive City:
Drive through diverse districts, each with its unique charm. From the bustling Downtown District with its skyscrapers and neon lights to the serene Countryside District with winding roads and beautiful landscapes, the city is yours to explore.
2=Collect and Customize Cars:
Build your ultimate car collection with a variety of vehicles ranging from classic muscle cars to modern sports cars. Upgrade and customize your cars with performance parts, paint jobs, and unique accessories to make them truly yours.
3=Exciting Racing Modes:
Test your skills in multiple racing modes including Quick Race, Career Mode, and Time Trials. Compete in high-speed races, navigate through challenging tracks, and aim for the top spot on the leaderboards.
4= Realistic Car Mechanics:
Experience realistic car physics and mechanics. Tune and upgrade your vehicles to enhance their performance on the streets. The in-depth customization options let you tweak every aspect of your car, ensuring the best racing experience.
5= Diverse Missions and Challenges:
Engage in a variety of missions and challenges. From thrilling races to time-bound delivery missions and precision driving challenges, there’s always something exciting to do.
6= Achievements and Rewards:
Unlock achievements as you progress through the game. Earn rewards for completing missions, winning races, and collecting cars. Show off your accomplishments and climb the ranks to become the ultimate city racer.
7= Dynamic Open World:
Enjoy a dynamic open-world environment with day and night cycles, weather changes, and lively city streets. Explore hidden locations, discover shortcuts, and take in the breathtaking views as you drive.
Gameplay Highlights:
City Exploration: Navigate through different districts, each offering unique scenery and challenges. From the Industrial District’s rugged terrain to the Coastal District’s scenic routes, every area provides a new adventure.
Car Collection: Expand your garage with an impressive collection of cars. Each vehicle can be fully customized and upgraded, allowing you to create the ultimate driving machine.
Mission Variety: Take on diverse missions that test your driving skills. Participate in pick-and-drop tasks, perform high-flying stunts, complete time attack challenges, and handle delivery missions with precision.
Why You’ll Love It:
"Car Driving City Racer Games" offers a comprehensive racing and driving experience that caters to all types of players. Whether you’re looking to speed through city streets, explore a beautifully crafted open world, or customize your favorite cars, this game delivers an unmatched level of excitement and engagement. The realistic car mechanics, stunning 3D graphics, and diverse gameplay modes ensure that there’s always something new and exciting to discover
.
Download "Car Driving City Racer Games" now and embark on your ultimate city driving adventure!

bluejetty:00178372:ios.description:
This application measures the shortest (air) distance between point A and point B using GPS, with the maximum available accuracy. Distances are displayed in yards, meters, kilometers, and miles.
Simply reset the ruler at point A and watch the distance counters increase as you move toward point B—just like using a real tape measure or ruler.
Primary uses for approximate sizing and measuring include:
Land, grounds, and properties
Real estate
Golf course yardage
Sports facilities and tracks
Air distance
Other outdoor measurements
The application is intended for outdoor use only and requires location services to be enabled.
How to use:
Go to the starting point (A) and press the RESET button to initialize the distance counters.
Walk to the target point (B) while watching the distance counters increase.
The point A arrow continuously shows the direction back to the starting point.
You can close the application at any time during a measurement. When reopened, the application will continue the current measurement.

bluejetty:00073967:ios.name: bless. minimal shopping habits
bluejetty:00073967:ios.summary: Introducing bless, the perfect shopping companion that helps you adopt a mindful approach to shopping. Whether you want to keep track of your spending, declutter your living space, adopt a minimalist lifestyle, or make purchases that reflec
bluejetty:00073967:ios.description:
Introducing bless, the perfect shopping companion that helps you adopt a mindful approach to shopping. Whether you want to keep track of your spending, declutter your living space, adopt a minimalist lifestyle, or make purchases that reflect your values, bless has got you covered. The whimsical raccoon guide will assist you in making thoughtful purchase decisions and developing a healthier relationship with material possessions.
Bless is more than just an app - it's a partner on your journey towards mindful consumption, offering insightful features and supportive guidance to make every purchase meaningful.
Mindful Wishlist:
Add the things you wish to buy and revisit them after a set period. This feature promotes thoughtful purchases, reduces impulsive buying, and encourages reflection on spending habits.
Expense Tracker:
Track your expenses, understand your spending habits, and align purchases with your values using an intuitive interface that simplifies the process.
Don't Want Anymore List:
Catalog items you decided not to purchase, keep track of your savings and reflect on your consumption choices. Most importantly, be proud of your mindful decisions.
Got Rid Of List:
Log your progress in decluttering your living space. Select how you've parted ways with your non-essential possessions, whether you sold them or gave them away. Revisit the list and experience the satisfaction of seeing how far you've come.
“Should I?” Test:
A feature that encourages thoughtful spending through reflective questioning before making a purchase. You'll learn to make informed decisions and adopt a mindful approach to consumption.
Educational Content:
Discover a collection of resources on mindful shopping, minimalism, and conscious consumerism. Our raccoon companion provides daily tips to help make mindful consumption effortless.
Shopping Shield:
Your online shopping experience just got much more mindful. If you feel that browsing shopping apps and websites risks your budget and distracts you from more important things in your life, install Bless Shield. Now, you can block certain apps and websites and even pick entire categories, like social media, to help you stay focused and mindful of your spending.
Challenges:
Who doesn't love a good challenge? Try out a week or a month of decluttering (get rid of one thing a day), mindful shopping (log every purchase to the app), or digital detox (no online shopping). The longer you keep it up, the easier it gets. Even if you don't complete the whole thing, don't lose your motivation; you can always start again!
Premium features:
Subscribing to the bless premium plan gives you access to a variety of handy features. You can easily set up and change currencies, track your shopping tendencies via colorful charts, and select your preferred raccoon icon. We appreciate your support and plan for many future updates!
Term of Use: https://www.getbless.app/privacy-terms

bluejetty:00180459:ios.description:
Finale To Do is a powerful daily planner, task manager and habit tracker. It is a flexible tool to help you organize to-do lists, manage tasks, build good habits, track shopping lists, schedule agenda, and much more. Finale To Do will let you get things done and stay on track.
Tasks
• Easily create detailed tasks
• Set multiple reminders for each task
• Create flexible recurring tasks*
• Automatic date recognition from tasks title
• Organize tasks by Smart Lists
• Design custom to-do lists with colors, icons, and emojis
• Various task list sorting options
• Highlight tasks by priority
• Share task lists for collaboration*
• Batch edit tasks
• Add tasks from the home screen
Habits
• Create and track habits 
• Set Habit Goals to improve your progress* 
• Add flexible repeat settings for habits* 
• Decorate habits using custom icons and colors
• Receive daily habit streak reminders to stay motivated
Focus 
• Use Pomodoro Timer to concentrate on scheduled work
• Break your work day into chunks using Pomodoro and Stopwatch
• Focus on a specific task to become concentrated
• Receive reminders to take a break or resume work
Notes
• Create detailed notes and rich text documents
• Set reminders and repeat settings for each note
• Customize notes with custom icons and emojis
• Export, share, or print notes as documents
Features to help you stay organized and boost productivity
• Widgets for tasks and habits on home and lock screens
• Change themes to fit your personal style
• Protect tasks and habits using passcode and Face ID*
• Import iOS reminders as to-do lists*
• Automatically sync iOS Calendar as to-do events*
• Earn daily motivating achievements
How Finale To Do helps you become productive?
• Always stay on top of personal daily tasks
• Get reminded when you need it
• Build good habits or get rid of bad ones
• To-do lists, habits, plans, agendas, and notes all in one place
• Collaborate on task lists together to boost efficiency
Finale To Do is free to download and features marked by a star (*) are available with Finale Pro — an optional upgrade offered either as a one-time Lifetime purchase, or a lower-priced Monthly / Annual subscription.
About Finale Pro plan:
You can purchase a Lifetime plan once, and keep Finale Pro forever without any additional fees. Alternatively, you can choose a monthly or an annual plan at a lower price. If you upgrade to the monthly Pro plan, payment will be charged to your Apple ID account, which will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Please feel free to manage or cancel the auto-renew subscription in your Apple ID Account Settings at any time after purchase.
Finale To Do integrates HealthKit, so you could sync Pomodoro time to Apple Health.
For questions, feedback, or suggestions, we are happy to help you at info@finaletodo.com
Connect with us:

Twitter: @FinaleToDo
Help Center: https://help.finaletodo.com
Terms of Use: https://finaletodo.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://finaletodo.com/privacy

bluejetty:00027206:ios.description:
Make accurate nursing diagnoses and develop effective care plans with this comprehensive app. Each diagnosis listing includes a definition, related factors, defining characteristics, prioritized actions/interventions, NIC/NOC classifications, and documentation guidelines. Or, choose by patient symptom and link directly to associated nursing diagnoses. 
Features of Nurse’s Pocket Guide include: 
• 400+ medical conditions with associated nursing diagnoses
• NEW! Each diagnosis updated to incorporate the NCSBN Clinical Judgment Measurement Model (NCJMM) terminology
• NEW! Completely up to date with diagnoses from the latest NANDA-I and ICNP (International Classification for Nursing Practice), broadening students’ understanding of the standardized nursing languages they’ll encounter throughout their careers. 
• Defining characteristics presented subjectively and objectively
• Actions/Interventions organized by nursing priority with rationales.
• Care plan guides
• Icons for cultural, collaborative, community/home care, diagnostic studies, pediatric/geriatric/lifespan, and medications
• NIC and NOC labels for each diagnosis
• Full Text Search helps you find topics quickly
• Highlight and make notes within any entry
• “Favorites” for bookmarking important entries
• Personalize your app with highlights and notes
Authors: Marilynn E. Doenges, APRN, BC; Mary Francis Moorhouse, RN, MSN, CRRN, LNC

bluejetty:00099054:ios.description:
From the bloody shadows, demons surge. Cities fall. The sky burns.
Long held in fragile balance, the forces that shaped existence are now tearing it apart. As cracks form between realms, demonic legions pour through, merciless, endless, unstoppable. OnirO is a brand-new action RPG forged in the spirit of classic hack ‘n’ slash games. Reimagined for modern players, it delivers fast-paced combat, deep class customization, and a dark fantasy world filled with dangers, secrets, and power.
Explore a land where solemn gothic ruins merge with the elegance and mysticism of ancient Eastern traditions. From cursed temples to shattered citadels, OnirO offers a rich, haunting atmosphere like no other.
Fight back the tide. Master forbidden abilities. Forge your own path through chaos.
What rises from the ashes of balance… is entirely up to you.
IMMERSIVE DARK FANTASY EXPERIENCE
• Stunning high-quality graphics, fully optimized for mobile
• A haunting fantasy world full of dark atmosphere and mystery
• Fast-paced action with responsive controls
• Full controller support
• Over 100 dungeon to explore
• Multiple difficulty modes to challenge every kind of player
• A rich endgame content with secrets to uncover
• Epic boss fights that test your skills
• An immersive soundtrack that brings the world to life
• Play the full campaign offline, no internet connection required
LEGENDARY LOOT & GEAR CUSTOMIZATION
• Collect and equip over 200 unique legendary items
• Enhance your gear through upgrades and rare materials
• Socket powerful gems into your equipment to boost your stats
• Choose from over 20 weapon types, from twin blades to greatswords, to suit your playstyle
MASTER THE MULTICLASS SYSTEM
• Shape your hero through a vast, interconnected skill tree
• Unlock up to 21 unique classes, like Samurai or Heremite, each with their own abilities and passive bonuses
• Mix and match abilities from multiple classes to create truly unique builds
• Choose your path carefully: every branch leads to new combos, synergies, and powerful effects
• Forge your own playstyle, from unstoppable tanks to lightning fast glass cannons
TOTALLY FREE-TO-PLAY
The game can be played totally for free. Some in-app purchases are available for the ones who want to unlock extra features and that want to support the development of this new Action RPG for Mobile Devices!
©2025 Redeev s.r.l. All rights reserved. Oniro is registered trademarks of Redeev s.r.l

"When I mark up my s
bluejetty:00174952:ios.description:
Scriptation is the Emmy®-winning script annotation app trusted by directors, script supervisors, actors, development executives, and production teams on film and television sets worldwide, from prep through production.
"When I mark up my script, I use Scriptation now." (Kathy Bates)
"Scriptation changed my life. Every time you get a new draft, it transfers all your notes." (Sophia Bush)
The script changes. Your work stays with it.
FOR DIRECTORS & WRITERS
Organize your entire prep in one digital production binder.
• Annotate scripts with highlights, notes, photos, Apple Pencil drawings, and audio
• Transfer markups to new revisions automatically in seconds
• Use layers to separate personal, department, and meeting notes
• Insert facing pages, shot lists, set plans, and reference images
• Create and share daily sides directly from the app
• Listen to your script read aloud with customizable character voices
• Keep scripts, call sheets, schedules, and production documents in one place
No more 3-ring binders. No more rewriting notes when revisions land.
FOR PRODUCTION & DEPARTMENTS
Break down scripts, tag elements, and generate reports.
• Tag props, wardrobe, locations, VFX, SFX, and more with custom categories
• Generate formatted breakdown reports as PDF or CSV
• Include photos, reference notes, and scene details
• Integrate with planning apps like Cinapse, SetHero, Shamel Studio, Shot Lister, and Think Crew
• Transfer tags to new revisions so breakdowns stay current
Perfect for assistant directors, department heads, producers, and anyone else on set who interacts with a script.
FOR SCRIPT SUPERVISORS
Professional lining and continuity tools built for production.
• Generate instant scene coverage tramlines
• Add facing page reports and mark takes directly in the script
• Maintain continuity notes across scenes and revisions
• Transfer lining and notes when new drafts arrive. Nothing lost.
Built for how modern script supervisors actually work on set.
FOR ACTORS
Prepare for auditions and rehearse scenes, no scene partner needed.
• Highlight your character's lines in one tap
• Rehearse with customizable character voices and scene looping
• Use Record Mode as a self-tape teleprompter with slate delays
• Transfer your annotations when new drafts arrive. No rewriting.
Whether you're prepping sides, running lines, or recording a self-tape, Scriptation turns your script into a rehearsal studio.
FOR DEVELOPMENT EXECUTIVES
Evaluate scripts faster. Listen to them, mark them up, and share notes.
• Listen to scripts with distinct character voices to hear dialogue, pacing, and tone
• Use it as a table read on the go between meetings or during a commute
• Annotate scripts as you read or listen
• Share note layers with creative teams while keeping personal notes separate
Whether you're reading for a greenlight or giving notes on a draft, Scriptation lets you experience the script, not just read it.
SCRIPTATION INDUSTRY PRO
Unlock the full production toolkit across all your devices.
Industry Pro includes advanced Note Transfer, multi-layer transfer, collate pages, compare scripts, breakdown tagging and reports, facing pages, daily sides, script supervisor lining tools, advanced layers, collaboration, and rehearsal tools for actors.
Premium AI features and AI voice access may require a separate AI subscription.
Scriptation offers optional auto-renewing subscriptions, including Industry Pro and AI access, with monthly and/or annual options where available. A free 14-day trial may be available for eligible offers.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Renewal is charged within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions in Apple Account Settings.
Terms of Use: https://scriptation.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://scriptation.com/privacy

bluejetty:00071761:ios.name: Ball Sort - Color Sort Game
bluejetty:00071761:ios.summary:
A calm ball sorting puzzle with 10,000 levels and no timer. Tap a tube to lift the balls, tap another to drop them in, and collect each color in its own tube.
There is no move limit, no lives and no energy. You can't lose a level, every le
bluejetty:00071761:ios.description:
A calm ball sorting puzzle with 10,000 levels and no timer. Tap a tube to lift the balls, tap another to drop them in, and collect each color in its own tube.
There is no move limit, no lives and no energy. You can't lose a level, every level is guaranteed solvable, and you can play without internet.
A few levels in, the balls start to play tricks. The main levels bring six twists, one at a time, between levels 8 and 80, each with a short card that explains it. Later levels combine them.
• Different heights: tubes hold 3 to 6 balls, and a color is complete only in a tube that fits all of it.
• Scattered start: balls are spread unevenly across the tubes, even the spare ones.
• Candy wrappers: a wrapped ball hides its color until it reaches the top.
• Color tubes: a colored tube takes only balls of its own color.
• Caramel: a stuck ball stays put until a ball of the same color lands on it.
• Ribbons: a tied tube opens when you complete the tube of the ribbon's color.
What else is in the game
• One move carries all the top balls of the same color, as many as fit.
• Daily Challenge: one Hard level a day, with a streak that raises the bonus coins.
• Difficulty: levels are marked Easy, Normal, Hard or Expert, with easier stretches after hard ones.
• Boards: 3 to 12 colors, 5 to 15 tubes and up to 66 balls, in six layouts such as pyramid, arch and wave.
• Stars: 1 to 3 per level. Fewer moves earn more stars, and every star adds coins.
• Gifts: every 10th level gives coins and a hint.
• Undo and Restart cost no coins, and undo keeps your stars.
• A hint looks for your next move from the current position. +Tube adds an empty tube, up to two per level. You start with 3 hints and 2 spare tubes, and coins buy more.
• Color symbols: a setting for color-blind players. Each of the 12 colors gets its own mark on the balls.
• Sound, music and vibration each have their own switch, and music from other apps keeps playing.
• For iPhone and iPad, in portrait or landscape, at up to 120 Hz on supported screens.
• No account or sign-in.
Ads and purchases
The game shows ads between levels and when you return to it. Reward videos start only when you tap a button with a video mark. All levels unlock as you play, with no payment needed. In-app purchases are optional: coin packs, a one-time purchase that removes ads, and a Starter Pack with the same ad removal plus coins, hints and spare tubes. Ad removal turns off the ads between levels and on return. You can still choose to watch reward videos. Ads, reward videos and purchases need an internet connection.

bluejetty:00027165:ios.description:
Transform your Instagram Profile into a professional look with Griddy – the All-In-One tool for creating grid posts, seamless carousel layouts, engaging instagram stories, and visually captivating content. Whether you’re an influencer, small business owner, or content creator, Griddy simplifies Instagram marketing like never before.
*** Key Features ***
1. Photo Splitter
Griddy makes it easy to split your photos into grid layouts for Instagram, with options for up to 10 rows (30 posts) to create eye-catching feed layout. YChoose from predefined grid layouts such as 1x3, 2x3, 3x3, or 4x3 with a single tap to quickly achieve a stunning Instagram feed or slice panorama photos into seamless carousel posts with ease.
For more control, you can split your photo into custom grid layouts and adjust the aspect ratio (landscape, square, portrait, story to fit your unique style.
2. Puzzle Feed Templates
Design seamless puzzle-style Instagram feeds with our aesthetic template. Perfect for creating a cohesive, professional look.
3. Carousel Post Maker
Turn your regular carousel posts into seamless photo collages or image galleries in seconds, ensuring your audience swipes for more.
4. Photo Collage Maker
Easily combine multiple photos with our easy-to-use, free photo collage maker app. Create beautiful collages from your photos and choose from dozens of creative layouts!
5. 500+ Customizable Templates
Choose from a diverse collection of fully customizable templates for different content types such as Grid Feeds, Carousel Posts, Stories, and Square Posts, curated for your business and brand.
6. Design Anything
Create on-trend Instagram posts with beautiful text fonts, stickers, and shapes. With our easy-to-use tools, you can do anything effortlessly with zoom & edit mode, working with layers, and multiple selection.
7. Add Text with Style
Enhance your posts with text effects like curved text, strokes, shadows, background colors, and rounded corners to make your captions pop.
8. Resize & Crop Photos
Quickly resize your photos to different Instagram Post sizes with a beautiful background color selection.
9. Watermark Tool
Protect your photos and content with an instant watermarking feature, ideal for maintaining your brand’s identity.
10. Brand Kit
Manage and apply your brand's logos, fonts, and colors to your designs easily. 
Import custom fonts to elevate your projects.
11. Preview Mode
See how your Instagram feed, carousel post, or story will look before sharing with your audience.
12. Share to Instagram
Export your grid or carousel posts directly to Instagram in HD quality with just a few taps.
Why Choose Griddy?
Griddy is your all-in-one solution for Instagram marketing, helping you:
• Split photos into Instagram grid layouts.
• Create seamless carousel posts from panoramic photos.
• Design professional-looking puzzle feeds.
• Save time with easy-to-use design tools.
• Grow your brand with visually stunning content.
Download Griddy Now!
Level up your Instagram profile with creative grids, seamless carousels, and aesthetic puzzle feeds. Whether you’re growing a brand or expressing your creativity, Griddy makes it easy and fun!
Follow us on Instagram @griddyapp to get inspired and explore amazing designs made with Griddy.
If you enjoy using Griddy, we’d love to hear from you! Leave a review or contact us at support@cornapps.com.

bluejetty:00115920:ios.summary:
Reading Stars is a fun, easy-to-use reading app that helps kids build skills and confidence—one story at a time.
Created in partnership with the award-winning Cricket® magazine, Reading Stars offers thousands of engaging, Lexile® level-mat
bluejetty:00115920:ios.description:
Reading Stars is a fun, easy-to-use reading app that helps kids build skills and confidence—one story at a time.
Created in partnership with the award-winning Cricket® magazine, Reading Stars offers thousands of engaging, Lexile® level-matched Children's Books in English, fun games, and daily rewards that turn reading into a habit that sticks. Whether it's a quick bedtime read or a longer story adventure, there's something for every reader.
This isn't just another reading app—it's a journey through epic stories and unforgettable Children's Books.
Read aloud or read along—the choice is theirs. With narration and word-by-word highlighting, even early readers can enjoy Children's Books independently. Perfect for bedtime, weekend learning, or storytime with family.
WHAT KIDS GET FROM READING STARS
- Learn in Just 10 Minutes a Day: Build strong reading habits, comprehension, phonics, and vocabulary—while keeping reading fun with Children's Books they'll love.
- Read → Quiz → Reward: Game-like tasks and earned rewards make reading feel exciting and meaningful.
- Confidence from the First Story: Books are matched to each child's level, curated by Cricket Magazine's expert editors.
- Vocabulary That Lasts: Memory games, read aloud tools, and phonics support help kids master new words.
AWARD-WINNING LIBRARY TO EXPLORE
- Original stories, articles, poems, and comics—across science, art, history, and more.
- Personalized suggestions based on age, level, and interests.
- Special themed collections for holidays, trending topics, bedtime, and key milestones.
- Perfect for all levels—kids always find Children's Books they love.
DAILY READING IN 5 EASY STEPS
- Story Spark – Questions spark curiosity and interest.
- Read – Use read aloud or read along modes.
- Quiz – Comprehension, vocabulary, phonics checks.
- Play – Word games that reinforce learning.
- Reward – Earn stars and build your own reading city!
KEY FEATURES
- Created with Cricket Magazine (Parents' Choice, NAPPA, Academics' Choice)
- Structured with Lexile® for level matching
- Read-to-Me mode with word-by-word highlighting
- Guided paths or free exploration
- Smart filters to build your Children's Books library
- 100% ad-free, safe learning space
- New Children's Books and bedtime stories monthly
Our Mission
Reading Stars was built to spark a love of reading in kids that lasts a lifetime.
We believe real reading builds real confidence—and Reading Stars makes learning joyful and meaningful every day.
Questions or feedback?
Contact us anytime at readingstars@bekids.com

Once subscribed you can access all content and features of Reading Stars. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscriptions and turn off automatic renewal in your Apple Account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://www.bekids.com/privacy/en/privacy.html
Terms of Service: https://www.bekids.com/terms/en/terms.html

bluejetty:00092334:ios.description:
* 21 different adventure types, Hiking, Biking, Kayaking, Rock Climbing and Backcountry skiing all in one app.
* 40,000+ adventures fully mapped - never get lost again!
* Share adventures with your friends, build up your profile and contribute your favorite photos and routes.
* Share your location with friends and other Bivy users. Make it easy to stay safe and found.
FIND
• Easily find any kind of outdoor adventure near you. Filter by activity type, difficulty, and quality. 
• Bivy has 17 different adventure types: Hiking, mountain biking, road biking, trail running, cross-country skiing, snowshoeing, camping, rock climbing, mountaineering, backcountry skiing, canyoneering, bouldering, aid climbing, kayaking, canoeing, rafting, sea kayaking, SUV, UTV, Snowmobile, ATV, and Motorcycle.
• Search by map or list. Get directions to the start of every adventure
TRACK
• Let Bivy track your location on the full path of every adventure. 
• If you go off-route, Bivy will alert you to get back on the right path.
• Keep track of your pace, mileage, calories burned, top speed, resting time and ETA.
SHARE
• Locate other friends and Bivy users in the outdoors. See other adventurers near you.
• Find out who has completed adventures you are interested in. And see comments on each adventure
• Build status in the community by completing adventures and uploading your own adventures, photos, comments, and corrections. Be the most accomplished adventurer in your neck of the woods. 
• Every uploaded adventure is vetted by our knowledgeable staff so you can trust the accuracy and quality of the data.
SAFETY
• Share your location with friends or other Bivy users. If you don’t come back on time, they will be able to see your path and location.
• Every adventure description gives you detailed information on distance, elevation, and difficulty
• While you are tracking, Bivy will tell you how much further you have and your expected time of arrival at your current pace.
BIVYSTICK
• Connect via Bluetooth to the Bivystick. Turn your Cell phone into a satellite communication device.
• Send and receive text messages when you are out of phone service
• Send an SOS and get in communication with EMS from ANYWHERE in the world.
• Access to point weather forecasts
• Detailed downloadable maps that can be used when you are offline or without service.
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00066119:ios.description:
Rage hard..
Marathon Infinity® is the climactic conclusion to Bungie's groundbreaking Marathon® Trilogy. Learn the the truth about the events of Classic Marathon® and Marathon: Durandal® first hand in "Blood Tides of Lh’owon", the single player portion of Infinity.
ENHANCEMENTS
 • High frame rate support
 • Updated HD Sprite set
 • 3D positional sound with HRTF
 • Texture parallax mapping
 • Multiplayer cross-play with Linux, Mac, PC, and Steam
 • Fan soundtrack by Talashar
FEATURES
 • 25 levels divided into four chapters
 • 5 hidden levels
 • missions include exploration, puzzles and extermination
 • "Carnage is as easy as point and shoot." ~Marathon Manual
 • introducing a new weapon: KKV-7 10mm SMG Flechette submachine gun
===== to.be.a.vidmaster ====
What does it mean to be a Vidmaster?
It is being balanced in the calm center of a whirling and untouchable tornado of destruction, while showers of grenades patter harmlessly around you and bullets crawl toward you in slow-mo.
It is when your brain develops a new bundle of nerves whose only function is to re-route impulses directly from your eyes to your finger muscles, so that you can twist and snap off a rocket long before you’re conscious of the yellow blip in your motion detector.
It is when the difference between a roomful of alien warriors and a carpet of them is a matter of seconds.
The word "vid" entered the Marathon lexicon during development of the first game, to distinguish the excellent players (particularly in net games) from the fodder. The Oath of the Vidmaster was inscribed into the skip-levels dialog (Command-Option-Begin New Game), to remind players of the highest level of excellence they could aspire to:
"I pledge to punch all switches, to never shoot where I could use grenades, to admit the existence of no level except Total Carnage, to never use Caps Lock as my 'run' key, and to never, ever, leave a single Bob alive."
To do these things is to invite maximum peril, and requires one to play the game as hard and unrelentingly as possible, at the highest level of skill; to play as a Vidmaster.
These three games, the Marathon® saga, are the best training and testing ground for Vidmasters. You can play against aliens alone or in a networked group through more than 80 levels. But the true challenge is surviving in one of the 50 included netgame arenas against other people. It is in such trials by fire that mighty Vidmasters are forged.
Rage hard..
=====
BUNGIE™, MARATHON® and the Bungie and Marathon logos are either trademarks or registered trademarks of Bungie, Inc., used with permission.

bluejetty:00178368:ios.summary:

Looking for a way to spend a quite five minutes? If you mean really quiet and incredibly stealthy, then head into Stealth Master, the silent but deadly mobile game that celebrates all things sneaky, sly, underhand and
bluejetty:00178368:ios.description:
► SILENT BUT DEADLY
Looking for a way to spend a quite five minutes? If you mean really quiet and incredibly stealthy, then head into Stealth Master, the silent but deadly mobile game that celebrates all things sneaky, sly, underhand and devious. Prove your ninja credentials by infiltrating buildings, sliding through the shadows, and taking out bad guys at close quarters, doing your job from a distance with a sniper rifle, or pulling off incredible daredevil heists without being seen in this fun action game that boasts loads of cool mechanics, scores of your favorite characters, and a deadly sense of humor.
► DID YOU HEAR SOMETHING?
• One last job – take contracts to eliminate gangsters, executives and other ne’er-do-wells in increasingly difficult ninja assassination missions that require skill, speed, and loads of stealth to reach and take out the boss.
• Tons of guns – try out a whole host of weapons, from the traditional cold steel of the kunai and katana to every type of gun imaginable, including high-powered sniper rifles. Find your favorite form of lethal force and hone your particular skill or choose the right tool for each job and become a true weapons master.
• Adapt to your environment – whether it’s dodging flashlights and lasers, using hidden passages, shooting up explosives to take out multiple enemies, or pretending to be a pot plant, Stealth Master offers dozens of different ways to use the surroundings to your advantage with ingenious game mechanisms that put variation and excitement in every level.
• Steal the unstealable – once you’ve mastered assassination, try your hand at the ultimate stealth task of hi-tech robbery. Now you won’t have to attack anyone, just stay in the shadows, slip past the guards and sophisticated security equipment, and grab the juicy loot without anyone seeing you. New robbery missions offer a combination of traditional stealth moves and a variety of fun brainteasers.
• Work remotely – tired of getting your hands dirty? Now you can do your nefarious deeds at a distance with tricky sniper levels. Train your sights on the target, plan your strategy, keep your head down, and make sure you’ve got an escape route.
• An incredible cast – complete missions and earn cash to unlock dozens of cool, pop culture-inspired characters that you can level up and train to be the ultimate assassins. Choose between action stars, superheroes, supervillains and a super-sneaky imposter to find your favorite ninja.
► THAT WAS UNEXPECTED!
Now with a load of new features, new game modes, new missions, new weapons, and a new character, Stealth Master is even more fun and exciting than before. Looking for action of the stealthy, surreptitious kind? Got what it takes to be a true master ninja assassin? Download the game now and get stealthing.
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

'Math Brain Booster' consists of different training modes, each of them consists of sequences of simple arithmetical tasks.

bluejetty:00166027:ios.description:
Controlla app provides a perfect solution for remote control of your Samsung TV. The sleek multi-button design ensures an intuitive, simple, and comfortable operation, giving you unparalleled control at your fingertips. We are seamlessly transforming your smartphone into a powerful remote control! 
Watch your favorite TV shows and movies using our unique streaming buttons for Netflix, Prime, and Youtube. Controlla makes watching what you love easier, browsing online, and accessing your favorite content.
Let us make your TV experience more straightforward and seamless with the new Samsung smart remote. We created this app for people who want easy & fast access to control their Samsung TV from their mobile device! 
This app gives you complete control over your Samsung Smart TV, including all of the
features of your old physical remote control and some more intelligent functions. To use Controlla, connect the mobile device and Smart TV to the same WIFI network and start using it.
***BUTTONS***
- Turn ON and OFF the TV (Supported models only)
- Home button
- Return button
- Numbers keyboard buttons(Enter a channel number for jumping right to it)
- Colors buttons (red, yellow, green, blue)
- Change channels (next and previous )
- Increase or decrease the volume (also using the Phone side buttons)
- Mute the sound (silent mode)
- Change the source (HDMI, PC, AV...)
- Access the 4 favorite buttons - Up / Down / Left / Right Navigation + center button “OK”
- Play / pause / Reverse / Fast Forward.
- Netflix button, Amazon prime button, and Youtube button
- Settings button
- Menu button
***FEATURES***
- No infrared equipment required, just Wi-Fi connection
- Every time you open the app, your TV will be auto-connected for quick and easy access
- Realistic and user-friendly app design
- Light vibration when pressing buttons
- Connect to multiple TVs with the same phone + option to switch between the devices
Forget about the hassle of searching for the physical remote or dealing with clunky on-screen keyboards. Our app ensures a seamless and efficient control experience, putting you in command of your entertainment.
Whether you're binge-watching your favorite series, exploring the latest movies, or catching up on YouTube videos, this app empowers you with the tools you need.
With just a few taps, you can unleash the power of Controlla Samsung Smart Remote and take charge of your TV viewing - Simplify Your TV Control!
Download Controlla now and Simplify your Samsung TV control from your phone.
Premium Subscription Offer:
Get full app access with an annual Premium subscription for seamless convenience, the subscription fee of $39.99/year (United States) will be billed to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase.
Subscription Details:
- Payment will be charged to the iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews each year unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, at the original subscription rate.
- Manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a Premium subscription.
- To restore a purchase on a new device or regain premium, tap "Restore Purchase" in the app settings.
For support or inquiries, contact us in-app or visit https://www.controlla-tv.com/.
Please review our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service for more information:
Privacy Policy: https://www.controlla-tv.com/
Terms of Service: https://www.controlla-tv.com/controlla-tv-terms-of-use
Prices may vary based on your region and are subject to change without notice. Local taxes may apply.

bluejetty:00117670:ios.name: Flight of the Amazon Queen
bluejetty:00117670:ios.summary:
"A great game, that'll give you hours of fun and leave you feeling good. We love it!"
-Mr. Bill's Adventureland
"Walks on the fine line between Monkey Island and Indiana Jones without falling."
"A well-executed adventure."
- Leading MobyGa
bluejetty:00117670:ios.description:
"A great game, that'll give you hours of fun and leave you feeling good. We love it!"
-Mr. Bill's Adventureland
"Walks on the fine line between Monkey Island and Indiana Jones without falling."
"A well-executed adventure."
- Leading MobyGames reviewers
The year is 1949 and you assume the role of Joe King, a pilot for hire who is given the job of flying Faye Russell (a famous movie star) into the Amazon jungle for a photo shoot.
Of course, things never go according to plans. After an unfortunate turn of events they find themselves stranded in the heart of the Amazon jungle, where Joe will embark on a quest to rescue a kidnapped princess and in the process, encounter a dangerous temple, fearsome Amazonian warriors, and a powerful mad scientist intent on taking over the world!
It's up to you to deal with the imminent threat of world domination … but be careful, or this may be the last Flight of the Amazon Queen!
The game features:
- A classic graphic adventure based on the much-loved LucasArts adventure games and the adventure films of the '40s
- Explore over 100 exotic locations and interact with over 40 wildly individual characters including, but not limited to, a tribe of Amazon women and 6-foot-tall pygmies
- Witty dialogues packed with sassy humor will make you laugh out loud
- FULL voice-acting including the talents of the famous British actress Penelope Keith, Actor William Hootkins who played Red Six(Jek Porkins) in Star Wars, Brad Lavelle, Tom Hill, Enn Reitel, Jon Coleman, Debbie Arnold and more!
'20th Anniversary Edition' features:
- Totally new, much praised, game play controls that were built from the ground up for touch-screens.
 * Hotspot based - no more pixel hunting!
 * All-new slick icons and animations.
 * For more details, please see our tutorial video: https://youtu.be/Scq1QDKOFHA
- High-end graphics upscaling (xBR filter) for high-resolution displays
- Completely new game menus and save/load system
- Music options: MT-32 or Original Adlib 
- Optional retro settings: play with original graphics and even the original controls (mouse pointer)
- A lot of extras:
 * ‘The Making of’ booklet (35 pages)
 * Interview Mini-Game featurette with Commentary by Game Creator
 * Original US and EU manuals
 * The Official Playing Guide (97 pages)
- Multiple languages (ALL included without additional payment):
English voice acting, with the option for adding subtitles in English, Spanish, Italian and Hebrew
German voice acting with or without German subtitles
French voice acting with or without French subtitles
The 20th Anniversary Edition produced and developed by MojoTouch © 2008-2018 all rights reserved.
Licensed from Red Sprite Studios - the original game developer. An Australia-based company.
Uses ScummVM which is protected under GNU-GPL v2. For more information, please visit http://mojo-touch.com/gpl
LucasArts, Monkey Island, Indiana Jones and Star Wars are registered trademarks of Lucasfilm Ltd.

bluejetty:00064249:ios.name: Jigsaw Puzzles for Kids 2—5
bluejetty:00064249:ios.summary: The ONLY jigsaw puzzle game starring your child! These ad-free jigsaw puzzles are designed for toddlers and preschool kids, and help develop early learning skills such as shape recognition, matching, memory, logic, and hand-eye coordination
bluejetty:00064249:ios.description:
The ONLY jigsaw puzzle game starring your child! These ad-free jigsaw puzzles are designed for toddlers and preschool kids, and help develop early learning skills such as shape recognition, matching, memory, logic, and hand-eye coordination. All puzzles are hand-illustrated, and feature favorite preschool play activities - farm animals, cars, trucks, seasons, princesses and pirates. Toddlers can start with very easy levels, and older children will enjoy progressing through harder levels with more puzzle pieces.
"I love this app because it works on fine motor skills and also helps my son understand the concept of parts making a whole." App Store review
Just add your child's photo face to the Character Maker, and they become the star of hundreds of jigsaw puzzles - making playtime more engaging and meaningful, and encouraging imaginative role-play and storytelling. Why not add photo faces of family and friends? Children love playing with familiar faces!
"Lovely for personalization and engaging children." Literacy Trust Best Apps
Preschool learning fun for kids aged 2 -5 years old:
• Simple drag-and-drop puzzles develop fine motor skills & hand-eye coordination
• Jigsaws help children practise shape matching & memory skills
• The Character Maker encourages creative and imaginative pretend play - it's easy to add photo faces and customize hairstyles
• These puzzles grow with your children thanks to 5 difficulty levels from beginner to expert puzzler!
• Choose 4 pieces for beginners, up to 36 pieces for puzzle pros
• Totally Ad-free puzzles mean calm and positive screen time with no interruptions
• Play offline - perfect for road trips and flights
• Explore at your own pace, no rules or time pressures
• Easy enough to play alone, perfect to play together for super-charged fun learning!
Discover hours of puzzling fun for the whole family - from jigsaw beginners to champion puzzlers! Kids can choose their favorite preschool play themes from farm animals to vehicles, fairy tales to pirates. Enjoy calm, relaxing and quality screen-time together, with no lost jigsaw pieces.
Start puzzling straight away in this free version, which includes a selection of puzzles so you can try before you buy. All 5 levels are free, from easy puzzling with 4 pieces to hard puzzling with 36 pieces, and all customization options in the Character Maker are also free. Each full puzzle pack requires an in-app purchase, which is behind a parent lock. 
OkiPlay is our family business based in Yorkshire, England. We're parents too, so we take kids’ privacy and wellness very seriously. We love creating games for children. They inspire us to keep everything simple, authentic, beautiful, and fun. Our preschool apps are loved & trusted by parents, grandparents, teachers, and children all over the world. Here's what they say about OkiPlay:
* "I am a Speech-Language Pathologist working with 3-5 year olds. They are very engaged and love being a part of the game."
* "All excellent apps... they are very interactive, and it's brilliant how you can choose different family members to feature in them."
* "Absolutely gorgeous - both our children were totally captivated by this app ...the personalization feature is fantastic, and the graphics are charming."
* "My daughter squeals with delight at the sound of the app opening. She has a blast while developing her fine motor skills."
* "Thank you so much for creating something so adorable and educational for little ones."

bluejetty:00070184:ios.summary:
A new mobile game based on My Hero Academia is here!
Check out a lot of exclusive illustrations of the Heroes and the Villains!

What you'll find in MY HERO ULTRA IMPAC
bluejetty:00070184:ios.description:
A new mobile game based on My Hero Academia is here!
Check out a lot of exclusive illustrations of the Heroes and the Villains!
Recommend to you who want to enjoy strategic battles with their Quirks!
What you'll find in MY HERO ULTRA IMPACT:
- An explosive battle RPG with heroes and villains you know and love.
- Use your heroes’ iconic Quirks and let them shine!
- Climb the ranks to be the top hero!
▼ A casual 3-on-3 Quirk battle with your trained heroes and fierce opponents!
- Activate Quirks with the tap of a finger.
- Build skill chains with your heroes' Quirks!
- Break out your flashy Plus Ultra Moves for the final punch!
▼ It's on you to develop your favorite heroes' Quirks!
- Train up with U.A. High teachers and Pro Heroes at the Unforeseen Simulation Joint (USJ)
- Formidable enemies await at the never-before-seen VE Tower!
Put together your team of heroes, use the Quirks to your advantage, and stand bravely against the heinous pursuits of the villains looming ahead!
▼Relive the tale of My Hero Academia in the Main Quest!
The story begins with the meeting of the main character, Izuku Midoriya, and the Number One Hero, All Might.
Watch U.A. High Class 1-A learn and grow, and prepare for the looming threats of the League of Villains and the Shie Hassaikai!
Face off against Class 1-B in cross-class matches and get ready for the work studies at Endeavor Agency!
And prepare for the showdown against the League of Villains and Meta Liberation Army!
Relive beloved scenes from the anime as you strive to turn Deku and his friends into pro heroes!
▼ Check out a collection of exclusive illustrations!
- Display your favorite Ultra Rare character on your Home screen and watch them come alive with the “Cinemagraphy” feature!
- Train your characters to awaken them and unlock new original illustrations.
▼ Customize your Hero Base as U.A. High School, a villain hideout or more!
- Invite your heroes and villains to your space!
▼ Test your skills in Ultra Arena!
- Challenge other players and battle against their hero teams.
- Leverage the Quirks of your carefully trained heroes to win!
- Master the game and claim your spot at the top of the rankings.
▼Interact with other players in Clubs!
Use fun stickers made just for the app and chat with friends!
· Official Website
https://heroaca-ui.bn-ent.net/en/
· Official Facebook Page

• Travel across the world and explore beautiful locations and famous landmarks!
• Outfit your train with food, entertainment or comfort cars to increase passenger happiness and keep business booming!

bluejetty:00128407:ios.description:
Welcome to the World of Motorola by Hubble Connected…. Where we empower parents, home owners and expectant mothers to stay connected to what matters most, no matter where they are.
The Motorola by Hubble Connected app provides one centralised place to manage all your smart prenatal, baby, nursery and home products with the touch of a button, from anywhere in the world.
- SAFE & SECURE
With advanced end-to-end encryption technology and AES 128-bit streaming, you can rest assured knowing that your camera stream and other data is totally private and secure.
- RECORD, STORE & SHARE*
Record videos and image snapshots and save them using our secure cloud storage. Or easily share them with family and friends.
- DAILY VIDEO SUMMARY*
Get a quick overview of what went on when you weren’t home. Rewind with a time-lapse Daily Video Summary of the key motion-triggered events from the past 24 hours.
- TWO-WAY TALK
Speak to and hear your loved ones, callers, or intruders from anywhere. Sing your little one to sleep with a lullaby, chat to the delivery guy about where to leave your parcel, or scare off unwelcome visitors in crystal clear sound.
- CREATE VIRTUAL BOUNDARIES**
Only get alerted about the important things with SmartZone. Select specific areas to receive motion detection notifications for, such as doors, gates, and windows.
- VOICE ASSISTANCE
Control your monitor or other voice assistant compatible products hands-free using Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant. Use your voice while multi-tasking to turn on your camera’s recording, ask for the temperature, play a lullaby, and more.
- BABY TRACKER
Hubble Connected’s baby tracker lets you log and track your baby’s development and routines over time, from feeding and sleeping to growth and diaper changes. And when your hands are full, just update the tracker using Amazon Alexa.
- SLEEP & PARENTING TIPS
Access articles and videos with sleep and parenting tips from leading childcare organizations.
PRENATAL: The Motorola by Hubble Connected app lets Roo users discover a new way to experience the miracle of pregnancy.
- LISTEN, TRACK & SHARE BABY’S HEARTBEAT
Listen to the magical sound of your baby’s heartbeat from the comfort of your home. Save the recordings to cherish the memories forever, and share them with family and friends.
- PRENATAL TRACKER
Conveniently track important prenatal information such as your water consumption, weight, bump, and baby’s kicks, all in one place.
- VOICE ASSISTANCE
Update your prenatal tracker hands-free with Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant. “Alexa, ask Roo to record a kick.”
- EXPERT PREGNANCY ADVICE
Access prenatal tips and advice based on your pregnancy stage. Explore the range of articles and videos, sourced from leading experts.
- PREGNANCY FAQs
Find answers to the most commonly asked FAQs, from morning sickness and back pain to nutrition and exercise.
- Terms of Use

bluejetty:00158026:ios.name: Eatrack: Food & Symptom Diary
bluejetty:00158026:ios.summary: Do you often experience symptoms after eating – like stomach aches, skin rashes, bloating, or headaches – and wonder if certain foods or intolerances could be the cause? With Eatrack, you can easily track your meals, drinks, medications, sy
bluejetty:00158026:ios.description:
Do you often experience symptoms after eating – like stomach aches, skin rashes, bloating, or headaches – and wonder if certain foods or intolerances could be the cause? With Eatrack, you can easily track your meals, drinks, medications, symptoms, and digestive health. Based on your entries, you’ll get valuable insights to help you spot patterns and better understand possible triggers.
WHY USE A FOOD & SYMPTOM TRACKER?
Scientific studies show that keeping a food and symptom diary can really help if you’re dealing with IBS, IBD, MCAS, or intolerances like histamine, fructose, lactose, sorbitol and more:
• Up to 70% of people gain better control over their symptoms (American Journal of Gastroenterology).
• A food diary increases the chance of spotting patterns by 50% (Journal of Nutrition).
WHO EATRACK IS FOR:
• You experience symptoms after eating and want to understand what’s causing them
• You want a simple way to log what you (or your child) eat
• You’re sensitive to certain foods or suspect intolerances
• You struggle with digestive issues or other recurring symptoms
• You want to identify foods that don’t agree with you – and leave them off your plate
WITH EATRACK, YOU CAN:
• Log meals, ingredients, drinks, medications, symptoms, and digestive patterns with ease
• Track symptoms by type, intensity, and time of day
• Document your bowel movements using the Bristol Stool Chart – and monitor changes over time
• Add ingredients quickly using a barcode or text scanner
• Track activities like exercise and relaxation – and see how they influence your symptoms
• Record your stress levels during meals to help identify emotional triggers
• Automatically highlight potential triggers like histamine, gluten, fructose, sorbitol, lactose, or salicylates
• Mark foods high in FODMAPs if you’re sensitive
• Use clear statistics and AI-powered analysis to uncover patterns across multiple days
• Let the AI help you understand connections between food, symptoms, digestion, activities, and stress
• Customize the time window between meals and symptoms – great for tracking delayed reactions
• Export your food and symptom diary as a PDF or CSV
• Sync your data across multiple devices
WHAT MAKES EATRACK SPECIAL:
• Eatrack is for people who want to understand their symptoms – not count calories
• We care about keeping things simple and user-friendly
• We’re a small, independent team
• We actually listen, improve based on feedback, and believe in growing slowly and thoughtfully
• Eatrack helps you share your eating and symptom patterns more clearly with your doctor or nutritionist
WHAT USERS SAY ABOUT EATRACK:
“Great app – stable, easy to use, and totally intuitive.”
“Finally an app that helps me track and see patterns right away.”
“Love that I can even add my own custom foods.”
“Eatrack has become part of my daily routine. It helps me keep my symptoms and meals in check.”
“The color coding for intolerances is super helpful.”
“It even includes the Bristol Stool Chart – perfect for gut health.”
“Exporting reports for my doctor is super easy.”
“Finally, a fair pricing model with premium features that actually make sense.”
Eatrack is free to download and try.
If you like the idea behind Eatrack, we’d love your support with a positive App Store review. Have feedback or ideas? Just reach out: support@eatrack.app
Thanks for being here.
Eatrack – Better understand your body’s signals!

My Pretend Daycare & Preschool is great fun for kids that love daycare centers, preschools, and kindergarten class!
Take care of kids ranging from babies all the way to school age children in a fun, Daycare atmosphere with toys, beds, cribs, playground equipment, and more!
Help parents at the desk with kid drop-offs, and get ready for some fun!
Become a daycare worker, and manage several rooms at the Daycare Center for kids!
Play in the baby room, and feed the infants, and help them fall asleep!
Take care of kids in the classroom, and help them with activities, artwork, and other fun crafts!
Go outside, and play on the playground with kids of all ages! Bikes, climbing equipment, slides, tires, and more!
My Pretend Daycare & Preschool is great fun for kids who love pretend play games, and dollhouse games!

- Use the Subscription on any iPhone/iPad/ registered with your Apple Account
- Auto-renewal can be canceled anytime during the active subscription period

bluejetty:00093087:ios.description:

An inclusive, multiplayer investing platform where you can invest together with family & friends, as well as by yourself (personal), and for kids (custodial).
HEDGE IS A FEDERALLY-LICENSED FINANCIAL INSTITUTION. Our mission is to empower underserved families to build wealth together, and to restore upward mobility to the American Dream. We aim to grow alongside you and to earn the opportunity to support our customers for their entire lives as their primary financial institution. Our strategy is simple: as you grow, so do we.
SUMMARY
1. Multiplayer / Group Investing
2. Personal Investing
3. Hedge Kids (UTMA/UGMA Custodial)
INVEST WITH FAMILY & FRIENDS ("Make a Hedge Fund With Family / Friends")
* Invite family/friends to join a group
* Send proposals & vote on what to invest in together
* Collaborate, chat, learn, and grow together
* No joint tax liability, lockups, or red tape; no accreditation required
* You have full control and ownership over your assets at all times
* Transfer assets out of groups and into your Personal Portfolio at the click of a button
* Start investing together in seconds
PERSONAL INVESTING 
* Commission-free individual investing 
* Invest in a broad range of US Exchange-listed stocks, ETFs, etc.
* Start investing with as little as $5, with the flexibility to purchase fractional shares
* Recurring Investments
COMING SOON
* Interactive Learning Tools: Built to help onboard you into sustainable, long-term investing
* Inclusive Network of Investor Communities: Find a community of your own to learn/grow alongside

bluejetty:00171504:ios.description:
Zoe is a FREE & high-rated dating and social networking app for lesbian, bisexual, and queer womxn around the world.
The concept is easy: Swipe right to “like” them and left to “pass”. Once users “like” each other, it's a MATCH and they can start chatting right away! 
Whether you’re looking for friends or the love of your life, you are in the right place. Find truly authentic LGBTQ+ women nearby and chat now!
Finding Your Match
• Quickly create a profile and browse amazing lesbian, bi and queer women around you. 
• Set your preferred age and distance range.
• Upload profile photos and private photos to your profile from your photo album, Facebook or Instagram. 
• If you match, you can start chatting with them immediately, it's absolutely FREE.
Security & Privacy
• Photo Verification – see who was verified by our photo verification system.
• Verification Request – ask your matches to verify their pictures.
• Messaging – only users who you match with are able to massage you.
• Private Mode – be visible only to the users you liked beforehand or match with.
• Snaps – send photos and videos that disappear after a couple of seconds.
• Private Photos – upload private photos only visible to users with your permission.
Premium Membership
• We offer 1 month, 3 months, and 12 months membership options.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Subscription can be managed by the user and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
Premium Account Features:
• Private Mode – be only visible to the users you liked beforehand.
• Who Likes Me – skip swiping and see women who liked you immediately and match with them right away.
• My History– search and edit your previous dislike decision about someone.
• Power Messages – send out up to 5 Power Messages a week so that your favorite picks will see your like and message before they swipe left or right on you!
• Rewind – Accidentally swiped left? Hit the rewind button anytime to change your decision. 
• Location Change – modify your location to discover cuties from different cities.
• Have fun with stickers – use our custom Zoe stickers in chats.
Terms of Use:
• Inappropriate content and explicit photos are strictly prohibited. Such content will be removed. You must be at least 18 years old to sign up for Zoe.
• Check our terms of use for more information: https://www.zoeapp.co/terms-of-use
About Us: 
Zoe is friendly, secure, and interactive. All LGBTQ+ women aged 18+ are welcome to join the community.
Our values are based on friendliness, joy, connection, being yourself, a positive approach, and inclusivity. 
Contact Us
• 24/7 Admin Support: We are here to help and we speak your language. Message our admin and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
• Feedback: Any recommendation or comment? We value your opinion, let’s make our platform a better place together.
Follow us on Social Media: 
• Facebook @Zoegirlapp
• Instagram @zoegirlsapp
• Tiktok @zoe_app

bluejetty:00180106:ios.description:
Collections is a personal database app to organize anything.
1. A field for every use
Collections supports over 20+ field types:
• Text, Number
• Boolean
• Picture
• Select
• Email, URL, Phone
• Password
• Date, Time
• Color
• Barcode
And with the Pro version you can use even more advanced fields.
• Document reference - Link documents together
• Group - Add multiple values for a field
• Formula - Create a formula for calculated values. Powerful formula editor with full support to math functions like SUM, AVG
• Sources - Import documents from external APIs with Javascript
2. Customizable
• Add and reorder fields
• Add a separator between fields to better visualize them
• Fields have different display styles like primary, secondary, thumbnail
• Filter and sort data
3. Templates
Collections includes basic templates to get started:
• Books
• Contacts
• Expenses
• Subscriptions
• Credentials
• Inventory
• School
5. Advanced management
Collections has different tools to help you creating the data model.
SUBCOLLECTIONS
Organize data into collections and subcollections. Simply said, they are like folders.
LISTS
A list contains items used in documents and it's very flexible. It could represent a Genre for a book or a Status like 'Available', 'Out of stock' for an object in the inventory.
6. Security
• Protect collections using a password, Face ID or Touch ID
• Sensitive data such as passwords are encrypted by default
7. iCloud Sync
Data is synced automatically between devices through iCloud.
8. Apple's Shortcuts support
Expand the app capabilities with Apple's Shortcuts support.
9. Pro version features
• Add unlimited documents (free version is limited to 100 documents)
• Add files to documents
• Add advanced fields
• Views
• Grid
• Use Summary to perform calculations across documents
