bluejetty:00127629:ios.name: LDS Priesthood: Ordinances
bluejetty:00127629:ios.summary:
Perform priesthood ordinances with clarity and confidence.
LDS Priesthood: Ordinances puts the wording of every ordinance and blessing in your pocket — ready the moment you're asked to serve. Whether you're preparing for your first baptism
bluejetty:00127629:ios.description:
Perform priesthood ordinances with clarity and confidence.
LDS Priesthood: Ordinances puts the wording of every ordinance and blessing in your pocket — ready the moment you're asked to serve. Whether you're preparing for your first baptism or have served for decades, you'll have the exact words, in the right order, without having to memorize them.
Every ordinance follows the instructions in the General Handbook, so what you read is what the Church actually asks — nothing added, nothing left out.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Read the sacrament prayers for the bread and water, word for word
• Follow step-by-step guidance for baptism and confirmation
• Administer to the sick — anointing with oil and sealing the anointing
• Confer the priesthood and ordain to an office
• Name and bless children, and give blessings of comfort and counsel
• Dedicate graves and dedicate homes, and consecrate oil
LEARN THE PRIESTHOOD
• Understand the Aaronic and Melchizedek Priesthoods and the keys of each
• Explore the offices and duties — deacon, teacher, priest, elder, and high priest
• Review the purpose, restoration, and responsibilities of the priesthood
BUILT FOR THE MOMENT YOU SERVE
• Guided mode walks you through one step at a time and reads each step aloud
• Focus mode shows large, distraction-free text and keeps the screen awake
• Instant search across every ordinance, prayer, office, and topic
• Save your most-used ordinances for one-tap access
• Adjustable text size, themes, and app icons
KEEP A RECORD OF WHAT YOU FELT
• After you serve, write a private impression — what you felt, and for whom
• Each entry is pre-filled with the ordinance and date, so it takes only seconds
• Tag the feeling in a tap — peaceful, grateful, humbled, close to God
• Your journal stays private to you, kept on your device and synced securely
• Search and revisit past impressions any time
FOR MEMBERS WORLDWIDE
Read every ordinance in your own language. Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, Thai, Khmer, Indonesian, Malay, Tagalog, Cebuano, Samoan, Tongan, Igbo, and Yoruba — with more on the way.
LDS Priesthood is designed to help priesthood holders serve with greater knowledge, confidence, and faith.
Guided mode, focus mode, read-aloud, all languages, an unlimited journal, custom themes, and an ad-free experience are available with LDS Priesthood Pro.
This app is an independent study and reference aid. It is not an official app of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints.

bluejetty:00128086:ios.summary:
Ricalko lets you create incredible artwork, see how your drawings take shape, like magic! It is great for beginners who want to learn drawing and it is perfect for advanced users who want to improve even more!
Ricalko has many smart featur
bluejetty:00128086:ios.description:
Ricalko lets you create incredible artwork, see how your drawings take shape, like magic! It is great for beginners who want to learn drawing and it is perfect for advanced users who want to improve even more!
Ricalko has many smart features that let you achieve the results your aiming to, but in few words it is able to virtually project photos, so you can trace them on a paper sheet, an easel or on any other surface! You don't have to be a professional artist to reach amazing results. 
How is it able to do that? In normal mode you have to put your device onto a stand (DIY works too, like a simple glass), with the camera pointing to a sheet of paper below for example. On your screen an overlay will be shown and you will be able to see both the photo and your hand below so you can trace it! See below for more details...
CRAFT REALISTIC ARTWORK FROM ANY PHOTO
You can choose any photo and then create art from it.
Pencil and paper? Brush and watercolours?
You choose!
LEARN TO DRAW AND SEPARATE LAYERS
Split photos to different layers, in colors or grayscale, see them one by one individually and trace them on your art to create the final result. 
Perfect for learning!
CREATIVE FILTERS
Turn your photo into a drawing, a comic or apply a posterisation, Ricalko filters are great for creativity.
PERSPECTIVE MODE
You don't have to keep your device perpendicularly if you don't have a stand, you can also keep it angled, perspective mode will remove any distortion and you will be able to create your artworks without any particular effort. You just have to set it with the guidelines helper image!
AR MODE
Don't like keeping your device still?
You don't have to with the augmented reality. You can select a marker, the app will recognise it and place your photo virtually next to it, so you can trace it!
USE ANY CAMERA
You can use any camera on your device, wide angle, zoom lens, ultra wide angle or even the front camera, this one with the perspective mode and a reflector (to be purchased in online stores, such as OSMO and not included).
ZOOM TO BE PRECISE
After you have setup your environment you can zoom on the area where you are drawing to see even more clearly, with natural gestures like pinch to zoom or by moving your device closer in AR Mode.
PREMIUM CUSTOMER SUPPORT
Need help? Have a suggestion? See it included in future releases and drop an email to support@genovasoftworks.com
REQUIREMENTS
Ricalko does not have any particular requirement since supports iOS 14+ devices only. If you can download it, it will work on your device.
A printer is suggested in order to print markers for AR Mode and the guidelines image for Perspective mode, even if they could also be displayed on an additional supporting device.
A subscription is required.
Terms and Privacy Policy can be found at https://www.genovasoftworks.com/terms.php.
For any question or help drop an email to support@genovasoftworks.com.

bluejetty:00140786:ios.description:
Bus Traffic: Car Puzzle - The Craziest Gridlock Puzzle You’ll Ever Play!
Are you ready to become the ultimate traffic master? In Bus Traffic game, your brain meets gridlock, and only your wits can save the day. 
What’s the deal?
Picture this: a street filled with honking buses, impatient drivers, and vehicles that seem to have no idea where they’re going. It’s your job to untangle this mess and guide the buses out of gridlock safely. Easy, right? Ha! Think again. Every level is a puzzle-packed adventure that will make you scratch your head, laugh at your mistakes, and cheer when you finally escape that last bus.
Why you’ll love Bus Traffic:
* Endless Traffic Mayhem: The levels packed with colorful buses, wild drivers, and unpredictable jams. Each level gets crazier than the last!
* Brain-Boosting Fun: Flex your problem-solving muscles while trying not to lose your cool.
* Go Global: Navigate jams inspired by cities worldwide. Every level brings a fresh challenge.
* Compete with Friends: Think you’re the best at traffic escape? Challenge your friends and prove you’re the true King (or Queen) of the Road!
* Relax and Laugh: Sure, the puzzles are tricky, but the fun animations, quirky sound effects, and satisfying wins will keep you smiling.
Why Bus Traffic?
Because life’s too short to take traffic seriously. Whether you’re a puzzle-solving pro or just looking for a game to make you happy, Bus Traffic is your ticket to a good time. 
So buckle up, hit the road, and let the madness begin!
Let's become the master of Bus Traffic: Car Puzzle Now!!!

bluejetty:00065902:ios.description:
Hey, psssst! You there...come over here, listen!
You are THE CHEF we’ve been looking for !
Have you ever dreamed of cooking delicious dishes from all over the world and discovering exotic cultures? You can achieve those dreams in Cooking Madness! Come and try one of the most addictive FREE time-management cooking games of 2026!
EXPLORE amazing restaurants and exotic foods along your worldwide journey 
- Favored by millions of global players, Cooking Madness proudly features more than 80 high-quality theme restaurants, 3000+ riveting levels to conquer and hundreds of ingredients to cook with!
- From the spicy flavors of Mexico to the culinary sophistication of Paris, from hearty burgers to delicate sushi, surprises await you in every exciting area of the map to be unlocked! Fill your chef's collection handbook by perfecting hundreds of delicious recipes from all over the world!
PRACTICE your cooking techniques and time-management - a real Mad Chef makes uses of fingers AND brain!
- Hungry diners are ravenous for tasty dishes! A few taps on the screen, and voila! You are preparing, cooking and serving scrumptious meals just like a professional chef!
- But wait, speed isn't everything, strategy is key! Can you prepare the right ingredients, juggle multiple dishes, and serve each customer just in time to collect the biggest bonus? Test your time-management skills and concoct the perfect strategy for each challenging level!
UPGRADE your culinary arsenal and earn achievement rewards to reach the zenith of the cooking world
- To create the most exquisite dishes, you'll need the finest ingredients and top-tier equipment. Earn coins from levels and reinvest them into upgrading every facet of your kitchen!
- With the achievement handbook in the game, you not only can view the milestones you have reached on the path of becoming a master chef, but also claim some well-deserved rewards! Use these to further boost your progress and never stop!
ENJOY some juicy in-game content and unparalleled gameplay
- Immerse yourself in festive atmospheres with limited-time restaurants. From Halloween to Mother's Day, St. Patrick's Day to Dragon Boat Festival, savor the magic of a cultural adventure!
- With regular updates featuring new restaurants and content, our chefs are always kept on their toes!
- Fumbled on a level and low on energy? Fear not! Join a team, call up friends on Facebook and send energy to each other. Share your newest culinary triumphs and succumb to the cooking fever together!
- Open your restaurants anytime, anywhere, with or without an internet connection. Unleash the joy of cooking, no strings attached!
This is THE cooking game you have been searching for! Don’t wait any longer, don your apron and immerse yourself in a real cooking craze!
Stay tuned with our social media for the latest news & giveaways, and find your friends and teammates in our friendly players' community via:
>>> Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/cookingmadness.chef 
>>> Official Fan Group: https://bit.ly/cookingmadnessofficialgroup
>>> Email: game.support@zentertain.net

bluejetty:00186292:ios.name: Private Pilot Test Prep
bluejetty:00186292:ios.summary: Sporty's Study Buddy prepares you for the FAA Private Pilot knowledge test (the "written") with three ways to study: Study Questions, Flashcards and Practice Tests. Questions are organized by knowledge area, with explanations of the right a
bluejetty:00186292:ios.description:
Sporty's Study Buddy prepares you for the FAA Private Pilot knowledge test (the "written") with three ways to study: Study Questions, Flashcards and Practice Tests. Questions are organized by knowledge area, with explanations of the right and wrong answers developed by Sporty's team of Master CFIs, based on their experience preparing students for the Private Pilot certificate.
• STUDY QUESTIONS BY TOPIC •
Choose whole knowledge areas or individual topics to build your own study session. As soon as you answer, you'll see the correct answer, why it's right, and where to read more. Change your answer anytime, bookmark questions as you go, and jump to any question from the question list. Every study session is shuffled.
• REVIEW WITH FLASHCARDS •
Flashcards show just the question, so you answer from memory before revealing the correct answer and its explanation. Mark each card Know It or Still Learning, then start a new session from the cards you're still learning. On iPhone Duo, study a card with the phone open and close it to check the answer.
• TAKE PRACTICE TESTS •
Each Practice Test draws 60 questions at random from the full question bank, gives you 2 hours, and is graded at the FAA's 70% passing score. Afterward, see your score by topic, review every question or only the ones you missed, and turn your misses into a new study session.
• PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF •
Sessions save as you go. The History tab lets you resume any session in progress and review past results, including your scores by topic.
• EVERY FIGURE, OFFLINE •
The Figures tab includes the complete FAA Airman Knowledge Testing Supplement, with every figure and legend listed by name and page. Swipe through the pages or open any one full screen. Questions show their figures right alongside, and you can study without a connection.
Designed for iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad, with Dark Mode and support for larger text sizes.
The FAA does not publish its knowledge test questions, so the questions on your test won't necessarily appear in this app. Study Buddy is meant to complement your training, not to replace flight and ground instruction.

bluejetty:00120686:ios.description:
Stuck on a scrambled Rubik's Cube? Point your camera at it and the solver shows you the exact solution, move by move. Then learn to solve it yourself with step-by-step 3D lessons.
This app turns the world's most iconic puzzle into something you can master in a single afternoon. No memorizing 50-page PDFs. No pausing and rewinding YouTube videos. Just clear, interactive 3D lessons that walk you through every move.
FROM YOUR FIRST SOLVE TO YOUR FASTEST
Pick up the cube for the first time and solve it today. Already solving? Sharpen your technique and crush your personal best.
WHAT'S INSIDE
• Camera Scanner. Point your camera at the cube and the solver reads the colors automatically. No more tapping in 54 stickers by hand.
• Instant Auto-Solver. Scan your cube or paint its colors on screen and get the exact solution, move by move, in seconds.
• Step-by-Step 3D Tutorials. 7 stages from "what's a Rubik's Cube?" to a full solve, every move animated in 3D. Zero guesswork.
• 3D Practice Mode. Spin a virtual cube with auto-scrambles and build real muscle memory without wearing out your physical cube.
• Speedcubing Timer. Official scrambles, full solve history, and Personal Best tracking. See yourself get faster.
• 2x2 Pocket Cube. Its own optimal solver, camera scan, and 3D practice mode.
• 15+ Cube Patterns. Checkerboard, Superflip, Tetris, and more. Learn to create show-stopping designs.
• Notation Guide. F, B, U, D, R, L finally make sense, with animated demos for every move and combo.
STAY MOTIVATED
• Meet Cubey, your animated coach who celebrates every milestone
• Level up, earn badges, and complete daily challenges
• Build a solving streak and watch your stats climb
• Share beautiful achievement cards with friends
WORKS EVERYWHERE
• 36 languages with full RTL support
• No account required
Stop staring at a scrambled cube. Start solving it.
Download now. Your first solve is closer than you think.

bluejetty:00146865:ios.description:
Explore cities through local eyes with FREETOUR.com
FREETOUR.com is a global travel app for discovering and booking free walking tours, budget tours and authentic local experiences with passionate local guides. Find things to do in Europe and Worldwide, compare trusted tour providers, and book city tours in 140+ countries.
Looking for free tours in Barcelona, Budapest, Rome, Venice, Vienna or Naples? Planning a city break, a backpacking trip, a weekend getaway or a longer vacation? Use FREETOUR.com as your walking tour app, city guide app and tour booking app to explore famous landmarks, hidden gems, local neighborhoods and real culture.
Why use FREETOUR.com?
• Free walking tours with local guides who know their city
• Budget guided tours, sightseeing tours and local experiences
• Day trips, night tours, pub crawls, bike tours, themed tours and excursions
• Tours available in multiple languages
• Ratings and reviews from travelers who have already joined
• Easy booking with instant confirmation
• Clear tour details: route, duration, language, meeting point and guide information
• No booking fees or hidden charges
• Free to download and free to use
How free tours work
Free tours are tip-based walking tours. You book your place for free, join a local guide, enjoy the experience, and decide what it was worth at the end. It is one of the easiest ways to understand a city's history, culture, stories and everyday life without paying high prices upfront.
Find tours for every travel style
Discover walking tours in historic city centers, food and culture tours, night walks, local neighborhood routes, day trips and unique activities. Whether you want a classic sightseeing tour in Rome, a local walking tour in Barcelona, a cultural route in Budapest, a romantic walk in Venice, an imperial history tour in Vienna or food trips through Naples, FREETOUR.com helps you find the right experience.
Travel smarter in Europe and Worldwide
Since 2014, FREETOUR.com has helped travelers connect with local guides and tour providers around the world. From Europe's most visited cities to emerging destinations across 140+ countries, our mission is to make meaningful travel easier, more accessible and more local.
Download the FREETOUR.com app to search, compare and book free tours, walking tours, guided tours, budget tours and local experiences worldwide.

bluejetty:00017550:ios.description:
Welcome to Ahli Mobile by Jordan Ahli Bank – your all-in-one app for seamless financial and loans payments management. Take control of your banking experience with our feature-rich mobile banking app designed to make your life easier.
With Ahli Mobile,, you have the power and the banking flexibility to manage your accounts, loans, finances, and transactions with unparalleled convenience. Here's what you can do with Ahli Mobile:
• Manage Your Accounts:
 - Open digital accounts from anywhere.
 - Access real-time balance information.
 - Obtaining the International Bank Account Number (IBAN) and customer number.
 - View detailed transaction history.
 - Download account statements.
 - Search for transactions.
 - Open subaccounts (current and saving) in multiple currencies.
 - Link/unlink accounts to your debit card.
• Cards Management:
 - Activate/deactivate your cards.
 - Pay dues credit card.
 - View credit card limits, used and available balances, card transactions and payment date along with accumulated Reward (Reward Points).
 - Modify your credit card limits such as: online purchase limit, ATM withdrawal limit, or point-of-sale purchase limit.
 - Show your credit card PIN and reset your debit card PIN.
 - Update card usage preferences instantly.
 - Reload your E-com card without visiting the branch.
 - Report lost or stolen cards.
 - Apply for Credit cards & Online Shopping Cards.
 - Accumulated Points balance on your credit card.
 - 0% Installments.
• Loans Management:
 - View loan details, including principal amount, outstanding balance, total, number of installments, and remaining balance.
 - Check Interest rate and due date.
 - Defer loan installments directly from the app.
 - Apply for different types of loans through the app.
• Transfer Funds:
 - Transfers of up to JOD 10,000 daily between your various accounts.
 - Transfer money between ahli customers via their account numbers.
 - Local and international transfers up to 10,000 JOD per day.
 - Update your daily transfer limits through the app without the need to visit any of our branches.
 - Use the CliQ service for instant local transfers and payments using the QR reader at merchant points of sale.
 - Use money voucher service for non-banking customers.
• Check Services:
 - Request a checkbook.
 - Check the status of your checkbook request.
 - Stop or revoke stopped checks without visiting the branch.
 - View check service.
• Term Deposits Services:
 - View the accrued amount of interest.
 - Open a deposit account directly from the app in multiple currencies.
 - Access detailed deposit account transaction statements for various time periods.
• Distinctive Features:
 - Enjoy exclusive features like card-less ATM access.
 - Withdraw and deposit money through our ATM network using QR service in the app.
 - Self-registration using your debit card.
 - Pay all your bills.
 - Save your prepaid bills for future payments.
 - Activate your Sanad account without visiting any Sanad locations.
 - Get your CRIF report directly through the app.
 - Set alerts for your accounts and reminders for payments due.
Experience hassle-free banking on the go with Ahli Mobile. Download now and take control of your finances!

bluejetty:00137291:ios.description:
FirstCry PlayBees makes early learning joyful through fun, expert-designed learning games for kids that grow with your child’s age and abilities. Loved by parents and trusted for high-quality content, the app is often recommended among the top educational games for kids. With interactive activities that encourage thinking, creativity, and problem-solving, PlayBees helps children build confidence and essential skills through meaningful, everyday play.
Why FirstCry PlayBees Is the Right Choice for Parents & Kids
•Designed as one of the most trusted learning apps for kids, with age-appropriate content parents can rely on.
•Includes thoughtfully crafted pre k preschool learning games that build strong early foundations through play.
•Features fun learning games for kindergarten and engaging toddler learning games to support growing skills.
•Covers essentials like 123 & alphabet games, catchy nursery rhymes, and interactive math games for balanced learning.
Alphabet Learning & ABC Tracing
Designed for early learners, this section introduces letters through playful abc learning games for kids and cheerful abc songs. Toddlers practice their ABCs through tracing letter games with guided strokes, while word-based activities inspired by endless alphabet help build letter recognition.
Learn 123 Numbers
Kids begin their number journey with fun activities that combine learning numbers in simple, engaging ways. With interactive 123 games, this learning app for kids helps children recognize numbers, and understand basic number order.
Coloring & Painting Games
Bright, easy-to-use coloring games for toddlers let kids explore colors, shapes, and creativity freely. These activities support fine motor skills while giving young children a calm way to express themselves.
Nursery Rhymes
Classic favorites come alive with music, visuals, and actions through nursery rhymes. Singing along helps kids improve language skills, memory, & rhythm while keeping learning light and fun.
Stories & Read Aloud Books
Interactive stories guided by a friendly storyteller help children fall in love with reading. These kids stories support listening skills, imagination through engaging visuals and simple narration.
Learn Shapes & Colors
Children explore early logic with matching games for toddlers that focus on shapes, colors, and patterns. Combined with simple memory games and interactive toddler thinking games, this category builds observation and problem-solving skills naturally.
Cooking Games
Safe and playful preschooler cooking games introduce kids to everyday foods, kitchen tools, and simple steps. These games encourage creativity, sequencing, and pretend play without any real-world mess.
Kids Puzzles
Easy-to-solve puzzle games for toddlers help improve focus, patience, and hand-eye coordination. With age-appropriate levels, children enjoy the challenge while gaining confidence step by step.
Learn Maths
Numbers feel fun with kids math games designed for growing minds. From preschool addition to kindergarten math games, and practice suited for 1st, 2nd, 3rd graders, concepts are introduced gradually and clearly.
Word & Spelling Games
Interactive english word & spelling games help children recognize words, sounds, and letter patterns. These activities strengthen vocabulary and phonics skills in a playful, pressure-free way.
Musical & Piano Games
Musical games & play supports creativity, listening skills, and early coordination while keeping children happily engaged. Kids explore rhythm & sound through easy-to-play piano games made just for little hands.
FirstCry PlayBees is a fun educational app for kids designed to make learning joyful and meaningful. With safe, expert-designed activities & games for 1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8 year olds, it supports early skills through play. Download the app and give your child a space to learn, explore, & grow. 
Email: playbees@firstcry.com 
Privacy policy: https://playbees.firstcry.com/privacy

bluejetty:00073247:ios.name: Farlight 84
bluejetty:00073247:ios.summary:
Hey, Lightcatchers! Welcome to Farlight 84! Are you ready for fast-paced hero shooter action with massive 60-player shootouts?
Team up with two squadmates and parkour your way through towering cityscapes as you hunt down your enemies. Play
bluejetty:00073247:ios.description:
Hey, Lightcatchers! Welcome to Farlight 84! Are you ready for fast-paced hero shooter action with massive 60-player shootouts?
Team up with two squadmates and parkour your way through towering cityscapes as you hunt down your enemies. Play as uniquely skilled heroes, tame your Buddy pets, and unlock hundreds of tactical combos to outsmart your opponents. With unlimited respawns, you're free to charge into the fray, break armor, and go all-out without fear! If you've got the guts, you've got the power to forge your own path to victory!
Season 4 of Farlight 84 begins April 23!
[Fast-Paced Action in an Urban Jungle]
Prepare to drop into a 60-player battlefield that pushes every limit!
From open fields to vertical cities, team up and let the bullets fly! Run, climb, and fight your way to victory!
Loot gear in tight alleyways, wall-run and slide between rooftops, zipline across bridges to reach the high ground, or launch across the map in a giant Rat Cannon. With layered, dynamic map design, every battle delivers endless exciting moments.
[Get Straight Into the Action With One-Tap Looting]
Don't struggle with cumbersome controls. Become a master looter in an instant!
When the battlefield turns hot, reaction speed is crucial. Enemy got the drop on you while you were trying to tweak your loadout? Not in Farlight 84! With the touch of a button, you can equip the best weapons and mods for an instant upgrade! Whether it's shotgun chokes or long-distance sniper scopes, everything gets equipped automatically, so you can focus on what counts—take aim, fire, and win!
[No Penalty for Newbies—Respawn and Hit Back Harder]
Knocked out? Nope, you're just getting started!
It's not just about pulling the trigger—you'll need to think on your feet and adapt on the fly. But if you make a mistake, your squad's got your six. Even if you go down, you'll be back in action in seconds and ready to strike back! No need to sit on the sidelines or shrink away from the fight—Even new players can become relentless battle machines!
[Countless Combinations of Hero and Pet Skills]
Each hero brings something different. So get ready to upgrade and expand your tactical playbook!
Choose your moment, unleash your skills, and nail that kill! And don't forget your Buddies—these tactical pets show up randomly, and they're game-changers! They can summon storms, shift zones, disguise the terrain, steal items while invisible... They're unpredictable, powerful, and always bring surprises to the fight!
Try combining your weapons, heroes, and Buddies in different ways, and you'll discover dozens of new ways to win!
There's no one way to win. Every shot opens up new possibilities!
Enjoy fast-paced hero battle royale in Farlight 84!
New season starts April 23!
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00027579:ios.summary:
Welcome to the narrated driving tour of California’s famous Pacific Coast Highway!

bluejetty:00027579:ios.description:
Welcome to the narrated driving tour of California’s famous Pacific Coast Highway!
This gorgeous highway winds along California’s coast and features some of the most jaw-dropping sights and picturesque towns you’ve ever seen. This flexible tour takes you south from San Francisco to Los Angeles or north from Los Angeles to San Francisco in four scenic segments:
San Francisco to Monterey:
Cruise down the most beautiful roadway in the world while getting a taste of the west coast way of life. Discover stunning ocean vistas, learn the fascinating history behind towns like Santa Cruz, and find your literary muse in the artsy haven of Monterey.
The 17-Mile Drive:
Roll your windows down and ride along the Monterey Peninsula, taking in unbroken views of the untouched coastline. See can’t-miss landmarks like the Lone Cypress and walk along the shores of the gorgeous Pebble Beach.
Big Sur (Monterey to San Luis Obispo):
Imagine hitting the open road. Rolling the windows down, listening to crashing waves as an ocean breeze tousles your hair, and just... driving. Stopping to visit a little coastal village, sampling the freshest seafood you've ever tasted, and watching the sun set over the deep blue Pacific. It’s not just the stuff of daydreams, it’s a real place called Big Sur!
San Luis Obispo to Los Angeles:
Experience the laid-back pace of “SloCal” life in San Luis Obispo, get acquainted with Santa Barbara’s rich history, and soak up some sun and surf at the world-famous Malibu beaches. This is the quintessential California experience in a single drive.
Popular points of interest along Highway 1 or Pacific Coast Highway (PCH):
■ Pedro Point
■ Gray Whale Cove & Mavericks Beach
■ Half Moon Bay
■ Pigeon Point Lighthouse
■ Butano & Año Nuevo State Park
■ Santa Cruz Boardwalk & Mystery Spot
■ Monterey & 17 Mile Drive
■ Carmel-by-the-Sea
■ Bixby Creek Bridge
■ Pfeiffer Beach & Canyon Bridge
■ Seal Beach Scenic Overlook
■ Big Creek Bridge
■ Piedras Blancas Light Station
■ Elephant Seal Vista Point
■ Hearst Castle
■ Morro Bay
■ Bubblegum Alley
■ Pismo Beach
■ Guadalupe
■ El Camino Real
■ Goleta’s Butterfly Grove
■ Thousand Steps Beach & Stearns Wharf
■ Ventura
■ Malibu
■ LA: Santa Monica
HOW IT WORKS:
As you travel, audio stories play automatically based on your location. Simply go to the starting point of the tour and begin following the given route. Each story begins playing on its own, usually just before you reach a point of interest.
TOUR FEATURES:
▶ Freedom of travel
No scheduled tour times, no crowded buses, and no rush to keep moving past stops that interest you. You have total freedom to skip ahead, linger, and take as many photos as you’d like.
▶ Automatic play
No muss, no fuss. Just follow the app’s built-in route to all the must-visit spots — the audio stories about everything you see will play automatically!
▶ Works offline
Download the tour in advance and then use it seamlessly, even in areas with no service!
▶ Lifetime purchase
No monthly subscription. No time limits. No usage limits. Enjoy this tour as many times as you like.
▶ Incredible stories
Immerse yourself in the history, culture, and secrets of this famous site with the help of a top-tier narrator and fascinating stories written by experts.
▶ Award-winning app
Featured on Thrillist and WBZ, this easy-to-use app won the Laurel Award for Technology from the Newport Mansions, who use the app for over a million tours per year.
FREE DEMO vs FULL ACCESS:
Check out the totally free demo to get an idea of what this tour is all about. If you like it, purchase the tour to get full access to all of the stories.
IMPORTANT NOTES:
Download the tour ahead of time over data or WiFi for full offline use.
Be sure your phone battery is fully charged or take an external battery pack. Continued use of the GPS can drain your battery.
Allow the tour to access location services and GPS tracking features to play stories automatically during the tour.

ABOUT PAZU
Pazu is a mobile games company that creates and publish beautiful digital games especially designed for kids.
GIRLS HAIR SALON - GLOW
Girls Hair Salon is a fun and interactive game from developers PAZU Games. Now you can own your own hair salon where you can color, cut, and dress your very own animated characters! Become the fashion glow stylist you’ve always wanted to be and makeover your character as you wish. Girls Hair Salon is a hair game full of interactive features and innovative tools to help you become the neon costume stylist you’ve always dreamed of and turn your characters into glow star! Here’s how!
Make your character glow! 
Girls Hair Salon lets you choose 1 girl from a selection of 6, Once you’ve chosen the perfect character to turn into a neon girl, you can then go and choose from a virtually endless amount of styling tools. Use makeup, clothing, hair dye and more, this makeover game lets you do everything you’ve ever wanted with just a click of a button. 
Color, Paint, and Clothe!
Each character in the selection is in desperate need of your help! Help them out by clothing them, coloring their hair, changing their form, and by giving them a complete makeover into a beautiful glow star! This beauty game gives you an endless assortment of tools to choose from without any need to slow down! Not to mention the fact that the app supplies you with hours upon hours of fun. You can make your character turn into a glow world with this incredibly fun app!
You will be amazed at the selection of tools available to change everything about your character to make the neon girl you want. Makeover, style and clothe in a fun-filled game that lets you make glow star! Kids will absolutely love this game! Start playing this entertaining, exciting, and addicting game today and become a costume stylist! 
Features :
* 6 different characters
* Dozens of different appliances make for countless glow stars!
* Colorful and unique artwork
* Easy and fluid interface that is designed especially for kids
* No Ads
*Parental Controls

Pazu is a mobile games company that creates and publish beautiful digital games especially designed for kids,
We focus on great art and sound, friendly user interface and most important, fun and entertaining gameplay.

bluejetty:00067727:ios.description:
Zen Flip Clock
A minimalist flip clock, desk clock, and focus timer designed to make time clear, simple, and easy to follow.
Choose from multiple clock themes, including flip clock, digital clock, and minimalist styles. Use it as a fullscreen clock for studying, working, focusing, or as a clean nightstand clock. Open the app and start right away.
Why Zen Flip Clock
More than just a clock, Zen Flip Clock is a simple tool for focus and time management. From study sessions and focused work to everyday timing, it helps you stay aware of your time and make every minute count.
Key Features
Multiple Clock Themes
Choose from flip clock, digital clock, and minimalist clock designs. Use your favorite theme as a desk clock, fullscreen clock, or nightstand clock for work, study, and everyday use.
Pomodoro Timer
Stay focused with the built-in Pomodoro timer. Perfect for studying, reading, working, and other tasks that require concentration.
Count Up Timer
Track elapsed time for studying, workouts, meditation, reading, and everyday activities.
Hourly Chime
Stay aware of time with hourly chimes and customizable reminders. Build better routines for work, study, and daily life.
Focus Statistics
Track your focus time and usage to better understand how you spend your time.
Personalization
Multiple Themes
Switch between a variety of minimalist clock themes, from classic flip clock designs to clean digital styles.
Smooth Animations
Enjoy clean, natural, and fluid clock animations designed for a calm visual experience.
Home & Lock Screen Widgets
View the time at a glance with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets without opening the app.
Easy Controls
Swipe left for Pomodoro
Swipe right for Count Up Timer
Tap to open Settings
Whether you need a flip clock for your desk, a fullscreen digital clock for studying, a Pomodoro timer for focused work, or a simple nightstand clock, Zen Flip Clock keeps time clear and focus simple.
Make time visible. Stay focused.

bluejetty:00167180:ios.summary:

Features:
Inte
bluejetty:00167180:ios.description:
Introduce your child to the wonders of the Spanish alphabet with El abecedario: Alfabeto Mágico. This engaging app is designed to make learning the Spanish letters an enjoyable and interactive experience for young learners.
Features:
Interactive Learning: Each letter of the Spanish alphabet is brought to life through interactive animations and activities, designed to captivate and educate.
Colorful Graphics: The app features vibrant and eye-catching visuals that make the learning process both fun and effective.
Educational Games: A variety of games are included to reinforce letter recognition and writing skills, providing an entertaining way to learn.
Progress Tracking: Tools for parents and teachers to easily monitor and track the child’s learning progress and achievements.
Designed for Beginners: Perfect for young children who are just starting to learn the Spanish alphabet.
With El abecedario: Alfabeto Mágico, learning Spanish is an exciting adventure. Download the app today and help your child discover the joy of learning through engaging and magical activities.
App subscription:
You can subscribe for access to the full list of 'ABC Alphabet: Learn to Write!'. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. You will be able to do all exercises for the duration of the subscription. Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original "one month" package unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting though your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the
subscription period to avoid being charged. 
Please visit: http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098 for more information.
You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your iTunes Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period.
Any unused portion of free-trial period, will be forfeited when the user purchases an app subscription.
Links to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy can be found below.
Privacy Policy: http://kida.app/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://kida.app/terms-and-conditions.html
* Prices are equal to the value that "Apple's App Store Pricing Matrix" determines as the equivalent of the subscription price in $ USD

bluejetty:00044414:ios.name: MOBE Health Guide
bluejetty:00044414:ios.summary: Approach your health from a whole-person perspective–where you focus on one or many areas of well-being that help you work toward one goal: living your healthiest life. MOBE provides personalized one-to-one guidance from experienced profess
bluejetty:00044414:ios.description:
Approach your health from a whole-person perspective–where you focus on one or many areas of well-being that help you work toward one goal: living your healthiest life. MOBE provides personalized one-to-one guidance from experienced professionals (including registered nurses, dietitians, health coaches, chiropractors, and clinical pharmacists), making sure you are supported on your journey toward better health. Together, you’ll create a vision and plan to build habits that help you manage your well-being, lifestyle, and medications.
**********************************
FEATURES
Get paired with a MOBE Guide and Pharmacist to work on specific areas of health.
Schedule appointments and send direct messages to your MOBE Guide and Pharmacist.
Track areas of health like nutrition, movement, stress, hydration, and more–all in one spot.
Stay in sync by connecting health data from other devices.
Access visit summaries after meeting with your MOBE Pharmacist.
Explore and save educational content on nutrition, movement, sleep, mental health, and more.
Get inspired in the kitchen with new, unique recipes.
**********************************
“I have this private connection with somebody who listens to me. If I have concerns, I get this information and feedback. It’s helping me—changing me as a person.” —Sarah K.
“MOBE can help you make improvements, increase your quality of life. It really helped me get my life in check. I feel less out of breath and less exhausted, and I can focus better.” —Thanh B.
**********************************
ABOUT MOBE
MOBE is a health outcomes company based in Minneapolis, Minnesota. We specialize in using health care data to inform our one-to-one health coaching model. MOBE works with health plans and employers nationwide. This app, and access to a MOBE Guide and Pharmacist, requires eligibility for MOBE or a valid subscription.

bluejetty:00095432:ios.description:
Lotería Digital is your all-in-one companion for playing Mexican Lotería with family and friends.
CALL THE CARDS
Start a game and let the app shuffle and call every card automatically—without repeats. Adjust the speed, pause whenever you need, review recently called cards, or call them yourself.
CAST TO YOUR TV
Keep your iPhone as the controller while the current card and game history appear on a compatible TV with Google Cast. Everyone gets a clear view from across the room.
PLAY YOUR WAY
• Choose from fun caller voices
• Record and use your own voice
• Switch between Spanish and English interface text
• Play with the Traditional deck or themed decks
• Use Mi Tabla to build, randomize, and mark your own board
• Settle ties with a quick deciding card
PRINTABLE LOTERÍA
Browse digital packs with boards and cards ready to download, share, or print for your next party, classroom, family gathering, or carne asada.
PREMIUM
Remove ads, enjoy Premium features, and share a 7-day Premium invitation with a new friend.
Whether you are the caller or playing along on your iPhone, Lotería Digital keeps the game moving so everyone can focus on the fun. Gather your people, get your markers ready, and shout “¡Lotería!”

bluejetty:00061582:ios.description:
AI psychic guidance, any time you need it
Ask a question and get a thoughtful reading in seconds. Psychic Reading Chat is a private space to think through love, career and life decisions with AI psychic readers trained on the knowledge, techniques and reading styles of professional psychics.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Chat with an AI psychic reader 24/7, with no appointments and no waiting
- Choose a reader by speciality: love and relationships, career and life purpose, tarot, past lives and karma, dream meaning, spiritual guidance
- Ask about whatever is on your mind, from a relationship that feels uncertain to a decision at work or a dream you keep thinking about
- Read your horoscope for today and tomorrow, plus weekly and monthly outlooks for your zodiac sign
- Keep every conversation and return to a reading whenever you want
- Browse reader profiles with ratings, review counts and a description of how each one works before you start
HOW IT WORKS
Pick a reader whose speciality matches your question, then type the question in your own words. The reply comes back in seconds, written in that reader's voice. Your conversations stay private to your account.
COINS
Messages and unlocking your daily horoscope use coins. Coin packs are available as one-time in-app purchases, and new users get free messages to try the app first.
PLEASE NOTE
Readings in this app are generated by AI. They are meant for reflection, entertainment and personal insight, and are not a substitute for professional medical, legal, financial or psychological advice.
Questions or feedback? You can reach us from Settings inside the app.

QUIZIT is a trivia game divided into several categories to challenge your knowledge!
How to play:
• Start a new game 
• Select your favorite category 
• Answer the 10 questions in the shortest time 
• The more correct answers in a row, the more points you get!
Users feedback:
* "Highly recommend! This a top quality app, has good range of general knowledge Q’s."
* "Good way of learning. Quickfire questions are brilliant so bring it on!"
* "Great! Great trivia game, just what I was looking for!"
* "Excellent! Very simple and a great time killer. Well done!"
You can choose from the following categories:
• Geography (Countries, capitals, flags...)
• Entertainment (Movies, music, artists...)
• History
• Art and Literature (Books, paintings...)
• Science and Nature
• Sport and Leisure (Football, gastronomy, board games...)
Want more than one category? No problem! You can choose the random mode so your game has a bit of everything ;)
MULTIPLAYER:
Play against your friends or random opponents and show you are the best!
STATISTICS:
Quizit shows a set of statistics for you to stay on track of your performance in the game and always try to improve your maximum!
FRIENDS:
You can also compete against your friends (Login with Facebook) or other players via the online leaderboards, so you can show what you got!
NO TIMER MODE:
Play with no time limit to relax and share knowledge with family and friends.
TIMED MODE:
In this game mode you have limited time to answer each question. Your challenge is to be the fastest.
You're still not convinced?
- A pop quiz game to have fun and learn with the whole family. Not to be missed.
- An addictive and fun quizup with questions updated to play at any time.
- More than 20,000 questions to test your knowledge and general culture.
- This trivia game is available in 6 languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese.
- The ideal hobby to show how much you still have to learn.
- A game of questions and answers for lovers of trivia crack and pursuit.

bluejetty:00175010:ios.name: OpenADSB
bluejetty:00175010:ios.summary: If you enjoy tracking aircraft using dump1090, tar1090 or Virtual Radar Server, then you'll enjoy OpenADSB. OpenADSB is a full featured high performance flight tracker display app that connects to a variety of backend air traffic sources. E
bluejetty:00175010:ios.description:
If you enjoy tracking aircraft using dump1090, tar1090 or Virtual Radar Server, then you'll enjoy OpenADSB. OpenADSB is a full featured high performance flight tracker display app that connects to a variety of backend air traffic sources. Enjoy OpenADSB's smooth native iOS experience instead of using the web interface.
PLEASE READ BEFORE PURCHASING:
You purchasing a general purpose air traffic display app that connects to a variety of servers types. New traffic sources can be added under Settings (gear button) - Track Source. As a convenience, OpenADSB comes preconfigured to use ADS-B Exchange. Air traffic from ADS-B Exchange is the sole responsibility of ADSBexchange.com, LLC. Frequent users are encouraged to support ADS-B Exchange through donations (adsbexchange.com/donate).
Features:
• Connects to dump1090, tar1090 and Virtual Radar Server.
• Comes preconfigured using ADS-B Exchange (adsbexchange.com). Note that OpenADSB is not affiliated with ADSBexchange.com, LLC
• Smoothly displays thousands of aircraft
• Shows aircraft history trails
• Various aircraft and history trail color schemes and optional legend
• Fully configurable filtering, display only the aircrafts you want to see
• Configurable military, VFR and emergency highlights
• Long-press on an aircraft to perform a browser search engine search of its callsign and registration
• Tap on an aircraft to show more details
• Details are fully configurable and includes callsign, registration, ICAO hex code, altitude, speed, vertical speed, heading, aircraft type, squawk code, MLAT, latitude/longitude and more
• Display values in imperial or metric units
• Bookmark up to 5 favorite locations
• Mail track details feature, send an email containing an aircraft's details along with a map snapshot, fully configurable
• Optimized data fetching logic minimizes network, battery usage and server load
• Highly configurable
• Supports Dark Mode
• Supports Split View, Slide Over and multitasking on iPad
• Keyboard shortcuts for external keyboards
Limitations and Disclaimer
OpenADSB is a general air traffic visualizer for dump1090, tar1090 and Virtual Radar Server data sources. OpenADSB is not affiliated with ADSBexchange.com, LLC. As a convenience, OpenADSB comes preconfigured using ADSBexchange.com as the default data source. Air traffic data, its accuracy, and its validity, is the sole responsibility of the data provider. OpenADSB is for entertainment use only, and not for operational, flight, navigation, traffic avoidance or any mission critical use.

bluejetty:00170081:ios.description:
Arabic Alphabet: Learn & Write is a fantastic educational app that helps children master the skill of writing Arabic letters. Specifically designed for young learners, this app provides a fun and engaging way to learn how to write each letter of the Arabic alphabet using only their fingers.
Featuring a user-friendly interface and vibrant graphics, kids will enjoy tracing each letter and perfecting their technique with ease. Clear instructions for each letter, along with helpful tips and tricks, ensure that children can easily learn the correct way to write each Arabic letter.
With Arabic Letters: Tracing ABC, kids can also enjoy a freeform tracing mode to practice writing without the guidance of the app. The app provides feedback and positive reinforcement to encourage continuous learning and improvement.
Whether your child is just starting to learn Arabic or looking to enhance their writing skills, Arabic Alphabet: Learn & Write is the ideal educational tool to support their learning journey. Download the app now and let your child discover the joys of tracing uppercase Arabic letters!
App subscription:
You can subscribe for access to the full list of Write Letters. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. You will be able to do all exercises for the duration of the subscription. Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original "one month" package unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting though your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the
subscription period to avoid being charged. 
Please visit: http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098 for more information.
You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your iTunes Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period.
Any unused portion of free-trial period, will be forfeited when the user purchases an app subscription.

bluejetty:00007557:android.description:
FANTASTIC HIDDEN OBJECT PUZZLE ADVENTURE GAME FROM THE CREATORS OF ENIGMATIS AND GRIM LEGENDS!
Embark on a clandestine mission that will decide the fate 
of the world! The Alliance has tasked you, a secret agent, with finding a mysterious artifact of unprecedented power that could change the course of the war. Can you outsmart your enemies, overcome every obstacle, and unravel the centuries old mystery?
TRY IT FREE, THEN UNLOCK THE FULL ADVENTURE FROM WITHIN THE GAME!
Amid the turmoil of war, the Alliance has given Agent Walker a mission of the utmost importance – track down and destroy the mythical Spear of Destiny before a sinister enemy can use its supernatural power to turn the tide of war and conquer the world!
PLAY A HIDDEN OBJECT MYSTERY GAME WITH A UNIQUE WARTIME SETTING!
The year is 1942, and the Europe is in flames. In the midst of the grim war, an mystical artifact known as the Spear of Destiny has been discovered, and it's believed to have the power to change the destiny of the war.
EXPLORE 35 HAND DRAWN LOCATIONS IN WAR TORN EUROPE!
Some believe the Spear to be nothing more than a larger-than-life myth, but neither side wants to make the mistake of dismissing its paranormal power, so a desperate race to uncover the truth about the relic begins.
A FANTASTIC STORY WITH A PARANORMAL TWIST!
To complete her mysterious mission, Agent Walker will have to cross the grim battlegrounds of France while facing death, destruction, and hidden puzzles every step of the way. But with so much at stake, there's no turning back.
PUT ON YOUR DETECTIVE HAT AND FIND THE HIDDEN RELIC!
Agent Walker will put on her detective hat and search for the location of the mysterious relic while solving puzzles and tackling obstacles. Of course, there's a sinister spy among the members of the Alliance who will stop at nothing to thwart the protagonist.
25 ENTHRALLING MINI-GAMES AND 22 HIDDEN OBJECT SCENES!
Time is of the essence. If the enemies of the Alliance get their hands on the artifact, they would have the power to bring about the end of the world as we know it. Will Agent Walker succeed, or is mankind already doomed?
A NEW HIDDEN OBJECT MYSTERY GAME NOW IN YOUR LANGUAGE!
Enjoy the paranormal story in English, German, Italian, French, Portuguese, Spanish, Polish, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
TAKE YOUR HIDDEN OBJECT GAME WITH YOU!
Optimized for phones and tablets, filled with hidden objects, and perfect for playing while traveling. No Wi-Fi is required for this offline game!
SIGN UP FOR OUR NEWSLETTER TO LEARN ABOUT NEW HIDDEN OBJECT GAMES EVERY MONTH!
Captivating adventures, paranormal investigations, grim legends, and eerie mysteries await the brave and adventurous who delve into our selection of immersive hidden object games!
FOR MORE GAMES LIKE THIS, CHECK OUT "ARTIFEX MUNDI!"
Try it for free, buy it if you like it, and enjoy it without any restrictions!
• Explore more than 20 hand-painted hidden object scenes!
• 35 amazing war torn locations await!
• Assemble a vast collection of military vehicles!
• Become a master by unlocking 16 achievements!
• Complete 25 mind bending mini-games!

bluejetty:00127687:ios.description:
Habits helps you keeping track and achieving your goals, by allowing you to customize them the most while keeping a simple and intuitive UI and user experience. 
Several graphs and statistics will help you understanding and analyzing your results!
== Handling simple habits ==
Practicing every three days, playing the guitar four times a week, read a book every week end or revising your exams every day : create and save these habits in a matter of seconds, and update them with a simple tap.
== Handling progressive habits ==
Have you drunk your daily liter and a half of water? 
Achieve your goals progressively by indicating your daily target, and fill your progress gradually to remember what you have already done. 
== Statistics ==
For every habit, you can access a statistics page containing essential data to help you understanding and improving it :
- The main evolution, day after day, by day, week, month, trimester or year.
- An immediate visual of your daily results,
- Your best uninterrupted streaks,
- And lastly, your best week days for every month.
== Notifications ==
You can setup notifications for every habit as a reminder. 
== Your personal data ==
Absolutely none of your personal data created with this application will be sent to any server, it will stay stored in your phone only. 
However, we grant you the ability to export it and keep a backup of your data, to re-import it if needed. 
Thank you for using Habits! Don’t hesitate contacting us to report a problem or proposing new ideas in order to constantly improve the app, at habitude-support@robbeyroad.com

bluejetty:00025288:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00025288:ios.description:
Lost your earbuds, headphones or a Bluetooth tag? Bluetooth device tag finder shows you which Bluetooth devices are nearby and guides you to the one you're looking for, getting warmer as you get closer.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Open the app and allow Bluetooth.
2. Scan to see the devices around you.
3. Pick the one you lost.
4. Walk around slowly: the signal meter rises and the app tells you when you're getting warmer or colder.
FEATURES
• Nearby devices: see Bluetooth devices around you with their signal strength, and search the list.
• Getting warmer: beeps and vibrations speed up as you get closer to your device.
• My devices: save your devices with your own names and icons.
• Last-seen map: see where your iPhone was when it last detected a saved device.
• Play sound: play a sound on supported devices, or a loud chirp through earbuds connected to your iPhone.
• Left-behind alerts: get notified when a saved device goes out of range (for devices that allow a connection).
• Home Screen widget and Live Activity: check your devices and follow a search from the Lock Screen.
WORKS WITH
Bluetooth earbuds and headphones, speakers, fitness trackers, smartwatches, key finders and other Bluetooth Low Energy accessories, as long as they're switched on, charged, within Bluetooth range and broadcasting. AirPods can be found while they're out of the case or the case is open.
GOOD TO KNOW
• Signal strength is an estimate. Walls and people affect it, so distances are approximate.
• Devices that are switched off, out of battery or out of range can't be detected.
• Many Apple devices don't let other apps connect to them. For those, also use Apple's Find My app.
SUBSCRIPTION
Unlimited use of the app needs a subscription:
• Monthly, with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers.
• Weekly, with no free trial.
The price in your currency is shown in the app before you buy.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends.
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the period ends.
• You can manage or cancel your subscription in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions.
• Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/bluetooth-device-tag-finder/projects
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/bluetooth-device-tag-finder/terms
AirPods is a trademark of Apple Inc., registered in the U.S. and other countries. This app is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Apple or any device maker mentioned.

bluejetty:00177678:ios.description:
Enjoy Zuzu, a binary puzzle game that tests your logic and skill! If you like Sudoku puzzles, you will love Zuzu!
About Zuzu:
Your goal is to fill in the board using only logical determination, similar to Sudoku. Tap a tile on the board to set or change its color. Like the binary number system in general, there are only two tile colors, orange (0) and blue (1). Zuzu games begin with an unfinished grid that must be filled in correctly according to three rules listed below.
Each row and each column:
.. is unique
.. has an equal number of red and blue tiles
.. has no more than two adjacent tiles of the same color
The strategies for solving a Zuzu binary puzzle vary in complexity. Once you install the game you will find a “How to Play” section with a link to a video outlining some successful solving strategies for a binary puzzle.
Track your best and average solve times over history with our stats tracker.
You can play Zuzu by Razzle Puzzles on your phone and tablet. Enjoy online or in offline mode!
For support please contact us at support@razzlepuzzles.com or visit RazzlePuzzles.com

bluejetty:00145128:ios.summary:
Lunatask is an all-in-one encrypted to-do list, habit tracker, journaling, life-tracking and notes app – now with relationship tracking too!
SELF-ORGANIZING LISTS
We’ve got your back, take the weight off your shoulders, and ensure no task
bluejetty:00145128:ios.description:
Lunatask is an all-in-one encrypted to-do list, habit tracker, journaling, life-tracking and notes app – now with relationship tracking too!
SELF-ORGANIZING LISTS
We’ve got your back, take the weight off your shoulders, and ensure no task is left behind. Pick your workflow and let our unique, forgiving, battle-tested approach handle the rest.
- Must/Should/Want Method
- Eisenhower Matrix
- Urgency-based Prioritization
- Pomodoro Timer
- Status Tracking
- Goal Tracking
- Task Estimation
- Recurring/Scheduled Tasks
- Work-in-progress Limit
DAILY CALENDAR + TIME BLOCKING
Connect your calendars to see meetings and calls for today directly next to your tasks. Then, drag your planned tasks and habits onto the calendar to fill the space in between.
- Time Blocking of Tasks & Habits
- Quick Join Zoom & Google Meet Calls
- Create Notes for Events from Templates (on desktop)
- Track Habits and Complete Tasks Directly from the Calendar
BUILD HEALTHY HABITS
Adopting new healthy habits is hard, we've all been there. Our beautiful visual habit tracker gives you accountability and shows your progress. Get rid of bad habits and build new healthy ones.
- Daily & Weekly Habits
- Customizable Recurrence
- Current/Record Streak Calculation
- Group Habits into Routines (in our desktop app)
- Tracking of Bad Habits
- Reminder Notifications
TRACK HOW YOU FEEL
Whether you have trouble managing mood swings, stress, anxiety, or depression, tracking how you feel will give you visibility into how you are doing over time and how your new habits affect you to help you overcome these challenging conditions.
- Mood and Emotion Tracker
- Energy Level Tracker
- Stress Level Tracker
JOURNALING
Keep a log of your thoughts, feelings, and experiences for self-expression and reflection and keep track of your mental well-being.
- PIN Protection for Extra Privacy
- Customizable Template for Entries (in our desktop app)
SECURE NOTES
Whether writing a list of goals for the next week, meeting notes, or an entry into your daily journal, our encrypted notes and notebooks keep everything organized.
- Markdown Support
- Note Sharing
- Note Tagging
- Note Templates
- Password-protected Notebooks
BUILD CLOSER EVERLASTING RELATIONSHIPS
Keep track of everything related to your friends and family, what to talk about next time you meet, and say goodbye to missed anniversaries, forever. You are not as alone as you might think.
- CRM but for Your Personal Life
- Fully Customizable Fields
- Timeline of Happy Memories You Share
- Set up Reconnect to Get Back in Touch
AN OPEN PLATFORM
Your to-do list is at the center of your life, it's important everything is there. Integrate with the tools you're already using and automatically bring tasks from your favorite apps into your to-do list.
- Email Integration
- Browser Bookmarklet
- Zapier Integration
- Public API
STATE OF THE ART SECURITY
All your data is end-to-end encrypted by industry-leading encryption algorithms. No one has access to your data, not even us.
- End-to-end encryption of your data
- We ask just for the email address
- We don't sell your data
- No in-app product analytics or tracking
SIMPLE PRICING
These are premium features not available on our forever-free plan:
- Unlimited Areas of Life (Free plan is limited to 2)
- Unlimited Habits (Free plan is limited to 7)
- Unlimited Relationships (Free plan is limited to 30)
- Weekly Habits
- Eisenhower Matrix
- Must/Should/Want Method
- Energy Level Tracker
- Note Templates
- Calendar Integrations
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period in user's iTunes Account Settings.
Documentation and more information available at https://lunatask.app
Terms of Use: https://lunatask.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://lunatask.app/privacy

Protect your private conversations with WAMR, the ultimate app to save, view, and manage your chats — even after these chats are deleted! With WAMR you can recover or undelete your chats, media, files, and links instantly and access them anytime, anywhere without being online.

-> Key Features:
- Recover and Undelete Deleted Messages & Media
Securely import and save your Personal and Business chats with media, links, and documents. Easily access messages, photos, videos, and files even after you delete those messages and media files from WhatsApp.
- Status Saver
You can easily save viewed status images & videos. Just link you account and you can view and save your favorite status simultaneously. Access these video, images status anytime in the Collection tab.
- Real Chat Style Viewer
Enjoy your chats in a familiar layout with accurate timestamps. You can view all your message shared media, links, docs in original chat format.

With WAMR You can recover chats from anywhere like Drive, File Manager, ChatApp or any exported chat file.
- Export Chats to Cloud or Local Storage

* Cut down on work-related travel expenses by making day trips

* Take advantage of daytime amenities, like pools, spas, and gyms
* Get ready for an event, such as a wedding or dinner

bluejetty:00155331:ios.name: VTech KidiConnect (CA English)
bluejetty:00155331:ios.summary:
KidiConnect™ lets you keep in touch with your child even when you are away from home.
With KidiConnect™ kids can share messages using a compatible VTech toy. All contacts must be approved by parents before any communication can take place
bluejetty:00155331:ios.description:
KidiConnect™ lets you keep in touch with your child even when you are away from home.
With KidiConnect™ kids can share messages using a compatible VTech toy. All contacts must be approved by parents before any communication can take place so parents will have peace of mind knowing their child is in a kid-safe environment. 
NOTE: KidiConnect™ is meant for communication with compatible VTech toys. You cannot use it to send messages to adults or children who do not have a compatible device.
Why Use KidiConnect™?
• Stay Connected with Your Child Anytime, Anywhere. KidiConnect™ uses an Internet connection to let you communicate with your child even when you are away from home - anywhere in the world. Parents can also add family members and friends to the child's contact list, so grandparents can stay close too.
• Kid Safe. All contacts must be approved by parents before communication can take place. Users who are not on a child's contact list cannot contact your child.
• Good For All Ages! Even the youngest kids can use KidiConnect™ to share voice messages, photos, drawings, stickers, and pre-recorded messages. And as children grow, they will be able to share text messages too!
• Group Chat. With Group Chat, your child can communicate and share with multiple family members or friends at the same time. 
• It's Fun! You can customize your KidiConnect™ avatar with your photo, or choose one of several cartoon designs. There are also fun stickers and pre-recorded messages. Your child can even use the voice changer to record a robot voice or a mouse voice!
USING KIDICONNECT™
Parents:
Please register your child's VTech device before downloading this app. This will create a Learning Lodge® Family Account, which one parent can use to log in to this app. That parent will be in charge of the child's contact list and can use this app to send or approve friend requests on their child's behalf.
The other parent will have to sign up for a separate Learning Lodge® account and be added to the family like any other relative.
Relatives:
You must get parental approval before you can contact a child. Once you've signed up for a Learning Lodge® account, send the child's parents a request to join their family.
* KidiConnect™ works with KidiBuzz™ and other VTech devices which support KidiConnect™ or VTech Kid Connect™.
For more details about VTech, please visit our website: 
http://www.vtechkids.ca

bluejetty:00119770:ios.description:
Toloka is an app where you can earn money by completing simple tasks. No special knowledge is required for these tasks.
Pick the tasks you like
You can perform tasks that are better paid, or simply do the ones you like. You might prefer to check an organization's contact details, while others prefer checking whether search results match a particular search query.
Follow your task history
Track the status and check the results of your completed tasks in the "Activity History" section.
Profile
Find out how much you’ve earned by checking "Account". Here, you can also see your skill levels: the higher the number, the more tasks are available to you.
Withdraw funds from your account
Your earnings are credited to your Toloka account immediately after the requester accepts the task. Earnings are paid in dollars, and you can cash them in your local currency through Payoneer. Turkish citizens can also withdraw money via Papara.
Please note: this app is intended for users over the age of 18. Please read the license agreement before installing Toloka: https://toloka.ai/tolokers/legal/toloka_mobile_agreement

bluejetty:00166776:ios.description:
In a diverse world, borderless communication is our common pursuit. aiTranslate, an intelligent translation app tailored for iOS devices, stands out with its precise and efficient translation capabilities and user-friendly experience, making it your reliable assistant for cross-cultural communication.
▶Conversation Translation
Using advanced AI deep learning, it better understands context and recognizes speech more accurately.
▶Voice Translation
With high-sensitivity voice recognition, just press a button to instantly convert your speech into the target language, making communication natural and fluent.
▶Simultaneous Interpretation
Utilizing advanced translation engines, it supports high-precision real-time translation in multiple languages, overcoming language barriers and enhancing efficiency.
▶Photo Translation
Never feel lost with menus or signs in unfamiliar languages again. aiTranslate’s photo translation lets you capture text and get instant translations. Just tap to camera, and the app will recognize and translate it immediately, helping you navigate smoothly.
▶Document Translation
Whether it's business, academic, or personal documents, aiTranslate offers professional translation services. Using advanced machine learning and a vast database, we ensure accurate and fluent translations. Simply copy and paste for fast, high-quality results, breaking language barriers and reaching a global audience.
▶Audio & Video Call Translation
Enjoy high-quality global calls with real-time bidirectional translation, enabling seamless communication across languages without needing to know the other person's language.
▶AI Conversations
Switch seamlessly between scenarios with AI available anytime, anywhere. Simulate real-life language environments, break language barriers, and boost your skills through fun, interactive conversations.
▶Voice Cloning
Replicate your voice for translations in your tone, offering accurate, personalized, and convenient multilingual interactions.
▶Supports 100+ Languages
Chinese, Mandarin, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian, Malay, Filipino, Turkish, Irish, Swahili...
▶Key Features:
- Simple, intuitive interface for all ages.
- Supports multiple major languages.
- Intelligent memory for frequently used vocabulary and history.
- Regular updates for better translation quality.
aiTranslate, making every translation shine like gold, helping you communicate confidently on the international stage and unlock infinite possibilities. Download now and start your intelligent translation journey!
▶Application Scenarios
-Business Meetings: Real-time translation in international business negotiations makes communication more efficient, aiding seamless business cooperation.
-Overseas Travel: Easily communicate with locals while exploring foreign cultures, making your journey more enriching.
▶Important Notes:

- Upgrading to a premium subscription during the free trial forfeits any remaining trial benefits.
- Stop auto-renewal anytime via your iTunes account settings, but do so at least 24 hours before the trial or subscription ends to avoid charges. Once canceled, your service will downgrade to the free version at the end of the current period.
- To ensure continuous service, your account will be charged the renewal fee within 24 hours before the current subscription ends.
Please read and understand the above terms carefully to better manage your subscription status.

bluejetty:00016146:ios.name: Cascade Gem & Jewel Adventure
bluejetty:00016146:ios.summary: Challenge your brain with this one-of-a-kind matching game where you aim, shoot, and match gems to solve puzzles! Explore lands, dig up treasures, and complete quests in a uniquely strategic way. Finally, a matching game designed for adults
bluejetty:00016146:ios.description:
Challenge your brain with this one-of-a-kind matching game where you aim, shoot, and match gems to solve puzzles! Explore lands, dig up treasures, and complete quests in a uniquely strategic way. Finally, a matching game designed for adults!
You’ll have a blast in this critically acclaimed gem-matching adventure! Build powerful combos on each level by spinning and tapping to make your matches. Sparkling gems, rare diamonds and beautiful jewels drop like candy on each turn. Plus, get a FREE Gold Starter Pack when you install this free-to-play matching puzzle game!
Journey through dozens of delightful hand-painted Lands to solve more than 900 clever puzzles! Connect with others, collect great prizes and crush tricky obstacles by playing in quests, bonus levels and NEW tournaments. 
CURRENT FEATURES
• Dig into exciting events to farm more resources by competing in Top Score Tournaments, or playing Quick Quests & Bonus Levels – it all helps you build up more powerful tricks & boosts! 
• Jam through cascading jackpots on your gem-matching adventure with Cascade's groovy music!
• Cuteness Alert! Get help from a host of sweet animal friends along the way -- puppies, pandas, bunnies, otters, foxes & more! You’ll love Jasper, the gem digging Mole, and all his furry friends.
• Win big by being Social! Keep score with your friends through recurring events, invite them to play, share your moments in the game & gift extra lives to your friends on Facebook!
• Skill and strategy matter! Yes, Cascade is entertaining, relaxing and delightful - but it's also training your brain with each addicting puzzle!
• Where will you go next: a Casino, English Garden, Cascade Resort or a tropical Space Observatory? Yes, with more hand-painted Lands with charm and heart in each frequent update!
• Build powerful boosts! Burst Gems, Super Wilds, Spin Savers, Hammers, Shifters and more will help you match through the most puzzling levels.
Exploding color, clever gameplay and delightful wins have inspired players to rate Cascade as "uniquely strategic", "fast-paced" and "brilliant fun"! It’s been featured for its unique play style: spin a wheel for gems on each turn, tap to match them with same-color gems on the board, and celebrate cascading wins with every match of three or more. The larger the match, the higher your score! Here’s your chance to swap out that match-3 puzzle game for a breath of fresh air with Cascade.
Want to hear more from current players? Get strategy tips, Cascade game updates and follow event posts on our Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/playcascadegame/

bluejetty:00044731:ios.summary: Fairy games are not just about flying around with pretty wings and casting magic spells - they can also be hilarious! Take for example the evolution game, where you start as a tiny fairy and work your way up to explore different magic world
bluejetty:00044731:ios.description:
Fairy games are not just about flying around with pretty wings and casting magic spells - they can also be hilarious! Take for example the evolution game, where you start as a tiny fairy and work your way up to explore different magic worlds.
Get ready for a magic adventure in the enchanted worlds with the Fairy Evolution Game! You'll start as a tiny creature and work your way up to becoming a funny mutant mage. The evolution aspect of the magic strategy fairy game is just as entertaining as the adventures: as you progress, you'll earn points and power-ups that allow you to evolve magic creatures into more advanced forms.
MAGICAL EVOLUTION FEATURES
- Pantheon: a new place for supreme beings to look down on us mortals and laugh at our misery
- Impostors: watch out for impostors trying to steal the spotlight from the fairies.
HOW TO PLAY THIS MAGIC STRATEGY FAIRY
- Drag and drop similar fairies to create new mysterious creatures
- Use magic eggs to earn coins, buy new creatures and make even more money
- Alternatively, fiercely tap a fairy to make coins pop from their eggs
HIGHLIGHTS
- Different stages and many magical species to discover
- A mind-blowing story with fantastical twists!
- The unexpected mix of creature evolution dynamics and incremental clicker games
- Doodle-like illustrations
- Open ended gameplay: enjoy the freedom!
- No fairies were harmed in the making of this game, only developers
This game ain’t fair. It’s fairy. So if you're looking for a magic strategy fairy game that's equal parts adventure and absurdity, look no further than the magic evolution game! With its charming graphics, quirky humor, and plenty of magic, it's the perfect escape from the ordinary world.
So what are you waiting for? Download the Fairy Evolution Game today and get ready for a wild and wacky ride through the enchanted forest!
Please note! Fairy Evolution is free to play, but it contains items that can be purchased for real money. Some features and extras mentioned in the description may also have to be purchased for real money.
