bluejetty:00070444:ios.description:
New York City Subway is the original and No. 1 selling application for getting around New York City.
- "New York City Subway application helps users navigate the complexities of the city's subway network" - The Epoch Times.
- New York City Subway app is recommended by the Financial Times and the Los Angeles Times.
************************************************************
DESCRIPTION
************************************************************
New York City Subway for iPhone is a comprehensive guide to traveling through New York City (NYC).
● Latest map of New York City Transit. Landscape and portrait modes are available. Detailed map of each line.
● Optimized for the latest iPhone screens. Works on all iPhone versions.
● Precise location of each station on the map (with a red circle). This application is fully compatible with Apple Maps, each station is represented by a red pin, a popup shows you the distance, and it's updated live (thanks to GPS) as you walk down the streets of NYC.
● The journey planner tool allows you to find automatically the best route to get to your destination in NYC Subway. Interactive map to choose your stations for the route. The journey planner does not require a network connection to operate, it works perfectly while in the subway.
● A bookmark manager allows you to save your favorite stations and routes.
● The application locates the nearest subway stations from your position in NYC. You can also provide an address in NYC, the application indicates the stations closest to that address.
● This application is available in English, French, Spanish, German and Japanese.
Thank you for taking the time to report any bugs or to request an enhancement to New York City Subway Application. Feedback is very important to us. We will do our best to answer queries. Email us at support@presselite.com

apple-macos:1595129686.name: DeDuplicate - Cloud Cleaner
apple-macos:1595129686.description:
Photos backed up twice, videos from old phones, folders copied “just in case”: duplicates pile up in the cloud and take up space you often pay for.
DeDuplicate scans your cloud storage, finds files with identical content, whatever their name, and lets you choose which copies to delete.
YOUR PRIVACY COMES FIRST
• Everything happens on your device, which talks directly to your cloud provider: your data never passes through DeDuplicate or third-party servers. 
• Nobody, not even the developer, receives your cloud data: file names, paths, and contents stay between you and your provider. 
• Your files are never downloaded: the app works with their metadata. 
• What the app stores, such as accounts, results, and history, is encrypted on your device. 
• No DeDuplicate account is needed, and there are no ads or usage analytics. 
• Diagnostics are off unless you turn them on, and never contain cloud data. Crash reports stay on your device.
WHAT IT CAN DO
• Finds only exact duplicates, never files that are merely similar or share a name. 
• Fast, because it downloads nothing: it compares metadata, including a fingerprint (hash) of each file’s content. In our tests, about 100,000 files in under 10 minutes: the time depends on the number of files, not their size. 
• Handles drives with hundreds of thousands of files, even on modest devices. 
• Scan the whole drive or only some folders, with or without shared files. 
• Stop scans and deletions whenever you like, and resume an interrupted deletion. 
• Deleted copies go to your cloud provider’s trash. History shows what each operation did and, where the provider allows it, restores them. 
• Results and history are saved, even after you close the app. 
• Search, sort, and export the results (CSV or JSON). 
• Same features on computers, phones, and tablets, with a dedicated desktop interface.
• On iOS 26 or later, keeps working in the background.
SUPPORTED SERVICES
• OneDrive 
• Dropbox 
• Google Drive, not Google Photos (∗) 
• MEGA 
• Box 
• pCloud 
• Yandex Disk
Designed and tested mainly for personal accounts: work, school, and enterprise accounts are not yet fully supported.
(∗) Scans cover the files stored in Google Drive, except Google’s native files such as Google Docs and Google Sheets.
WHY DeDuplicate
Otherwise you would download everything to a computer, find the duplicates there, and sync the changes back: not practical with hundreds of gigabytes. Or you would give an online service or an AI assistant access to your cloud. With DeDuplicate, you don’t hand it over to anyone.
DeDuplicate is actively developed: if something goes wrong, write to us and we will help.

ROAD TRIP? TRAIN RIDE? JUST TRYING TO TUNE OUT THE PERSON SITTING NEXT TO YOU ON THE PLANE? ;) 
With over 895,000 premium audiobooks, and 100,000 free, you can get your wisdom on—and politely protect your headspace.
IT’S LIKE MUSIC...ERRR, NARRATION TO YOUR EARS. 
From the latest bestsellers to timeless classics to up-and-coming indie authors, Free Audiobooks HQ is the app for a massive selection of studio-recorded quality audiobooks at your fingertips. Or should we say earbuds? 
ON DEMAND, NO SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED 
Just open, search, click and listen. There are no credits and no recurring monthly fees. Free Audiobooks HQ lets you download and listen on demand, wherever you are, whenever you're ready. Even find the top rated books with the click of a button, or switch the language and get your Spanish on! 
FANCY FEATURES YOU’LL WANT TO BRAG ABOUT TO YOUR FRIENDS 
Free Audiobooks HQ even does neat tricks like adjusts the speed, slows down or speeds up playback in 40 increments (without affecting pitch!), and even sets a sleep timer when it's time for bed. 
BONUS: ACCESS 158,000 EPISODES OF OLD TIME RADIO, TOO! 
It's the best radio dramas of the 1930's, 1940's, 1950's and more. Because what's modern technology without a little old-school entertainment? 
GREAT FOR AROUND THE HOUSE, TOO! 
Washing the car. Check. Washing the dog. Probably that, too. Whether you're logging some miles on the ol' treadmill, or logging 'em driving cross country, we're the companion you didn't know you needed. (Sorry, dog.)
